jobs.title: AI Data Engineer (8a-5p) Data and Analytics - Johnson City, TN
jobs.description: **Job Description:** Summary: The AI Data Engineer II is an independent technical contributor responsible for designing, developing, and deploying enterprise AI solutions that leverage Ballad Health's trusted data assets. Working within Ballad's Microsoft Fabric, Azure AI, Epic, and enterprise technology ecosystem, this role develops intelligent applications, agentic workflows, and AI\-enabled services that improve clinical care, operational performance, workforce productivity, and business decision\-making. This position combines modern data engineering with practical AI application development. The AI Data Engineer II builds and integrates AI solutions that securely connect large language models with enterprise data, APIs, documents, and operational systems while ensuring solutions remain scalable, governed, and production\-ready. Key Responsibilities **AI Solution Development** Design, develop, test, and deploy AI\-enabled applications, intelligent workflow automation, and agentic solutions using approved enterprise AI platforms. Develop solutions that combine enterprise data, semantic search, workflow automation, APIs, and large language models to support clinical, financial, operational, and administrative use cases. **Enterprise Data Integration** Develop scalable data pipelines and AI\-ready data services integrating Epic, Microsoft Fabric, ERP, claims, and other enterprise information sources. Design data structures and retrieval approaches that enable AI applications to securely access trusted enterprise knowledge while maintaining appropriate governance, privacy, and role\-based security. **AI Workflow Engineering** Develop AI workflows capable of retrieving enterprise information, interacting with approved systems and services, orchestrating multiple tasks, and supporting human review where appropriate. Evaluate AI performance and refine solution behavior to improve accuracy, reliability, usability, and operational effectiveness. **Platform Engineering** Develop reusable services, components, APIs, and engineering patterns that enable rapid development of future AI\-enabled applications. Support deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and lifecycle maintenance of production AI solutions. **Collaboration** Partner with AI Solutions Engineers, Data Engineers, Analytics teams, Information Technology, Clinical Informatics, cybersecurity, and operational leaders to translate business needs into secure, scalable AI solutions. Requirements: **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, Informatics, or related technical field. * Three (3\) or more years of professional software engineering, data engineering, machine learning engineering, or related technical experience. * Demonstrated experience developing AI\-enabled applications using modern AI platforms or frameworks. * Strong proficiency with Python, SQL, REST APIs, and cloud\-based development environments. * Experience working with cloud data and AI platforms such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure AI, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Databricks, AWS, GCP, or comparable enterprise technologies. * Experience integrating AI solutions with enterprise data sources, APIs, documents, or operational systems. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to translate complex business requirements into production\-ready technical solutions. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience developing enterprise AI solutions using retrieval\-based search, workflow orchestration, prompt design, structured outputs, or intelligent automation techniques. * One year relevant experience. * Experience building conversational applications, intelligent assistants, or agentic workflows. * Experience working with Microsoft Fabric, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Power Platform, or related Microsoft technologies. * Experience with healthcare data, Epic, FHIR, HL7, claims, value\-based care, or clinical operations. * Experience working in regulated environments requiring strong governance, privacy, and security controls. **Work Requirements:** Shift: Day On Call: No Weekends: No Travel Required: No Travel Shift Details: 8a\-5p City/State: Johnson City, TN **Location:** Ballad Health Corporate

jobs.title: Senior Engineer -AI Security, Systems Engineering & Developer Productivity
jobs.description: **Job Description:** At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day. Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits. We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths \- whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve. Bank of America is committed to an in\-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in\-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role\-specific responsibilities and business needs. At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us! **Job Description:** Seeking a highly technical, hands\-on Senior Engineer with deep Systems Engineering expertise to lead AI security, platform modernization, and developer productivity initiatives across Digital Technology. The role will drive secure adoption of AI capabilities, establish the roadmap for AI vulnerability management (including Mythos remediation), accelerate engineering modernization, and enable rapid release capabilities required to address emerging security threats and platform risks. This individual will serve as a technical leader, architect, and builder, developing solutions that improve engineering efficiency, strengthen security posture, and accelerate software delivery. This job is responsible for defining and leading the engineering approach for complex features to deliver significant business outcomes. Key responsibilities of the job include delivering complex features and technology, enabling development efficiencies, providing technical thought leadership based on conducting multiple software implementations, and applying both depth and breadth in a number of technical competencies. Additionally, this job is accountable for end\-to\-end solution design and delivery. **Responsibilities:** * Ensures that the design and engineering approach for complex features are consistent with the larger portfolio solution * Define the technology tool stack for the solution and evaluate and adapt new testing tool/framework/practices for team(s) * Enables team(s)/applications with Continuous Integration/Continuous Development (CI/CD) capabilities and engages with other technical stakeholders pertaining to efficient functioning of CI\-CD pipeline * Guides and influences team(s) on design and best practices for high code performance –e.g. pairing, code reviews * Provides end\-to\-end delivery of complex features, including automation, for either a single team or multiple teams, at the program level * Conducts research, design prototyping and other exploration activities such as evaluating new toolsets and components for release management, CI/CD, and features * Works with stakeholders to establish high\-level solution needs and with architects for technical requirements * Lead identification, triage, prioritization, and remediation of AI\-related vulnerabilities. * Build developer productivity solutions that accelerate secure software delivery. * Drive platform modernization initiatives, including JDK upgrades, framework upgrades, and technical debt reduction. * Enable rapid\-release capabilities for critical vulnerability remediation and security response. * Partner with Architecture, Security, Infrastructure, and Development teams to establish enterprise\-wide engineering standards. * Develop automation that reduces remediation lead times and improves engineering efficiency. * Champion secure AI adoption and establish best practices for AI\-powered software development. **Required Qualifications** * 7\+ years of software engineering, systems engineering, and platform engineering experience. * Strong hands\-on experience with large\-scale distributed systems, application architecture, and enterprise platform design. * Proven expertise in AI/LLM consumption patterns, AI platform integration, and secure AI application development. * Deep understanding of AI security risks, vulnerability management, and remediation practices. * Experience leading vulnerability remediation programs, including analysis, prioritization, and mitigation of AI\-related security findings (e.g., Mythos scans). * Experience developing remediation roadmaps and driving enterprise\-wide security modernization initiatives. * Strong knowledge of application security, secure coding practices, OWASP, authentication, authorization, encryption, and API security. * Hands\-on experience with Java ecosystem modernization, including JDK upgrades, dependency management, and framework modernization. * Experience designing and implementing CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, DevSecOps, and release engineering capabilities. * Strong cloud, containerization, Kubernetes, and infrastructure automation experience. * Ability to provide technical leadership across multiple engineering teams and drive adoption of engineering standards and best practices. * Strong problem\-solving, architecture, and stakeholder management skills. **Desired Qualifications** * Experience building AI\-powered developer productivity tools and software engineering accelerators. * Experience with GitHub Copilot, Copilot Studio, GenAI development frameworks, prompt engineering, and agentic AI architectures. * Experience establishing rapid deployment models, including ad\-hoc and 48\-hour release capabilities for security remediation. * Knowledge of AI governance, model risk management, compliance, and responsible AI practices. * Experience with security scanning technologies, vulnerability assessment platforms, and automated remediation workflows. * Experience building reusable engineering platforms, developer portals, self\-service tooling, and platform engineering solutions. * Familiarity with enterprise observability, operational excellence, and SRE practices. * Experience leading large\-scale technology modernization programs across multiple business lines. * Experience mentoring senior engineers and influencing architecture decisions at an enterprise level. * Financial services and regulated industry experience preferred. **Skills:** * Automation * Influence * Result Orientation * Stakeholder Management * Technical Strategy Development * Application Development * Architecture * Business Acumen * Risk Management * Solution Design * Agile Practices * Analytical Thinking * Collaboration * Data Management * Solution Delivery Process **Shift:** 1st shift (United States of America) **Hours Per Week:** 40

jobs.description: Date live: 09/21/2026 Business Area: Risk Finance and Treasury Area of Expertise: Technology Contract: Permanent Reference Code: JR\-0000127742 Salary / Rate **$ 120,000\.00 \- $ 175,000\.00** Embark on a transformative journey as a Senior Risk Analytics Software Engineer \- AVP. At Barclays, our vision is clear –to redefine the future of banking and help craft innovative solutions. In this role, you will play a key role in designing, developing, testing, and supporting strategic technology solutions that power Risk Analytics, Market Risk, and regulatory projects across the organization. You will collaborate closely with business stakeholders, quantitative analysts, and engineering teams to deliver scalable, secure, and high\-performance applications that drive critical risk management capabilities. The ideal candidate brings good software engineering expertise, a passion for innovation, and a commitment to engineering best practices within an Agile development environment. To be successful as a Senior Risk Analytics Software Engineer \- AVP, you should have: * Experience designing, developing, and maintaining analytics and reporting platforms that support data\-driven business and risk management decisions * Hands\-on experience building data transformation, enrichment, and workflow orchestration solutions for scalable data pipelines * Good understanding of Object\-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles and experience with frameworks and tools such as FastAPI, Spring Boot, and Apache Airflow * Proven programming expertise in Python and/or Java, Spark, SQL, Hadoop, Pandas, NumPy, Unix/Linux environments, and PowerShell scripting * Experience with software testing and development best practices, including PyTest, unit testing, and Python package management tools such as pip, Poetry, and Conda Other highly valued skills include: * Considerable knowledge of risk management principles and regulatory frameworks, including Value at Risk (VaR), Fundamental Review of the Trading Book (FRTB), and Basel standards * Experience working with cloud and data platforms such as AWS, Azure, Databricks, and Snowflake * Solid understanding of data governance, data quality management, regulatory controls, and compliance requirements You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in this role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking, digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills. Barclays employees are eligible for a suite of competitive and generous employee benefits, including medical, dental and vision coverage, 401(k), life insurance, and other paid leave for qualifying circumstances. This position is eligible for an incentive award. **Purpose of the role** To design, develop and improve software, utilising various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues. **Accountabilities** * Development and delivery of high\-quality software solutions by using industry aligned programming languages, frameworks, and tools. Ensuring that code is scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance. * Cross\-functional collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define software requirements, devise solution strategies, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives. * Collaboration with peers, participate in code reviews, and promote a culture of code quality and knowledge sharing. * Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations and actively contribute to the organization’s technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth. * Adherence to secure coding practices to mitigate vulnerabilities, protect sensitive data, and ensure secure software solutions. * Implementation of effective unit testing practices to ensure proper code design, readability, and reliability. **Assistant Vice President Expectations** * To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions. * Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. optimization. **Key Responsibilities:** * Execute process characterization experiments and engineering trials following defined procedures and protocols. * Collect, organize, and analyze process and inspection/metrology data to support engineering evaluations * Perform defect inspection and characterization using microscopy, metrology tools and analytical equipment. * Support statistical process control monitoring and assist in identifying process excursions or abnormal trends * Document experiment results, observations, and process changes in engineering reports and tracking databases. * environments. **Skills and Experience:** * High School Diploma or GED equivalent required. * Experience in semiconductor, advanced manufacturing or high\-tech production environments. * Experience reporting tools. * Experience operation or analyzing data from SEM tools is a strong plus * Ability to work in manufacturing environment for extended periods * May require standing, lifting, bending jobs.title: Data Engineer, Senior
jobs.description: **The Opportunity:** As a Senior Data Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining robust data pipelines. Your key tasks will include creating and optimizing end\-to\-end data flows, handling ETL processes including extract, transform, and load, designing data models, ensuring data security and compliance, collaborating with cross\-functional teams, and continuously improving performance and scalability. Your expertise will bridge the gap between raw data and actionable insights, enabling efficient data processing and analytics across the business. Here, you’ll work with and guide a multi\-disciplinary team of analysts, data engineers, developers, and data consumers in a fast\-paced, agile environment. You’ll use your experience in analytical exploration and data examination while you manage the assessment, design, building, and maintenance of scalable platforms for your clients. Work with us to use data for good. Join us. The world can’t wait. **You Have:** * 7\+ years of experience in designing and developing ETL processes and managing data pipelines * Experience using various AWS services, including AWS Glue, Amazon S3, and Amazon RDS * Knowledge of performance optimization techniques for ETL jobs, such as partitioning, bucketing, and caching * Ability to troubleshoot and improve query performance * Ability to develop and deploy ETL processes with limited visibility, utilizing comprehensive logging and robust error handling mechanisms to troubleshoot and resolve issues * Ability to proficiently write Python and PySpark code for ETL scripts and custom transformations * Ability to proficiently write SQL queries on a PostgreSQL database * Ability to design and implement data models, define schemas, and optimize data structures for efficient querying and analytics * Public Trust * Bachelor’s degree in Computer science, Computer engineering, Information systems, or technology **Nice If You Have:** * Experience with cloud\-native data services such as AWS Lambda or Google Cloud Functions and leveraging serverless architectures for data processing * Experience ensuring data quality, privacy, and security * Knowledge of data governance practices, data lineage, and compliance requirements such as GDPR and CCPA * Knowledge of tools like Apache Atlas, AWS Glue Data Catalog, or Collibra for managing metadata, data lineage, and cataloging data assets **Vetting:** Applicants selected will be subject to a government investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements of the U.S. government client; Public Trust determination is required. **Compensation** At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well\-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work\-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full\-time and part\-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page. Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract\-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $99,000\.00 to $225,000\.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date. **Identity Statement** As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in\-person or virtual) is prohibited **unless permission is explicitly provided** . **Work Model** Our people\-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration, whether it occurs in person or virtually. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings. * **Remote** : If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility. * **Hybrid** : If this position is listed as hybrid, you will be expected to work from a Booz Allen facility frequently, in alignment with leadership expectations and the needs of the role. You may also be required to work from or visit a customer facility. * **Onsite** : If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed at a Booz Allen office or customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role. **Commitment to Non\-Discrimination** All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

jobs.title: IT Field Engineer II
jobs.description: **Company Description** Boyd Gaming Corporation has been successful in gaming jurisdiction in which we operate in the United States and is one of the premier casino entertainment companies in the United States. Never content to rest upon our successes, we will continue to evolve and retain a position of leadership in our industry. Our past success, our current business philosophies and our sound business planning, combine to position Boyd Gaming Corporation to maximize value for our shareholders, our team members and our communities. **Job Description** Provides second\-level field engineering support for Company information systems, technology assets, and system users across assigned properties. Independently resolves escalated incidents and maintains network, server, endpoint, voice, audiovisual, and related services, escalating complex or high\-risk issues to Senior Field Engineers, Corporate IT teams, or vendors. Ensures reliable service, secure access, accurate documentation, and responsive customer support. **Technical Support and Incident Resolution** * Provide second\-level support for escalated incidents involving computers, printers, networks, servers, applications, and connected technology assets. * Troubleshoot incidents, isolate faults, support root\-cause analysis, restore service, and document actions and outcomes in the Company tracking system. * Respond to high\-priority outages and security vulnerability alerts at property and regional levels; communicate status and escalate complex or high\-risk issues appropriately. * Provide scheduled on\-call and after\-hours emergency support in accordance with departmental procedures. **Infrastructure, Endpoint, and Access Support** * Install, monitor, maintain, upgrade, and restore network, server, computer, printer, and communication hardware and software within production, training, datacenter, and communications\-closet environments. * Terminate, test, and troubleshoot network cabling using Company\-provided tools and test equipment. * Perform computer imaging, configuration, deployment, and replacement; support software upgrades and technology rollouts in coordination with Corporate IT teams. * Administer computer and user accounts, permissions, and vendor remote access in accordance with Company security policies; verify access removal or disconnection when work is complete. * Activate, configure, and enroll mobile devices in the Company mobile device management system and provide user support and training. **Voice, Audiovisual, and Digital Media Support** * Perform moves, additions, and changes for supported telephone and voicemail systems, including legacy, digital, and IP\-based technologies. * Install, configure, and troubleshoot digital\-signage and media\-delivery systems, including indoor and outdoor displays, video walls, projectors, monument signs, and pylon signs. * Where assigned, set up, operate, troubleshoot, and dismantle stage lighting, sound, microphone, processing, and related performance\-support equipment for local, regional, or national acts. **Documentation, Assets, and Collaboration** * Maintain complete, timely, and accurate incident, service, configuration, and action\-report documentation. * Inventory Company technology assets, document stock levels, and recommend replacement, upgrade, or retirement based on compatibility, reliability, and business need. * Participate in disaster\-recovery testing, technology evaluations, hardware planning, and implementation activities under the guidance of Corporate IT functional teams. * Provide technical guidance, on\-the\-job training, and mentoring to Engineer I team members without direct supervisory authority. * Coordinate with Senior Field Engineers, the IT Operations Center, Corporate IT teams, vendors, and property stakeholders to restore service and deliver reliable customer support. * Follow jobs.description: ### **Description** This is a hands\-on technical role focused on the reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency of Brivo's global data center infrastructure. You will manage the end\-to\-end infrastructure lifecycle—deploying, maintaining, upgrading, and decommissioning hardware—while driving automation and process improvements. As a technical lead for deployments and complex operational issues, you will establish technical standards and ensure high availability across our global sites.### **Key Responsibilities** * Deploy, maintain, upgrade, and decommission servers, storage, networking, and data center infrastructure. * Serve as the technical lead for physical infrastructure deployments and complex operational issues. * Drive automation and process improvements that reduce manual effort across data center operations. * Develop and maintain infrastructure standards, documentation, and operational procedures. * Perform root cause analysis for infrastructure incidents, manage asset inventory, and lead capacity planning. ### **Skills, Knowledge \& Expertise** * 3\+ years in data center operations, infrastructure engineering, or a related technical role. * Austin\-local (regular travel within the Austin metro area; no remote). * Experience with DCIM and infrastructure management tools such as NetBox or Nautobot. * Strong root\-cause\-analysis and troubleshooting skills across server hardware and physical infrastructure. * Automation\-oriented mindset with an AI\-native posture (active user of tools like Claude, Gemini, or ChatGPT). ### **Why Work for Us?** Brivo is a Great Place to Work\-Certified™ company and the global leader in cloud\-based access control and video surveillance. Following our merger with Eagle Eye Networks, we are building the only platform powerful enough to support the future of AI\-driven security. Why Your Work Matters Innovation drives our vibe, but purpose drives our mission. You will work on essential systems that protect the health, safety, and welfare of people and property worldwide. At Brivo, your voice is heard, your talent is respected, and your contributions have a global impact. * *The Brivo Experience:* We thrive on in\-person collaboration and a "one\-team" atmosphere. We embrace our international presence, leveraging diverse ideas and backgrounds to improve our culture and our products. To keep our global teams connected and inspired, we provide a premium onsite experience featuring communal meals, recurring social events, and fully stocked workspaces—ensuring you have everything you need to stay focused while building the future of security. * *Total Rewards:* We support our people with competitive medical, vision, and dental plans (including company\-offset premiums), a 401k with company match, and an unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO) policy that empowers you to take the time you need to maintain a healthy work\-life balance. Individual compensation packages are based on job\-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, training, and market conditions. In addition, Brivonians enjoy a robust benefits and perks package tailored to their work location. ### **About Brivo** Brivo and Eagle Eye Networks have come together to create a category\-defining, cloud\-first platform at the intersection of AI and the physical world. Our mission is simple and ambitious: to make physical spaces safer, smarter, and more autonomous—from single\-site businesses to global enterprises. As the unified global leaders in cloud\-based access control and video surveillance, we provide a comprehensive digital foundation for the built environment. By combining Brivo’s pioneering building access platform with Eagle Eye’s AI\-powered video management system (VMS), we have created a system of intelligence that protects over 600 million square feet across 90\+ countries. With a global footprint spanning headquarters in Bethesda, Maryland, and Austin, Texas, and international offices in Amsterdam, London, Bangalore, and Tokyo, we are leveraging our open APIs and cyber\-secure cloud infrastructure to reshape the future of physical security. Join us as we build the world’s most robust platform for video intelligence and smart space automation. Learn more at www.brivo.com. *Brivo is an equal employment opportunity employer and values diversity. jobs.description: **Data Records Clerk** **Location:** Alpharetta, GA **Department:** Cal Engineering Solutions **Position Type:** Full\-Time (40 Hours per Week) **Pay Range:** $16\.00 \- $18\.00 per Hour **Position Summary** Cal Engineering Solutions is seeking a reliable and detail\-oriented **Data Records Clerk** to support our engineering and IT teams in the Alpharetta office. This entry\-level position is responsible for transferring information between company systems, maintaining electronic records, and assisting with basic computer setup activities. The Data Records Clerk plays an important role in ensuring engineers have access to accurate and up\-to\-date project information while supporting daily administrative and technology\-related functions. This position is ideal for a recent high school graduate or someone beginning a career in administrative, data management, or technical support roles. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** **Data and Records Management** * Download files, records, reports, and project information from designated company systems. * Upload and organize data into engineering platforms for employee access. * Verify information for accuracy and completeness before transferring data. * Maintain organized electronic filing systems and digital records. * Track completed uploads and downloads to ensure proper recordkeeping. * Assist with document organization and data management projects. * Ensure confidentiality and security of company information. IT Support * Assist with setting up desktop and laptop computers for new employees. * Connect monitors, docking stations, keyboards, and other equipment. * Assist with inventory tracking of company computers and technology assets. * Help prepare equipment for employee onboarding and offboarding. * Provide basic administrative support to the IT department. **Administrative Support** * Report data discrepancies or technical issues to management. * Perform general office and administrative duties as assigned. **Qualifications** **Required** * High School Diploma or GED. * Basic computer skills, including Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, and Teams. * Strong attention to detail and organizational skills. * Ability to follow instructions and complete tasks accurately. * Strong verbal and written communication skills. * Ability to maintain confidentiality. Preferred * Previous office, administrative, customer service, or data entry experience. * Familiarity with electronic filing systems and document management. **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities** * Strong attention to detail and accuracy. * Basic technical aptitude and willingness to learn new software systems. * Effective organizational and time management skills. * Ability to work independently and as part of a team. * Positive attitude and strong customer service skills. * Ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast\-paced office environment. **Physical Requirements** * Ability to sit and work at a computer for extended periods. * Ability to occasionally lift and move equipment weighing up to 25 pounds. * Ability to work in an office environment during normal business hours. **Work Schedule** * Monday through Friday * 40 hours per week * In\-office position located in Alpharetta, Georgia **Compensation** * $16\.00 to $18\.00 per hour, based on qualifications and experience.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) - Applied AI
jobs.description: Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world. **Location** ------------ Hybrid work from Chicago, Atlanta, Nashville, Dallas, NY **About the job you're considering** ------------------------------------ At Capgemini, you will collaborate with cross\-functional teams to deliver innovative technology solutions that drive business value and enhance client experiences. You will contribute to the design, development, and continuous improvement of scalable, high\-quality solutions in a dynamic and collaborative environment. **Role Overview** ----------------- As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) in Applied AI, you are the 'Agent Engineer' and the primary driver for our customers' most critical AI initiatives. You take initial conversational prototypes and transform them into production\-ready solutions, owning the end\-to\-end engineering lifecycle, including the transition from 'Art of the Possible' to real\-world business value and scalable, secure AI systems. This is a high\-travel, high\-impact role focused on leading technical delivery for Conversational AI pilots and establishing the first Customer User Journeys (CUJs) for our largest customers at their sites. This role requires a deep understanding of: * Software Engineering * Machine Learning Operations (MLOps) * Cloud Infrastructure **Key Responsibilities** Conversational AI \& Agent Engineering * Serve as the lead developer for complex Conversational AI and CX applications, transitioning from rapid prototypes to production\-grade agentic workflows (e.g., multi\-agent systems, MCP servers) that drive measurable ROI. * Architect and code conversational flows that are not just functional, but optimized for the 'connective tissue' between Google's Conversational AI products and customers' live infrastructure, including APIs, legacy data silos, and security perimeters. Evaluation, Optimization \& Observability * Build high\-performance evaluation (Eval) pipelines and observability frameworks to optimize complex agentic workloads, focusing on reasoning loops, tool selection, and reducing latency while maintaining production\-grade security and networking. * Experience debugging Agent logic and optimizing tool selection, including tracing conversation IDs across microservices to identify and resolve failures in real\-time. Platform Integration \& Knowledge Systems * Experience connecting agents to enterprise knowledge bases and optimizing RAG chunking to prevent hallucinations. * Build solutions that interact with enterprise IT infrastructures and support external customer projects. Product Feedback \& Engineering Excellence * Identify repeatable field patterns and technical 'friction points' in Google's AAI stack, converting them into reusable modules or product feature requests for Engineering teams. * Co\-build with customer engineering teams to instill Google\-grade development best practices, ensuring long\-term project success and high end\-user adoption. Production Systems \& Customer Delivery * Track record of troubleshooting live, high\-traffic systems during critical windows. * Lead technical delivery for Conversational AI pilots and customer\-facing implementations. **Minimum Qualifications** -------------------------- **Education** * Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **Software Development** * 5 years of experience with software development using Python or similar coding languages. **Cloud \& Infrastructure** * Experience architecting AI systems on cloud platforms (e.g., GCP). * Experience deploying resources via Terraform or similar tools to automate the setup of agents, functions, or networking. **Application Development** * Experience building full\-stack applications that interact with enterprise IT infrastructures and developing external customer projects. **Preferred Qualifications** **Advanced Education** * Master's or PhD in AI, Computer Science, or a related technical field. **Agentic AI \& Multi\-Agent Systems** * Experience implementing multi\-agent systems using frameworks like ReAct and self\-reflection. **AI Optimization \& Debugging** * Experience debugging Agent logic and optimizing tool selection, including tracing conversation IDs across microservices to identify and resolve failures in real\-time. * Experience connecting agents to enterprise knowledge bases and optimizing RAG chunking to prevent hallucinations. **Production Support** * Track record of troubleshooting live, high\-traffic systems during critical windows. \#LI\-SS1 The base compensation range for this role in the posted location is $82,082 to $ ternal pay equity. It is not typical for candidates to be hired at or near the top of the posted compensation range. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for additional compensation such as variable incentives, bonuses, or commissions, depending on the position and applicable laws. **Capgemini offers a comprehensive, non\-negotiable benefits package to all regular, full\-time employees.** In the U.S. and Canada, available benefits are determined by local policy and eligibility and may include: * Paid time off based on employee grade (A\-F), defined by policy: Vacation: 12\-25 days, depending on grade, Company paid holidays, Personal Days, Sick Leave * Medical, dental, and vision coverage (or provincial healthcare coordination in Canada) * Retirement savings plans (e.g., 401(k) in the U.S., RRSP in Canada) * Life and disability insurance * Employee assistance programs * Other benefits as provided by local policy and eligibility **Important Notice:** Compensation (including bonuses, commissions, or other forms of incentive pay) is not considered earned, vested, or payable until it becomes due under the terms of applicable plans or agreements and is subject to Capgemini’s discretion, consistent with applicable laws. The Company reserves the right to amend or withdraw compensation programs at any time, within the limits of applicable legislation. **Disclaimers** Capgemini is an Equal Opportunity Employer encouraging inclusion in the workplace. Capgemini also participates in the Partnership Accreditation in Indigenous Relations (PAIR) program which supports meaningful engagement with Indigenous communities across Canada by promoting fairness, accessibility, inclusion and respect. We value the rich cultural heritage and contributions of Indigenous Peoples and actively work to create a welcoming and respectful environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, gender identity/expression, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, genetics, veteran status, marital status or any other characteristic protected by law. This is a general description of the Duties, Responsibilities and Qualifications required for this position. Physical, mental, sensory or environmental demands may be referenced in an attempt to communicate the manner in which this position traditionally is performed. Whenever necessary to provide individuals with disabilities an equal employment opportunity, Capgemini will consider reasonable accommodations that might involve varying job requirements and/or changing the way this job is performed, provided that such accommodation does not pose an undue hardship. Capgemini is committed to providing reasonable accommodation during our recruitment process. If you need assistance or accommodation, please reach out to your recruiting contact. Please be aware that Capgemini may capture your image (video or screenshot) during the interview process and that image may be used for verification, including during the hiring and onboarding process. Click the following link for more information on your rights as an Applicant in the United States. http://www.capgemini.com/resources/equal\-employment\-opportunity\-is\-the\-law Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55\-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end\-to\-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, generative AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Conversational AI & IVR
jobs.description: Philadelphia, PA, United States (On\-site) Contract (2 months 18 days) Published 5 hours ago stakeholder management crm integration UX/UI product management customer service skills Debugging Skills problem \- solving analytical skills kpi management * Comcast is seeking a Product Manager to lead the strategy, roadmap, and execution of conversational experiences across AI\-powered voice and digital platforms. This role starts with the customer—understanding where experiences break down, identifying unmet needs, and turning those insights into better products. The Product Manager will directly use customer feedback, conversation data, behavioral data, and journey analysis to improve self\-service experiences and reduce customer effort. * We’re looking for a Product Manager who likes to build, prototype, and experiment—using modern AI development tools to turn ideas into working concepts and accelerate product discovery. The ideal candidate is technically capable and comfortable with APIs, data, prompts, prototypes, debugging, and AI coding agents, without needing to be a production software engineer. This individual will partner closely with engineering, design, data science, operations, and customer experience teams to deliver scalable, measurable solutions. **Key Responsibilities:** Product Strategy \& Roadmap: * Define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for conversational and AI\-powered customer experience products. * Identify unmet customer needs and breakdowns across voice, chat, messaging, and self\-service journeys. * Turn customer feedback, conversation data, behavioral data, and journey analysis into product priorities and experiments. * Prioritize investments based on customer impact, business value, and measurable outcomes. Product Delivery \& Optimization: * Own the product lifecycle from discovery through launch and continuous improvement. * Develop business requirements and align teams around product objectives. * Partner with engineering, AI/ML, UX, conversation design, and operations teams to deliver high\-quality solutions. * Monitor product performance and optimize experiences using customer feedback, analytics, and business outcomes. * Use AI\-assisted development and prototyping tools to quickly explore ideas, build working proofs of concept, test assumptions, and collaborate more effectively with engineering and design. Conversational AI \& IVR Leadership: * Lead the evolution of conversational, messaging, virtual assistant, contact center, and AI\-powered customer experiences across voice and digital channels. * Improve automation, containment, and self\-service effectiveness while reducing customer effort. * Partner with AI and conversation design teams to enhance intent recognition, customer journeys, and service outcomes. * Manage integrations between conversational platforms and enterprise systems, including CRM, billing, support, and digital applications. * Stay current on emerging technologies, including Generative AI, large language models (LLMs), speech recognition, and conversational AI. Stakeholder Management * Build strong partnerships across business, technology, operations, customer experience, and leadership teams. * Present product strategy, roadmap updates, business cases, and performance results to stakeholders. * Align diverse teams around shared goals and measurable outcomes. **Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field. * 5\+ years of Product Management experience delivering customer\-facing digital products. * Experience owning products from concept through launch and ongoing optimization. * Experience with conversational, messaging, virtual assistant, contact center, or AI\-powered customer experience platforms across voice and/or digital channels. * Experience delivering conversational products across voice, chat, messaging, or other digital channels; experience spanning multiple channels is strongly preferred. * Experience managing or partnering on customer\-facing user experiences and interfaces. * Strong understanding of Agile product development methodologies. * Experience defining product requirements, roadmaps, KPIs, and success metrics. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills. * Proven ability to lead and influence cross\-functional teams. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience in telecommunications, broadband, media, customer service, or contact center technologies. * Experience with conversational AI and customer engagement platforms such as Google Dialogflow, Nuance, Genesys, Cognigy, Kore.ai, Amazon Lex, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI Services, or other conversational/customer engagement platforms. * Hands\-on experience with AI\-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Codex, or similar tools, with the ability to prototype or build lightweight applications and product experiences. * Experience with Generative AI, LLM\-powered experiences, prompt design, or AI orchestration frameworks. * Familiarity with NLP, NLU, speech technologies, and conversational design principles. * Experience improving IVR containment, self\-service adoption, and contact center experiences. * Knowledge of customer journey mapping, service design, experimentation, and product analytics. * Experience integrating conversational platforms with CRM and enterprise systems. * Familiarity with accessibility and inclusive design practices. **Success Profile:** The successful candidate will be: * Customer\-obsessed, with an expectation to stay close to customer needs, friction points, and outcomes. * A hands\-on builder who is comfortable getting into the product, experimenting with new technology, and creating prototypes rather than relying exclusively on engineering teams to explore ideas. * Data\-driven and comfortable using customer feedback, conversation data, behavioral data, journey analysis, and product analytics to make decisions. * Technically capable and comfortable working with APIs, data, prompts, prototypes, debugging, and AI coding agents. * A clear communicator who can bring business and technology partners together around customer outcomes. The pay range that the employer in good faith reasonably expects to pay for this position is $39\.30/hour \- $61\.40/hour. Our benefits include medical, dental, vision and retirement benefits. jobs.title: Senior UI/UX Developer - Computing Services
jobs.description: **Senior UI/UX Developer** to lead the design and front\-end implementation of intuitive, accessible, and responsive web applications. In this role, you will bridge the gap between user experience design and software engineering—transforming complex functional requirements into user\-centered interface designs while writing clean, modern front\-end code. You will serve as the champion for web accessibility (ADA/WCAG compliance), establish UI/UX best practices, and collaborate with cross\-functional development teams to deliver seamless digital experiences across the university. **Your core responsibilities will include:** * I/UX Design \& Architecture: Design intuitive user flows, wireframes, high\-fidelity prototypes, and design systems for enterprise web applications. * **Front\-End Development** : Translate UI/UX designs into production\-ready, performant front\-end code using modern JavaScript, HTML5, CSS/SASS, and relevant web frameworks. * **ADA \& Accessibility Compliance** : Lead accessibility audits, remediations, and testing to ensure all web applications comply with ADA standards and WCAG 2\.1 AA/AAA guidelines. * **Front\-End Testing \& QA** : Build and execute automated UI testing (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, Playwright) and integration tests to ensure cross\-browser compatibility and component reliability. * **Technical Estimation \& Scoping** : Evaluate UX/UI requirements, estimate implementation timelines, assess browser compatibility, and ensure interface designs integrate cleanly with backend services. * **Mentorship \& Design Standards** : Establish division\-wide UI/UX design patterns, mentor junior developers on accessibility and front\-end best practices, and maintain clear design documentation. * Other duties as assigned. Flexibility, excellence, and passion are vital qualities within Computing Services. Inclusion, collaboration, and cultural sensitivity are valued competencies at CMU. Therefore, we are in search of a team member who is able to effectively interact with a varied population of internal and external partners at a high level of integrity. We are looking for someone who shares our values and who will support the mission of the university through their work. **Qualifications:** * **Experience:** 5–7 years of professional experience in UI/UX design and modern front\-end web development. * **Front\-End Engineering** : Solid JavaScript expertise and experience navigating modern JavaScript build tools, package managers, and front\-end frameworks/ecosystems. * **ADA \& Accessibility (WCAG):** Demonstrated experience designing and coding for web accessibility, including ARIA roles, keyboard navigation, contrast compliance, and screen reader compatibility (e.g., NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver). * **Automated Web \& UI Testing** : Strong experience with automated web testing tools (e.g., Selenium, Cypress) and unit/component testing frameworks. * **UI Security \& Standards:** Good understanding of web application security as it impacts the front\-end (e.g., preventing XSS, safe state management, and secure form handling). * **Collaborative Leadership:** Proven track record of guiding UI/UX initiatives, collaborating closely with backend engineers and project leads, and documenting design systems/components. *A combination of education and relevant experience from which comparable knowledge is demonstrated may be considered.* **Preferred / Nice\-to\-Have Experience:** * **Full\-Stack Context** : Broad familiarity with Java application stacks (Spring Framework, Tomcat) or RESTful API integrations to collaborate effectively with backend developers. * **Database \& Data Integration** : Basic to solid understanding of SQL/Oracle or data pipelines to better design data\-dense dashboards and admin interfaces. * **AI Tooling in UX/Dev:** Recent exposure to AI\-assisted tools for design, prototyping, or front\-end code generation/testing. * **Environment \& Tools:** Comfort working in Linux\-based developer environments, using Git version control, and deploying containerized applications. * **Domain Context** : Prior experience designing accessible digital services within a Higher Education or public\-sector context. **Key Soft Skills:** * **User Empathy \& Advocacy** : Passion for advocating for diverse user groups, including users with disabilities, to create inclusive digital experiences. * **Visual \& Technical Communication:** Ability to articulate design decisions clearly to developers, product managers, and non\-technical university stakeholders. * **Problem\-Solving \& Detail Orientation** : Sharp eye for visual consistency, user friction points, micro\-interactions, and edge\-case behaviors. * **Adaptability \& Learning** : Drive to keep pace with evolving accessibility standards, modern front\-end frameworks, and emerging design technologies. **Requirements:** * jobs.title: Principal High-Speed Analog Circuit Design Engineer
jobs.description: **Principal High\-Speed Analog Circuit Design Engineer** **About the job** Are you an Analog Design Engineer, who is seeking an amazing opportunity delivering disruptive High Speed Interconnect Technology powering next generation AI? We are looking for an Analog Design Engineer – someone who is excited to join a fast\-growing Start\-Up Company growing a group of diverse individuals responsible for handling high\-speed mixed\-signal circuit designs! Candidate will have the opportunity to architect and design circuits for high\-performance transceivers and other critical analog functions. **What You Will Do** * High speed analog circuit design, such as high\-speed broadband amplifiers (VGA, CTLE, DRV, etc.) * Clock generation and distribution (VCOs, PLL, clock distribution, etc.) * Fundamental analog blocks (bandgap references, LDOs, temp sensors, etc.) * New techniques for the development of next generation optical transceiver * Design of custom passive components, from concept to silicon implementation * Supervise analog layouts within advanced process nodes * System verification and circuit design spec creation * Silicon bring\-up, debug and support * Team communication and documentation **What You Will Bring** * Master’s degree and/or PhD in Electrical Engineering or related fields with 5\+ years of experience * Should have strong analog design fundamentals and experience in designing analog circuit blocks for broadband amplification, clock generation and distribution, and/or fundamental analog blocks * Experience with analog design and verification tools (Virtuoso, Spectre, ADE, and post layout extraction tools) is a must * Experience in advance CMOS design and verification flows (tools to evaluate self\-heating, electromigration, safe operating area) * Experience with electromagnetic simulation tools (EMX, Momentum, HFSS or other) is a plus * Knowledge of the fundamentals on electromagnetism, lump models, and high frequency design * Good understanding of analog layouts in FinFET and its effect on high\-speed designs is a plus * Strong communication and documentation skills

jobs.title: Principal PLL Design Engineer
jobs.description: **Principal PLL Design Engineer** **About the job** Are you a PLL Design Engineer, who is seeking an amazing opportunity delivering disruptive High Speed Interconnect Technology to power next generation AI? We are looking for a High\-Speed CMOS PLL Analog Design Engineer –who is excited to join a fast\-growing Start\-Up Company with a key role for expert in clocking circuits for next generation optical transceivers, high\-speed SerDes, and ADC/DAC systems. Candidate will have the opportunity to architect and design PLLs for next generation transceivers. **What You Will Do** * Understand trade\-offs between different PLL topologies (e.g., integer\-N, fractional\-N, all\-digital/ADPLL) to meet specifications for power, area, jitter, and frequency range * Architect, design and simulate analog/mixed\-signal PLL building blocks (VCOs, charge pumps, dividers, PFDs, Loop Filters) at transistor level using tools like Cadence Virtuoso and Spectre * Address challenges in advanced node technologies, such as self\-heating, electromigration, voltage\-controlled oscillator (VCO) linearization and device\-level noise optimization * Supervise and verify layouts produced by layout engineers to ensure floorplanning, matching, and parasitic minimization using advanced node technologies * Be responsible for PLL bring up in the lab, conducting performance characterization using state\-of\-the\-art lab equipment * Conduct comprehensive system\-level simulations and validation for PLL integration into advanced transceiver technologies **What You Will Bring** * Master’s degree and/or PhD in Electrical Engineering or related fields with 5\+ years of relevant experience in PLL design, and production level tape\-out experience. * Must have extensive experience with advanced node technologies (16nm/12nm, 7nm, 5nm, 3nm, 2nm processes) * Deep understanding of phase noise analysis, VCO design, LDOs and supporting circuitry associated with PLLs * Proficient in cadence virtuoso, electromagnetic simulator (e.g., EMX/HFSS), and MATLAB for system\-level modelling * Strong communication and documentation skills **Annual Base Salary Range**: $2000,000 \- $300,000 (The final offer will be determined based on job\-related skills, experience, qualifications, and location.)

jobs.description: **Principal SerDes Design Engineer** **About the job** We are looking for a SerDes Lead Designer, who is seeking an amazing opportunity delivering disruptive High Speed Interconnect Technology to power next generation AI. Candidate will have the opportunity to architect and design SerDes for next generation transceivers. **What You Will Do** * Define architecture, specifications, and circuit topologies for next\-generation SerDes * Overview development of system\-level modelling, with behavioral models (e.g., MATLAB, SystemVerilog, Verilog\-A) to analyze link budgets, equalization strategies and jitter budgeting * Design high\-performance analog/mixed\-signal circuits in advanced node technologies * Develop and overview the design of critical blocks including RX/TX equalization (CTLE, DFE), High\-speed PLLs, Phase interpolators, DLLs, TDCs * Implement digitally assisted analog circuits, background calibration, and adaptive loops to improve Power, Performance, Area * Oversee physical layout to minimize parasitics, device stress, electromigration and process variation impacts * Overview of the analysis of Signal Integrity and Power Integrity to achieve system\-defined targets * Lead lab validation, debugging and characterization of SerDes IPs within our state\-of\-the\-art lab * Correlate silicon measurements with simulated data, and lead performance optimization in the system environment **What You Will Bring** * Master’s degree and/or PhD in Electrical Engineering or related fields with 10\+ years of relevant experience in SerDes design * Proven record of taking high\-speed SerDes design to tape\-out and volume production * Experience in lab bring\-up, characterization, and debugging designs that reach out production * Must have extensive experience with advanced node technologies (16nm/12nm, 7nm, 5nm, 3nm, 2nm processes) * Prior experience in cross\-functional interaction to deliver IP and ensuring seamless integration in SOCs * Strong communication and documentation skills **Annual Base Salary Range**: $200,000 \- $300,000 (The final offer will be determined based on job\-related skills, experience, qualifications, and location.)

Job Requirements * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * An advanced degree in directly applicable area of study may substitute for up to two (2\) years of experience. * iOS engineer must have native experience in Swift (7\+ years) * Android engineers must have native experience with Kotlin (7\+ years) * Experience writing unit tests * Experience working in larger team environment * Experience working with Git for source control * Experience leading architectural and process changes * Experience in creating technical documentation * Deep understanding of Agile methodologies and Scrum * Experience performing technical interviews * Expertise of UI patterns such as model\-view\-controller (MVC) and model\-view\-view model (MVVM) is required * Expertise in RESTful services and the JSON file format. * Ability to work on multiple projects in a fast\-paced work environment. * Ability to work independently as well as part of a team. * Ability to lead junior and senior engineers on projects of high complexity. * Ability to recognize issues in existing software and put together improvement plans. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. * Excellent communication skills and the ability to work cross functionally with back end and quality engineers. * Strong ability to interface with Product Owners and Scrum Masters for ticket/issue management. * Strong ability to estimate work, support project plan creation, and report out progress to functional management at a platform level. * Understanding of CI/CD (continuous integration/continuous delivery) tools, frameworks and deployment processes. * Experience defining process improvements and implementing change Preferred Job Requirements: * Mobile development bootcamp, organized training, or certifications. * Ability to lead changes on a mobile platform that is not their expertise (e.g. experience is iOS, but could help lead Android devs). \#LI\-LN1 \#LI\-REMOTE The pay range for this position is $126,198\.00 \- $215,291\.00; base pay offered may vary depending on a number of factors including, but not limited to, the position offered, jobs.title: Structural Project Manager
jobs.description: Colliers Engineering \& Design is currently seeking a Structural Project Manager to join our Structural Engineering team in our Austin, TX office. From industrial design to multifamily, Colliers Engineering \& Design engineers will ensure your project meets today’s safety standards as well as your functional requirements. Our structural engineers are able to design the structural systems for buildings, foundations, and earth retention for all types of new construction, additions, adaptive reuse, and renovations. Our engineers have the knowledge and experience to design projects utilizing steel framing, conventional and pt concrete, mass timber, conventional wood framing, light gauge, and masonry. Project Managers are responsible for the project schedule and meeting project budgets in addition to engineering duties. Project Managers will assign tasks and deadlines to Project Engineers and Graduate Engineers while maintaining oversight of the progress. Project Managers may act as Project Engineer, especially on smaller projects. Project Manager will be in contact with the client to ensure knowledge of the schedule, major design coordination issues, and any construction administration challenges. By developing strong connections with our clients, Colliers Engineering \& Design engineers ensure our designs meet project goals. Our projects include new buildings, renovations and re\-purposing. Streamlined coordination with other in\-house services will facilitate an efficient approach and complete engineering package that spans all phases of structural design and construction. This includes feasibility studies, scope and condition assessment, code compliance review, static/dynamic load analyses, drawing preparation, bidding services, and construction administration. * Provide primary point of contact for Principals and design team including Architect and General Contractor. Attend project meetings with Architects and other design professionals, Owners, and Contractors. * Manage project schedule, activities, and budget. * Work with Structural Director to manage client accounts and maintain continuity of service. * Identify when scope of work is exceeded and notify client. Summarize project status and communicate additional service requests to Structural Director. * Communicate with Structural Director when milestones are completed and project schedules are updated Invoice work as milestones are completed. * Review time and cost for projects both complete and in process. * Maintain project phases within accounting software: create projects \& all associated phases by utilizing administrative staff, verify all project fees for phases, etc. * Identify un\-billed time and determine which invoice the time should be associated with or identify added scope and coordinate with the Structural Director and client to bill for the un\-billed time on a monthly basis. * Maintain CA billing on a monthly basis by reviewing the progress of each project under construction with internal resources. * Supervise and manage the work of Project Engineers, Graduate Engineers, and Interns. Develop specific tasks for resource allocation with review and follow up. Anticipate and provide guidance where unconventional conditions exist. * Coordinate with technical staff to employ internal drawings templates for new projects. * Ensure all calculations and details are in accordance with relevant codes (IBC, ASCE\-7, ACI, AISC, NDS, AISI, etc) based on project\-specific jurisdiction. * Review structural drawings for foundation and framing layout, coordination with Architectural drawings and inclusion of standard notes and details. Ensure structural drawings meet internal standards. * Review drawing packages prepared by Project Engineers and make adjustments as needed to ensure quality of product and meet client expectations. * Act as Project Engineer as required to develop familiarity with internal standards and for complex projects or projects located in high seismic or hurricane prone regions. * Edit and compile relevant specification sections addressing structural items. Coordinate with Architect on sections and format. * Manage all construction administration tasks including submittals, shop drawings, RFIs and review of testing reports. * 10\+ years of experience required in building structural design * P.E. required. * Should have relevant continuing education courses showing annual advancement of career. * Possess an intermediate to advanced understanding of structural design software such RISA, RAM, TEKLA, TEDDS, SAFE, PROFIS, etc. with a willingness to learn and adapt to new software. * A willingness to learn and adapt to new software and client needs. * Understanding of steel, concrete, masonry, and wood design principles. * Light gauge experience is preferred. * Knowledge of current building and material design codes and standards such as IBC, ASCE7, AISC360, ACI318, ACI 530 or NDS. * Strong Microsoft Office skills. * Able to work independently and also collaboratively on a team. * Strong communication skills. * Ability to read, write and understand English for purposes of comprehending written job\-related communications and verbal instructions and interactions.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Technical
jobs.description: Description: Deep Sync is the industry leader in deterministic identity and AI\-powered data solutions. Leveraging our 35\-year foundation of compiling direct mail\-grade datasets, Deep Sync develops data\-first technologies that power marketing, measurement, AI, and business intelligence for agencies and brands with our fully deterministic identity graph, privacy\-first audiences, comprehensive data solutions, and integrations with leading platforms and cloud providers. **Position Overview** Marketing depends on identifying the audience correctly. Deep Sync supplies the identity data that makes that possible, across offline and online channels, in both consumer and business marketing. You will own the product surface on which a customer selects an audience, purchases it, and delivers it into the channel where the campaign runs, built on the platform now under development. The role also covers new product development: taking an idea from a hypothesis to a paid offering, and discontinuing the ones that do not justify further investment. The products we build have to be ready for an AI first world. Customers increasingly reach data through agents and natural language rather than through a screen, which means what we ship has to serve a machine as readily as a person. The position calls for a senior product manager fluent in advertising and in data, and equally at ease with AI. You should already understand what a match rate is worth to a buyer, the limits of lookalike modelling, and why one individual appears as separate records in separate systems, you should be able to go into the data and verify such questions yourself, and you should be building with current AI tools rather than reading about them. We run a flat organisation and a fast product development cadence. The position is based in Kirkland, WA. **Key Responsibilities** **Product ownership and delivery** * **Surface ownership.** Own an area of the product from the problem through to the outcome: the case for doing the work, the requirements engineering builds from, and the usage it shows six months after release. * **Requirements and written decisions.** We work in documents. A requirements document states the problem, the decision taken, what is in scope and what is not, and how success will be measured. Presentations are for reporting, not for deciding. * **Scope discipline.** A rebuild invites reproducing every feature that exists today. Establish what is actually used, make the case for retiring the rest, and hold that position in review. * **Release management.** Select the customers who receive each release first, define the test that closes a milestone, and report the result as it stands. * New product development * **Opportunity identification.** Attributes that have never been packaged, audiences that have never been priced, and questions customers are currently paying somebody else to answer. * **Early validation.** A test with two or three customers, a measure agreed in advance, and a short written finding. Evidence before a long build rather than after it. * **Applied AI.** Determine where a model or an agent belongs in the product and where it does not, specify how its output will be evaluated, and demonstrate the idea with a working prototype rather than a description of one. Design for consumption by machines as well as by people: predictable interfaces, described data, and output that a system downstream can act on without a person in between. * **Progression or discontinuation.** Both are acceptable outcomes. An idea that remains a proposal for three quarters is not. **Market and commercial** * **Customer contact.** The sales, delivery and client facing teams hold most of the knowledge about what fails, and customers hold the rest. Time spent with them is part of the role. * **Consumer and business marketing.** The two buy different things for different reasons, and both are Deep Sync customers. Understand what each is measured on. * **Revenue alignment.** Which audiences sell, which attributes do not, and what a customer pays for rather than merely tolerates. Work with product marketing on how the result is presented to the market. * **Delivery destinations.** The Trade Desk, DV360, Meta, Amazon, TikTok, LiveRamp, the Snowflake and Databricks marketplaces, and the offline channels. Determine which integrations are worth maintaining, and what each has to do before a customer regards it as complete. **Data** * **Verification.** Match rates, coverage by attribute, record counts, and the cost of a source against the revenue attributed to it. No analyst is attached to this role, so write the query yourself. * **Working with the data owners.** Identity resolution, the attribute taxonomy and modelling belong to other teams. You are their customer, and you specify what the market requires of them. Requirements: * **AdTech or MarTech product experience. Required.** You have built and released product within an advertising or marketing tech e effect of an identifier being withdrawn, and the constraints privacy regulation places on all of it. * **Exposure to both consumer and business marketing**, or a demonstrated understanding of how the second differs from the first. * **Sound judgement at speed.** The cadence here is fast, which is not a licence to guess. Assess the options, state the trade off, choose, and be able to explain what would change the decision. A decision taken in a day on seventy percent of the information, and revised when the remainder arrives, is worth more than a month spent reaching certainty. * **A product taken from proposal to paying customer.** A new product, a new line, or a feature nobody requested that proved to matter. Be ready to describe how it was tested before it was built. * **Data fluency without being a data engineer.** Strong SQL, familiarity with Snowflake, Databricks or an S3 and Parquet data lake, and the ability to validate coverage and match rates before a figure is published. * **AI fluency. Required.** What we build has to work in an AI first world, consumed by agents as readily as by people, so this is not a preference. You use current AI tools in your own work, for analysis, prototyping and writing. You can judge where a model or an agent belongs in a product and where it does not. And you understand what a model changes about a requirement: how its output is evaluated, how it fails, and what the underlying data has to look like for it to work at all. * **Written clarity.** Plain sentences, a stated position, visible reasoning. A writing sample will be requested and read closely. * **A record of stopping work.** A feature, a roadmap item or a project already under way. Be ready to describe what it cost and how the decision was carried. * **Distributed working.** Part of engineering is based in India. Most collaboration is written, and it succeeds only when the writing carries the detail. **Experience** * At least four years in product management, of which at least three in AdTech, MarTech or a data as a service business. * Software or data sold to other businesses, serving consumer and business marketing. * A record of releasing into a platform that already carried customers, and of starting something that did not previously exist. * Practical use of machine learning or generative AI, either in a product you released or in the way you do the work. * Bachelor degree or equivalent practical experience. No certification required. * Advantageous and not required: direct mail or other offline channels, data distributed through the Snowflake or Databricks marketplaces, clean rooms, or a company built by acquisition. **Location:** Kirkland, WA. This role requires an in\-office presence five days a week with remote flexibility. **Compensation \& Benefits** * Compensation: $155,000\-$185,000 annually, commensurate with experience, and qualifications. * Flexible Time Off (FTO) and Company Holidays * Medical, Dental, Vision, and Health Savings Account (HSA) benefits * 401(k) with Company Match * Company\-Paid Life and AD\&D Insurance * Short\-Term and Long\-Term Disability Insurance * Voluntary Life \& AD\&D Insurance * Critical Illness and Accident Insurance **Work Authorization:** *Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S.* **Equal Opportunity Employer***: Deep Sync provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.* **Please Contact:** Recruiting \| recruiting@deepsync.com

Your expertise will help ensure our clients’ technology environments are secure, efficient, and scalable. This person should be skillful at pre\-project/work\-briefings with each client on each project. Always think about the tools we have before asking another team member; (i.e. IT Glue, Meraki, etc.).
