jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description: Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser\-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A — the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry — we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies. Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game\-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally. **Your Role** ------------- Focused Energy is looking for a Principal Software Engineer to define and own the Core Software architecture that will operate and integrate our fusion power plant. Sitting within the Software Department and reporting to the Head of Software, this is a foundational technical role: you will set the direction for how controls, hardware interfaces, calibration systems, data infrastructure, and human\-machine interfaces come together into one coherent system. You will design and implement critical parts of the Core Software stack, stand up reliable automated calibration workflows, and set the engineering standards the rest of the department will build on. This is a rare opportunity to shape the software backbone of a fusion power plant and operate as a technical lead within the Software Department. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Define and maintain the end\-to\-end Core Software architecture for the fusion power plant, including device interfaces, calibration, data handling, data storage, and HMI. * Design and implement critical parts of the Core Software system using languages such as C\+\+ and Python. * Define clear interfaces between software, control hardware, diagnostics, plant equipment, data systems, and operator tools. * Design reliable automated calibration facilities and workflows that produce traceable and repeatable results. * Set practical standards for architecture, coding, testing, observability, documentation, release, reliability, security, and fault tolerance. * Lead technical decisions across teams, mentor engineers, resolve difficult trade\-offs, and grow into a lead within the Software Department. **Who You Are** --------------- ### **Must\-Haves** * Extensive experience designing and implementing control software for complex physical or industrial systems. * Extensive experience with hardware and software interfaces, including device integration and system\-level troubleshooting. * Experience designing and implementing automated calibration facilities or automated calibration workflows. * Strong experience with data handling, data pipelines, metadata, and reliable data storage. * Experience designing and implementing HMI for operators or technical users. * Strong software design and implementation skills in C\+\+, Python, or similar languages. * Ability to define architecture for complex, mission\-critical systems under changing requirements and strict physical constraints. * Strong communication skills — you can explain technical decisions, risks, and trade\-offs to software, hardware, science, and operations stakeholders. * Strong leadership skills — you can guide decisions, mentor engineers, build alignment, and take ownership without relying on formal authority. * Experience applying thorough testing, observability, reliability, fault tolerance, security, and documentation practices. ### **Nice\-to\-Haves** * Experience with software for plasma, nuclear power, high\-energy physics, or scientific facilities. * Experience with real\-time or distributed control systems and high\-throughput data acquisition. * Experience defining shared frameworks, API conventions, configuration management, or communication systems for multiple teams. * Experience writing architecture decision records or technical proposals and leading architecture reviews. * Experience growing into a department\-level technical lead or coaching senior engineers. * Fluency with AI\-assisted software development, or strong enthusiasm for using approved AI tools responsibly to improve quality and delivery. **What We Offer** ----------------- * Innovative Technology \& Mission: Be part of a cutting\-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery. * Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you'll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career. * Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top\-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges. * Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company. * Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together. * Medical, Dental, Vision: Multiple great plans to pick from that are active come the 1st Day of employment for you and any enrolled dependents. * Vacation Days: We support your work\-life\-balance by granting you Unlimited PTO. * Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. * Retirement Plan: If you decide to enroll in our 401k plan, we will match up to 4% on top of the employee contribution. * Equipment: We offer state\-of\-the\-art Windows or Apple Laptops. In addition, you will receive a keyboard, mouse and headset so you are fully equipped from day 1\. * Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace. Focused Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Focused Energy will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, benefits.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer - Dec 2026 & May 2027 Graduates
jobs.description: **About Formlabs:** Do you want to change how the world creates? At Formlabs, we're building the tools that make it possible for anyone to bring their ideas to life, from cutting\-edge products to life\-saving medical devices. Our 3D printing technology powers innovation at more than 50,000 industry leaders worldwide, including Apple, Google, Tesla, New Balance, and NASA. Together, we're helping everyone design, prototype, and manufacture faster than ever before. We're a team of hands\-on builders, engineers, and innovators reinventing how the world makes physical things. If you're ready to shape the future of fabrication, come build it with us. Electrical engineering at Formlabs bridges the gap between the analog and digital worlds. If you love to design and build boards from the ground up, develop firmware to control complex electromechanical systems, and produce elegant solutions to real\-world problems, we want you as an **Electrical Engineer.** **You are highly encouraged to share an example of your work that demonstrates your skills and experience.** **The Job:** * Design and build prototypes and production electronic systems, including circuit design, PCB layout, embedded firmware development, bring up and validation Own projects, not skills * \- this role is for a "full\-stack" engineer with a focus on shipping products, not a specialist in any one area of electronics engineering Go beyond the board * \- be responsible for the design of subsystems such as sensors, actuators, and optoelectronics that require tradeoffs between electrical and mechanical requirements * Back up your design decisions with data gathered through simulations and experiments * Hone your skills and grow: engineers at Formlabs have grown into deep technical experts, system architects, product technical leads, and team leaders / managers. We support talented people growing in any direction. **You:** * Have a minimum of 2 years of experience designing and debugging electronics that have gone into products * Are an electrical engineering generalist, comfortable with analog and digital design, PCB layout, validation, and debugging techniques Are comfortable working with electronics that interact with the physical world * \- our most complex problems tend to involve the integration of electronics, mechanical designs, and software. * Are hands\-on and interested in supporting your designs throughout the product life cycle, from early research to debugging field failures **Bonus Skills:** * Familiarity with embedded software development, for example: microcontroller firmware developed in C or C\+\+, device drivers or board support packages for embedded Linux systems, or C\+\+ application development. Hardware design is a core part of our team's responsibilities, but we also extend into low\-level software development when knowledge of the physical system is key to writing the best code. **Our Benefits \& Perks:** * Robust equity program to build future wealth through RSUs * Comprehensive healthcare coverage (Medical, Dental, Vision) * 401K matching and access to financial advisors * Generous paid Parental Leave (up to 16 weeks) * Tenure\-based paid Sabbatical Leave (up to 6 weeks) * Flexible Out of Office Plan – Take time when you need it * Ample on\-site parking \& pre\-tax commuter benefits * Healthy on\-site lunches, snacks, beverages, \& treats * Regular sponsored professional development opportunities * Many opt\-in culture events across our diverse community * And of course… unlimited 3D prints *We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.* **Even if you don't check every box, but see yourself contributing, please apply.** Help us build an inclusive community that will change the face of 3D printing.

jobs.title: District Engineer
jobs.description: **General Purpose:** The District Engineer is responsible for assisting in the overall operation of the Fort Collins\-Loveland Water District (FCLWD, the District) by providing technical knowledge and assistance to staff in the design of utilities that meet customer needs. The position performs professional engineering work in the planning, design, construction, operation and maintenance of the District’s water distribution and transmission systems. Reports directly to the General Manager. **Essential functions:** * Establishes and maintains Master Plans; Evaluates the District’s ability to provide water service to all current and future customers; reviews submitted engineering designs for conformance with adopted District master plans, District criteria and accepted industry standards and practices; evaluates economic feasibility of repairs and replacements. * Ensures the District’s design and construction standards comply with applicable state and federal health department regulations applicable to water facilities. * Performs Engineering/Operations reviews including designs for proposed development and capital construction within the District’s service area as they relate to water utilities including tracking, routing, and meeting deadlines. * Ensures staff adheres to the District’s personnel policy manual and safety standards. * Directs department staff in limited design work for small construction projects as required. * Manages the Water Capital Improvement Programs (CIP) including budget preparation, consultant selection, design management, permitting, coordination with other District departments, plans and specifications, bidding, construction management, and budget oversight for the District’s capital improvement plan. * Interacts with Operations Superintendents, Controller and Deputy General Manager to coordinate operations and staff functions. * Manages computer models of the water distribution system, including water demand analysis and hydraulic model maintenance, administering water system pressure, fire flow and capacity requests. * Meets and confers with developers, consultants, contractors, District employees and the general public regarding engineering and development requirements. Oversees the construction inspection process and staff. * Administers inclusion petitions, reimbursement and oversizing agreements and facilitates other developer and annexation agreements as required with administrative staff support. * Other duties as required and necessary to ensure the success of the organization. ***Supervisory duties:*** * Directly manages the department’s Administrative Support, Geographic Information Systems (GIS), Development Review Engineering (CEIII), Capital Projects Engineering (CEIII) staff and indirectly manages Computer Aided Drafting (CAD), Construction Project Management and Field Inspection staff, in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training employees, planning, assigning and directing work including goal and direction setting, appraising performance, rewarding and disciplining employees, addressing complaints and resolving problems. ***Economic responsibility:*** * Manages the District’s funds in an accountable and business\-like manner, ensuring that costs are consistently reviewed and contained, including ensuring all tools, equipment, clothing allowances, transportation reimbursements and travel costs are maintained and within District guidelines. * Manages staff time, including on call, overtime, and compensatory time in an economically efficient manner. ***Knowledge, skills and abilities:*** * Ability to consistently promote, support, work, and act with an expectation of agency in a manner in support of the District’s mission, vision and values. * Thorough understanding of the design and construction of water systems. * Knowledge and experience in budgeting, design, administration, and construction management of water utility infrastructure. * Ability to use computer software packages including project management, Excel, Word, Outlook, hydraulic modeling programs. * Ability to interact positively with a wide variety of people. * Ability to independently solve complex problems, provide accurate and error\-free work under pressure and meet reasonable deadlines. * Ability and maturity to perform assigned tasks unsupervised throughout an eight (8\) hour day. * Superior written and oral communication skills. ***Additional Requirements/Licenses/Certifications:*** * A current Professional Engineer (PE) from the State of Colorado or ability to transfer license from another State is required. * Must have reliable transportation. * Must have a valid driver’s license. ***Material and equipment directly used:*** * Telephone, cell phone, pickup truck, printer, 2\-way radio, calculator, computer equipment and software including project management, ArcGIS, Sequel database, AutoCAD, advanced Excel, Word, Outlook, and hydraulic modeling programs. ***Physical Activities:*** *The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.* * Ability to stand, sit, walk, walk on unpaved terrain, talk, reach with arms and hands, have good manual dexterity, use hands and fingers to operate a computer and telephone keyboard, handle or feel, hear alarms/telephones/normal speaking voice. * Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus. * Moderate physical activity required by moving and positioning objects up to 50 pounds occasionally and/or up to 20 pounds frequently. **Education:** * Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Sanitary Engineering, Water Resource Engineering, or closely related field is required. **Experience:** * A minimum of eight (8\) years of responsible engineer experience including design of water and wastewater systems is required. * At least three (3\) years of previous management or supervisory experience is required. * An equivalent combination of education and experience may be substituted on a year for year basis. **Working environment:** *The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job.* * Work is generally performed in an indoor professional office environment. * Occasional outdoor work in extreme weather conditions (hot/cold); walking on uneven terrain; occasional exposure to insects. * Travel to conferences, meetings and branch locations on a regular basis is necessary. *Passing pre\-employment screening will be required prior to the start of employment.* **Benefits:** * We offer a competitive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, and HSA and retirement benefits with District match. Find out more by visiting our website: https://fclwd.com/who\-we\-are/careers/ Job Type: Full\-time Pay: $150,369\.80 \- $222,443\.31 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Employee assistance program * Flexible spending account * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Retirement plan * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: *At FourKites we have the opportunity to tackle complex challenges with real\-world impacts. Whether it's medical supplies from Cardinal Health or groceries for Walmart, the FourKites platform helps customers operate global supply chains that are efficient, agile and sustainable.* *Join a team of curious problem solvers that celebrates differences, leads with empathy and values inclusivity.* As a **Senior AI Engineer**, you'll join a team focused on data integrations (shippers and carriers moving in and out of the FourKites ecosystem) and our active AI agent workstreams — including a support automation agent handling 60\-70% of customer tickets, a voice agent that calls carriers to gather and update information, and an end\-to\-end carrier onboarding agent (email \+ voice). You'll work on features end to end (\~75\-80% backend, \~20\-25% frontend) using Python, Java/GoLang, agentic frameworks like LangGraph, React, Redis and PostgreSQL. You'll develop products that change the logistics landscape for some of the biggest corporations in the world, and work closely with our US team and customers to shape the future of the industry. **What you'll be doing:** * Design, build, and productionize AI agents/workflows (e.g., support automation, voice, and onboarding agents) using agentic frameworks such as LangGraph * Develop, test, and maintain backend applications in Python and Java or GoLang * Write clean, efficient, and well\-documented code across the full SDLC — development, QA, and release * Design and implement data models and database schemas * Collaborate with the frontend team to integrate the backend with the user interface * Perform code reviews and ensure code quality standards are met * Troubleshoot and debug applications, including AI agent workflows in production * Work with the DevOps team to deploy and manage applications in production (Kubernetes) * Continuously learn and stay up to date with new technologies and industry trends, particularly in the AI/agentic space **About the team:** Our product and engineering teams are dedicated to providing the industry's best\-in\-class end\-to\-end supply chain visibility platform. This team owns data integrations across our shipper/carrier ecosystem and is actively building out FourKites' AI agent capabilities. We are committed to building a high\-performing team with software craftsman\-thinking, dedicated to developing and enhancing our core platform — and we want you to be a central part of it! **Who you are:** * 5\+ years of experience as a Backend/Software Developer, with hands\-on exposure to AI/agentic systems (deep AI expertise not required, but you should be comfortable in the ecosystem) * **Python** — mandatory * **Java or GoLang** — proficiency in at least one * Hands\-on experience (2\+ years) with **LangGraph or similar agentic frameworks** * Strong understanding of object\-oriented programming principles * Experience with databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, or MongoDB * Familiarity with front\-end technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React * Good knowledge of RESTful APIs and microservices architecture * Working knowledge of Kubernetes * Full Agile SDLC experience — development, QA, and release * Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills * Ability to work independently and in a team environment * Strong knowledge of Git (branches, submodules, rebasing) and Agile tools such as JIRA and Confluence * Experience with Amazon Web Services or other cloud services is a plus * Excellent oral and written communication skills **Who we are:** *FourKites, the leader in AI\-driven supply chain transformation for global enterprises and pioneer of real\-time visibility, turns supply chain data into automated action. FourKites Intelligent Control Tower® breaks down enterprise silos by creating a real\-time digital twin of orders, shipments, inventory and assets. This comprehensive view, combined with AI\-powered digital workers, enables companies to prevent disruptions, automate routine tasks and optimize performance across their supply chain. FourKites processes over 3\.2 million supply chain events daily — from purchase orders to final delivery — helping 1,600\-plus global brands prevent disruptions, make faster decisions and move from reactive tracking to proactive supply chain orchestration. For more information, visit www.fourkites.com.* FourKites provides competitive compensation with stock options, outstanding benefits and a collaborative culture for all employees around the globe. To help you be your best, we have 5 global recharge days, in addition to generous PTO and standard holidays. Parental leave for all parents, an annual wellness stipend and volunteer days also provide you with time and resources for self care and to care for others. Throughout the year, FourKites sets aside time during the workday to learn and celebrate diversity. We're always listening for new ways to support everyone in and out of the office. **Compensation:** The expected annual base salary range for this role is $140,000 \- $180,000\. Actual compensation will be determined based on several factors, including but not limited to experience, qualifications, skills, and business needs. In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for bonus and incentive compensation as well as participation in FourKites' employee stock option program. **Benefits:** FourKites provides competitive compensation with stock options, outstanding benefits and a collaborative culture for all employees around the globe. To help you be your best, we have 5 global recharge days, in addition to generous PTO and standard holidays. Parental leave for all parents, an annual wellness stipend and volunteer days also provide you with time and resources for self care and to care for others. Throughout the year, FourKites sets aside time during the workday to learn and celebrate diversity. We're always listening for new ways to support everyone in and out of the office. Benefits include: * Medical, Dental \& Vision benefits starting on first day of employment * 401k Retirement savings with employer match * Bonus and incentive compensation as well as employee stock option program * Employer paid life insurance and short term disability insurance * Generous PTO, global recharge days, and volunteer days * Paid parental leave for all parents * Family planning and inclusive wellbeing resources * Technology reimbursement * Commuter benefits for in\-office employees (Chicago) * Annual Wellness Stipend * Ongoing learning \& development opportunities

We are committed to building a high\-performing team with software craftsman\-thinking, dedicated to developing and enhancing our core platform — and we want you to be a central part of it! **Who you are:** * 5\+ years of experience as a Backend/Software Developer, with hands\-on exposure to AI/agentic systems (deep AI expertise not required, but you should be comfortable in the ecosystem) * **Python** — mandatory * **Java or GoLang** — proficiency in at least one * Hands\-on experience (2\+ years) with **LangGraph or similar agentic frameworks** * Strong understanding of object\-oriented programming principles * Experience with databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, or MongoDB * Familiarity with front\-end technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React * Good knowledge of RESTful APIs and microservices architecture * Working knowledge of Kubernetes * Full Agile SDLC experience — development, QA, and release * Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills * Ability to work independently and in a team environment * Strong knowledge of Git (branches, submodules, rebasing) and Agile tools such as JIRA and Confluence * Experience with Amazon Web Services or other cloud services is a plus * Excellent oral and written communication skills **Who we are:** *FourKites, the leader in AI\-driven supply chain transformation for global enterprises and pioneer of real\-time visibility, turns supply chain data into automated action. FourKites processes over 3\.2 million supply chain events daily — from purchase orders to final delivery — helping 1,600\-plus global brands prevent disruptions, make faster decisions and move from reactive tracking to proactive supply chain orchestration. For more information, visit www.fourkites.com.* FourKites provides competitive compensation with stock options, outstanding benefits and a collaborative culture for all employees around the globe. jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: Fragment is the AI platform that autonomously acts to streamline procurement workflows end to end. Within a few months of launch, we signed Fortune 500 companies. Within a year of founding, our customers, all $1B\+ revenue enterprises, continue to grow in number and are actively championing us to their networks, and our marketing and CAC to get here has been $0\. We're hiring Software Engineers to help build the systems that make this possible. Our team comes from enterprise AI and manufacturing and has been shipping agents in production environments since the beginning. We need engineers who want to own what they build. **Company Highlights** * **The Team:** Our CEO previously led and scaled three of Zoom's products past $300M in revenue, and our CTO is an ex\-AI researcher who has spent his entire career in enterprise AI, leading engineering teams from seed through Series C. The broader team includes repeat VC\-backed founders, Caltech PhDs, former quants, chess masters, Six Sigma Master Black Belts, and one very enthusiastic Bonsai grower. * **Product:** We pride ourselves on our depth of our experience building agents, and on our continued diligence in leveraging the latest technology. We hold a high bar of excellence that starts with the founding team. * **Hypergrowth:** 30x revenue growth in the first half of this year, with the majority of our pipeline coming from customer references. **Background** Deploying truly impactful AI Agents today requires teams of forward\-deployed engineers, months of ontology design, hundreds of ad\-hoc integrations, and thousands of lines of glue code. It’s slow, expensive, brittle, and impossible to scale. Fragment eliminates all of that. We’ve built a platform where: * Ontology Agents autonomously construct the context layer, unifying structured \+ unstructured data, capturing tribal knowledge, and composing it all into a real\-time ontology of the business. * Self\-assembling Process Agents automate workflows that would normally be manually and tediously handled by BPOs. Our first suite of agentic workflows, which drove our early traction, targets procurement. Our product sits in the \#1 budget priority for traditional enterprises right now: AI that streamlines labor, and actually works in production. **What You'll Do** You will design and own systems that don’t exist yet \- the foundational architecture for AI Agents operating over complex enterprise data. For example: * Build a distributed agent pipeline that processes tens of millions of data points with deterministic, auditable, and multi\-tenant\-safe behavior * Define and develop an automation editor that takes a visual\-text hybrid approach to workflow development. Enable dynamic, configurable design that autonomously adapts to the processes of a customer. * Engineer graph traversal \+ indexing systems enabling fast, lossless reasoning over our Unified Data Interface (UDI) and arbitrary data systems. * Define the core framework for self\-assembling agents that compose and execute workflows autonomously \- safely, predictably, and with full traceability This is not a “feature team” role. This is **foundational engineering**, shaping the platform that every agent and every enterprise workflow will rely on. **Who You Are** We’re looking for a high\-slope generalist with 3\-7\+ years of experience who gets restless when they're not building things that matter. You might describe yourself as someone who: * Learns ridiculously fast * Thrives in ambiguity * Thinks in systems, not tickets * Ships high quality work quickly * Gets excited by messy enterprise data and hard problems * Wants to own architecture, product, and customer impact * Has seen high quality production code across the stack **Interested?** Reach out even if you’re not sure you’re a perfect fit. High\-slope engineers rarely fit cleanly on paper. Compensation Range: $200K \- $350K

jobs.description: GE Vernova is embracing cutting\-edge technologies to streamline operations, improve customer experiences, and drive growth. We are seeking a highly motivated and talented AI Engineer to join our dynamic team. This position offers a great opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced technology and traditional industry, making a tangible impact on our business processes. We are driving strategy and leading research \& development efforts to execute on the business’s mission to help power the energy transition. We forge the collaborations and help invent the technologies required to electrify and decarbonize for a zero\-carbon future. affordable, reliable, sustainable, and secure energy. **Job Description** =================== * Collaborate with domain experts to understand business needs and translate them into clear and effective authentication, authorization, role\-based access control, input validation, data protection, logging, error handling, database access, and other security concerns. * Translate business needs, or configuration decisions, with attention to security, compliance, privacy, reliability, and customer data handling. * Work across engineering, product, platform, risk, and cybersecurity teams to remove blockers, resolve issues, and drive agreed actions to completion. * Proactively identify process, tooling, and control gaps, then implement practical improvements that reduce manual effort and privilege, trustworthy identity, authorization boundaries, input and output controls, secrets protection, audit logging, data governance, and resilient failure handling. * Build or integrate automated provide actionable remediation guidance and validate that security issues are addressed effectively. **Required Qualifications** * Solid professional experience in software engineering, security engineering, product security, application security, or a related technical field. * Hands\-on experience writing, reviewing, testing, and troubleshooting code, with strong proficiency in Python or a comparable modern programming language. * Experience with full\-stack or platform development using tools and technologies such as GitHub, Git, terminal and CLI workflows, APIs, relational databases such as PostgreSQL, and automated testing. * Practical experience conducting threat modeling, secure design reviews, architecture reviews, or secure code reviews. * Working knowledge of common application and API security risks, secure authentication and authorization patterns, input validation, logging, error hand security or compliance frameworks relevant to enterprise environments. * Experience balancing near\-term delivery with maintainability, operational readiness, and longer\-term improvement opportunities. * Experience designing guardrails, evaluation frameworks, security controls, and governance mechanisms for AI\-generated code and AI\-assisted engineering workflows. * Experience building, extending, or securing AI\-assisted development platforms, coding assistants, developer agents, agentic workflows, MCP integrations, RAG systems, or AI\-enabled engineering productivity solutions. **How You Work** * Highly organized and detail\-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously. * Takes ownership of problems and follows through until outcomes are delivered. * Thrives in a fast\-paced environment and switches context with minimal loss of momentum. * Acts on ambiguity instead of waiting for perfect information. * Curious, driven, and eager to learn unfamiliar technologies and business domains. * Proactive in identifying improvement opportunities and turning ideas into implemented solutions. * Direct, respectful, and audience\-aware in communication. * Open to differing perspectives while confident in evidence\-based technical judgment. **What Success Looks Like** * Security risks are identified early and translated into clear, actionable engineering decisions. * Committed work is planned, prioritized, communicated, and delivered with high quality. * AI security safeguards and security automation are reliable, testable, maintainable, and usable by partner teams. * Engineering teams receive practical guidance that jobs.title: Senior Estimator & Material Handler
jobs.description: SENIOR ESTIMATOR, Material Handler General Contractor — Public Works, Commercial \& Residential Construction **Company:** Gemstone Construction **Position:** Senior Estimator **Employment Type:** Full\-Time **Reports To:** CEO / Executive Management **Supervises:** Project Engineers / Estimating Team POSITION OVERVIEW Gemstone Construction is seeking an experienced **Senior Estimator** to lead our estimating department and oversee the estimating process from the initial project opportunity through contract award and turnover to the Project Management team. This is a senior\-level position for an experienced construction professional who understands how to estimate and bid **public works, commercial, and residential construction projects**. The Senior Estimator will be responsible for identifying qualified projects, reviewing plans and specifications, attending project site walks, understanding the full scope of work, coordinating subcontractor and supplier pricing, completing accurate estimates, meeting bid deadlines, and ensuring every awarded project is properly handed off to the Project Manager. The Senior Estimator will also **lead and manage the Project Engineer estimating team**, ensuring project engineers are obtaining subcontractor and supplier pricing, completing their assigned scopes, maintaining accurate information, and meeting internal deadlines. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail\-oriented, technologically capable, and comfortable taking ownership of the entire estimating process. This person must be able to work independently while also managing and holding an estimating team accountable. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES1\. PROJECT IDENTIFICATION \& OPPORTUNITY MANAGEMENT Monitor and identify new construction opportunities through: * North Coast Builders Exchange * Public works bid platforms * Commercial bidding platforms * Plan rooms * Builder networks * Other estimating and construction software systems * Review potential projects and determine whether they are appropriate for Gemstone Construction. * Evaluate project size, location, schedule, scope, client requirements, bonding requirements, insurance requirements, prevailing wage requirements, and overall profitability potential. * Maintain an organized pipeline of potential projects. * Prioritize projects based on company capacity, profitability, strategic value, and probability of winning. * Communicate recommended projects to executive management for approval before significant estimating resources are committed. 2\. INITIAL CLIENT \& PROJECT SITE MEETINGS The Senior Estimator will be responsible for understanding the project **before Gemstone commits to pricing it**. Responsibilities include: * Attend initial site walks and pre\-bid meetings. * Meet directly with clients, owners, architects, general contractors, public agencies, and other project representatives as required. * Inspect existing conditions. * Take detailed measurements, photographs, and videos. * Identify existing conditions that could affect pricing, schedule, logistics, or constructability. * Identify potential risks, exclusions, conflicts, and unknown conditions. * Ask the questions necessary to fully understand the client's expectations. * Review site access, staging, material storage, working hours, occupied areas, safety requirements, and logistical challenges. * Clearly communicate site conditions and project requirements to the estimating and project engineering team. The Senior Estimator is expected to **know what Gemstone is bidding before the estimate is built.** 3\. PUBLIC WORKS \& COMMERCIAL ESTIMATING The Senior Estimator must have substantial experience with **public works and commercial construction**. Responsibilities include: * Read and interpret plans, specifications, drawings, addenda, bid documents, and contract documents. * Understand public works bidding procedures and requirements. * Identify required bid forms and documentation. * Understand prevailing wage requirements. * Understand bonds, insurance requirements, certified payroll requirements, subcontractor requirements, and other public works compliance obligations. * Identify mandatory pre\-bid meetings and site walks. * Track bid deadlines and submission requirements. * Review project specifications for unusual requirements or potential cost exposures. * Identify scope gaps and conflicts between plans and specifications. * Prepare RFIs and clarification questions when necessary. * Review addenda and incorporate changes into the estimate. * Understand subcontractor and supplier requirements for public projects. * Ensure all required documentation is submitted correctly and on time. **Missing a bid deadline or failing to submit a required document is unacceptable.** 4\. ESTIMATING The Senior Estimator will have ultimate responsibility for producing accurate, complete, and competitive estimates. Responsibilities include: * Develop detailed estimates from plans, specifications, drawings, site  fy opportunities to improve project profitability. * Understand the difference between being competitive and simply being the lowest bidder. * Communicate significant financial risks to executive management before submitting a bid. The goal is not simply to win work. The goal is to **win the right work at the right price.** REQUIRED EXPERIENCE \& QUALIFICATIONSRequired: * Minimum **5\+ years of construction estimating experience**, preferably with a General Contractor. * Strong experience with **public works construction**. * Experience with commercial construction. * Residential construction experience is strongly preferred. * Proven ability to read construction plans and specifications. * Strong understanding of subcontractor and supplier bidding. * Experience with public works bid requirements and documentation. * Understanding of prevailing wage projects. * Understanding of bonds, insurance, and public works requirements. * Strong Microsoft Excel skills. * Strong Microsoft Word skills. * Strong organizational and communication skills. * Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously. * Ability to lead and hold a team accountable. * Valid driver's license and ability to travel to project sites. Preferred: * Experience with JobTread or similar construction management software. * Experience with North Coast Builders Exchange or similar plan rooms. * Experience estimating projects from conceptual through final bid. * Experience with negotiated, hard\-bid, design\-bid\-build, and public works projects. * Experience managing Project Engineers or Junior Estimators. * Construction management, engineering, or related education. PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES The successful candidate will be: * **Accountable** * **Organized** * **Detail\-oriented** * **Proactive** * **Deadline\-driven** * **Analytical** * **A strong communicator** * **Comfortable leading a team** * **Comfortable working independently** * **Technologically capable** * **Financially minded** * **A problem solver** * **Willing to ask questions** * **Not afraid to challenge incomplete or inaccurate information** This position requires someone who takes ownership. We are looking for an estimator who will not simply say, *"I didn't receive the quote,"* or *"I thought someone else was handling it."* We need someone who will find the answer, follow up, identify the problem, and make sure the job gets done. PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS The Senior Estimator will be measured on: * **Accuracy of estimates** * **Profitability of awarded projects** * **Number and quality of qualified opportunities identified** * **Meeting bid deadlines** * **Completeness of bid submissions** * **Subcontractor and supplier coverage** * **Performance and accountability of the Project Engineer team** * **Quality of project turnover** * **Identification and management of estimating risks** * **Organization and accuracy of estimating documentation** * **Effective use of company software and technology** * **Communication with executive management and Project Management** WHY THIS POSITION MATTERS The Senior Estimator is one of the most important positions within the company. The Project Manager can only be as successful as the information they receive when a project is awarded. A good estimate creates a strong foundation for the entire project. A poor estimate can create problems that affect the company for months or years. The Senior Estimator is therefore responsible for making sure Gemstone understands **what we are building, what it should cost, what the risks are, what we are committing to, and how the project needs to be executed before we ever sign the contract.** This position is an opportunity for an experienced construction estimator to take ownership of an estimating department, lead a team, and play a major role in the growth and profitability of Gemstone Construction. Pay: From $35\.00 per hour Benefits: * 401(k) matching * Paid time off Work Location: Hybrid remote in Acampo, CA 95220

AI and digital innovation are transforming the way businesses work, and we’re at the forefront of it. Genpact’s AI Gigafactory, our industry\-first accelerator, exemplifies how we scale advanced technology solutions to help global enterprises work smarter, grow faster, and transform at scale. Whether tackling complex challenges through large\-scale models or agentic AI, our breakthrough solutions tackle companies’ most complex challenges. If you thrive in a fast\-moving, innovation\-driven environment, love building and deploying cutting\-edge AI solutions, and want to push the boundaries of what’s possible, this is your moment. Genpact (NYSE: G) is an agentic and advanced technology solutions company. We leverage process intelligence and artificial intelligence to deliver measurable outcomes. With a strong partner ecosystem and decades of client trust, we provide innovative solutions that transform how businesses run. Powered by a team with an active learning mindset and client centricity at its core, we deliver lasting value for the world’s leading enterprises. jobs.title: Senior Engineer- Modern Work
jobs.description: Description: The Senior Engineer – Modern Work is the senior technical individual contributor within the Global Data Systems Cloud Services practice. The position owns the full delivery lifecycle of Microsoft 365 and Modern Work engagements across the GDS customer base, including discovery and assessment, solution design, planning, implementation, migration, security remediation, automation, documentation, operational handoff, support, escalation, and continuous improvement. The role operates with limited supervision and is accountable for the technical quality and reliability of the work it delivers. This is a senior technical position rather than a people\-management position. The Senior Engineer provides technical leadership by establishing and upholding engineering standards, leading technical workstreams, training and mentoring other engineers, and serving as a senior escalation point for complex Microsoft 365, identity, endpoint, security, and cloud issues. The position has no formal direct reports and no supervisory or disciplinary authority. **Business Purpose and Expected Outcomes** Cloud Services is the Microsoft\-first delivery and operations practice within GDS, turning Microsoft 365, Secure Plus, endpoint management, and AI readiness into repeatable managed outcomes for customers. As GDS continues its evolution from a traditional managed services provider toward a Microsoft\-focused managed intelligence and innovation model, the practice requires senior engineering depth that can carry complex customer work end to end without day\-to\-day direction. This position exists to provide that depth. It serves as the senior technical counterpart to the Director of Cloud Services for day\-to\-day delivery, allowing practice leadership to concentrate on service strategy, organizational leadership, partner relationships, product development, financial performance, customer growth, and practice development. Expected outcomes include: * Consistent, high\-quality technical delivery across all Cloud Services engagement tiers. * Reduced key\-person dependency and greater continuity of engineering leadership. * Faster, better\-documented resolution of complex customer escalations. * Increased standardization, automation, and reuse across the delivery pipeline. * Measurable growth in the technical capability of other Cloud Services engineers. Requirements: **Microsoft 365 and Modern Work** * Design, implement, administer, and optimize Microsoft 365 tenants, including tenant architecture, directory and domain configuration, service configuration, and baseline standards. * Deliver and support Exchange Online and hybrid Exchange environments, including mail flow design, coexistence, troubleshooting, and remediation. * Design, deploy, and support Microsoft Teams, Teams Phone, SharePoint Online, and OneDrive, including collaboration and information architecture. * Lead cross\-tenant and tenant\-to\-tenant projects, including consolidations, acquisitions, and divestitures. * Plan and execute migrations to Microsoft 365 from Google Workspace, on\-premises Exchange, and legacy file platforms with minimal customer disruption. * Apply collaboration governance, adoption, and lifecycle management practices that keep customer environments supportable at scale. * Align technical designs with Microsoft 365 licensing entitlements and documented customer requirements. **Security, Identity, and Compliance** * Design and administer Microsoft Entra ID, including hybrid identity and Microsoft Entra Connect. * Implement Conditional Access, multifactor authentication, password less authentication, and access controls aligned to Zero Trust and least privilege. * Configure Privileged Identity Management, Identity Protection, access reviews, and identity governance. * Integrate enterprise applications using single sign\-on, SAML, OAuth, and related application integration methods. * Investigate and remediate identity incidents, including compromised accounts, risky sign\-ins, and privilege misuse. * Deploy and tune Microsoft Defender XDR, including Defender for Office 365, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, and Defender for Cloud Apps, and support Microsoft Sentinel where it applies to the GDS service portfolio. * Configure Microsoft Purview capabilities, including information protection, sensitivity labeling, retention, data loss prevention, and eDiscovery. * Deliver Microsoft Intune and Windows Autopilot engagements covering endpoint configuration, compliance policy, application deployment, patching, security baselines, and mobile device and mobile application management. * Lead Windows modernization and endpoint lifecycle projects across managed customer environments. * Perform security assessments, build remediation plans, participate in incident response, and lead security\-hardening initiatives. * Own Secure Plus onboarding, delivery, ongoing improvement, and escalation for assigned customers. **Azure and Cloud Services* 1\). * Microsoft Certified: Copilot and Agent Administration Fundamentals (AB\-900\), or the Microsoft Applied Skill for preparing security and compliance to support Microsoft 365 Copilot. * Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert (SC\-100\) or Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ\-305\). * ITIL Foundation or a comparable service\-management certification. * Experience with Teams Phone or direct routing voice deployments. * Experience with compliance\-driven environments and recognized security frameworks such as CIS, NIST, CMMC, HIPAA, PCI, or SOC 2\. * Experience building agents or automation with Microsoft Copilot Studio or Power Platform. **Customer Service and Communication Expectations:** GDS serves its customers on the principle of Serving People and Making IT Simple. The Senior Engineer is expected to translate complex technical work into language customers can act on, to set and meet realistic expectations, and to keep stakeholders informed during projects, escalations, and service\-impacting events. The position requires professional written and verbal communication with technical and non\-technical audiences, the ability to present information and answer questions in customer and internal meetings, ownership of issues through to resolution, and the judgment to raise risks early rather than late. **Success Measures:** Performance in this position is evaluated against the following outcomes: * Quality and reliability of technical implementations. * Achievement of project milestones and customer commitments. * Reduction of repeat escalations and preventable incidents. * Accuracy and completeness of technical and project documentation. * Measurable security and compliance improvement in supported environments. * Timely resolution of complex escalations. * Customer satisfaction and effective stakeholder communication. * Successful operational handoffs into managed services. * Increased standardization and automation across delivery. * Knowledge transfer and measurable growth of other engineers. * Contribution to service maturity, scalability, and continuous improvement. **Physical Demands and Work Environment** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit and to talk or hear. The employee is frequently required to stand; walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; and reach with hands and arms. The employee must regularly lift or move up to 25 pounds. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, and color vision. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally exposed to risk of electrical shock. **NOTE:** This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee incumbent in this position. Employees will be required to follow any other job\-related instructions and to perform any other job\-related duties requested by any person authorized to give instructions or assignments. All duties and responsibilities are essential functions and requirements and are subject to possible modification to reasonably accommodate individuals with disabilities. To perform this job successfully, the incumbent will possess the skills, aptitudes, and abilities to perform each duty proficiently. Some requirements may exclude individuals who pose a direct threat or significant risk to the health or safety of themselves or others. The requirements listed in this document are the minimum levels of knowledge, skills, or abilities. This document does not create an employment contract, implied or otherwise, other than an at\-will relationship.

jobs.title: Process Excellence Engineer
jobs.description: **CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT ENGINEER – OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE** Miami, Florida \| Reports to: Operations Manager Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM; one Saturday every two weeks, 8:00 AM–1:00 PM. Additional hours during peak seasons. Compensation: $24\.00/hour \+ company incentives Language: Fluent English and Spanish required **ABOUT THE ROLE** We are looking for a **Process Excellence Engineer** to join our Operations team and play a key role in building and rolling out our Business Operational System. This is a floor\-level, people\-first role. You will spend the majority of your time in our logistics operation — working shoulder\-to\-shoulder with frontline teams and supervisors to observe how work actually gets done, identify what's getting in the way, and put better systems in place. If you're the type of engineer who would rather be on the floor than behind a desk, this role is for you. We are not looking for someone to run reports from an office. We need someone who can help us build lasting operational capability: management routines, performance standards, problem\-solving habits, and a culture where improvement is part of how we work every day. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** **Build and Roll Out Operational Systems** * Translate Operational Excellence strategy into practical, day\-to\-day routines at the floor level * Support leadership in implementing and sustaining the Business Operational System * Design and deploy visual management systems and daily performance boards * Establish tiered management routines and structured performance reviews * Define and track operational KPIs; close gaps between target and actual performance * Build supervisor and frontline capability so improvement becomes self\-sustaining **Drive Lean and Process Improvement** * Identify and eliminate waste, variation, bottlenecks, and non\-value\-added activity * Facilitate Kaizen events, focused improvement sessions, and cross\-functional problem\-solving * Apply tools including 5S, Value Stream Mapping, Spaghetti Diagrams, PDCA, A3, Fishbone/Ishikawa, Pareto Analysis, and basic statistics * Improve layouts, material flow, work methods, and information flow * Measure and document the financial and operational impact of improvements **Standardize How Work Gets Done** * Observe and document current processes; identify gaps between documented and actual practice * Write standard operating procedures, work instructions, and process maps * Establish standard cycle times and productivity expectations where appropriate * Develop audit mechanisms to ensure standards are followed and sustained * Build training materials from standardized work **Solve Problems at the Root** * Distinguish root causes from symptoms using structured methodologies * Facilitate cross\-functional teams through problem\-solving using PDCA and A3 thinking * Develop corrective and preventive actions; follow up to confirm they hold * Coach supervisors and frontline employees in practical problem\-solving **Analyze Productivity and Labor** * Conduct time and motion studies; establish performance baselines and expectations * Identify productivity losses by process, team, and shift * Support labor planning and workforce balancing based on operational demand * Analyze capacity constraints and bottlenecks * Evaluate labor cost per unit without compromising safety, quality, or cold\-chain integrity **Manage Performance Data** * Build and maintain operational dashboards and performance indicators * Analyze productivity, cycle time, labor efficiency, quality, and service metrics * Use Excel and other tools to turn data into clear, actionable insights * Prioritize improvement opportunities through Pareto and trend analysis **Train and Develop People** * Facilitate Lean fundamentals workshops and Kaizen events * Coach supervisors in daily management and performance routines * Develop practical, easy\-to\-use training materials * Progressively transfer improvement ownership to frontline teams and supervisors **Support Peak Season Readiness** * Analyze prior high\-volume season operations to identify capacity and labor risks * Develop standard work and visual management to support peak periods * Conduct post\-peak reviews and convert lessons into repeatable practices **HOW WE'LL MEASURE YOUR SUCCESS** In your first 12–18 months, we expect you to: * Support implementation of the Business Operational System and its core pillars * Standardize critical operational processes with clear, documented standard work * Stand up a structured problem\-solving culture with trained supervisors * Deliver measurable improvements in productivity, cycle time, rework, and labor efficiency * Develop frontline leaders capable of independently managing daily performance * Sustain improvements — not just launch them Metrics will include: units per labor hour, cost per unit, cycle time, on\-time shipment performance, rework and error rates, process adherence, capacity utilization, and improvement project impact. **WHO YOU ARE** You are hands\-on, analytical, and people\-oriented. You're as comfortable on the warehouse floor as you are in a spreadsheet. You don't need formal authority to influence people — you earn credibility by knowing your stuff and showing up consistently. Your operating mode: **Observe → Analyze → Standardize → Improve → Teach → Sustain** **Core Competencies:** * Gemba mindset — you go to where the work happens * Structured problem\-solver — you separate facts from symptoms * Coach and facilitator — you build others up, not just fix things yourself * Communicator — you translate technical concepts into plain language, in both English and Spanish * Self\-starter — you own projects from analysis through sustainment **QUALIFICATIONS** **Required:** * Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, Manufacturing Engineering, Logistics, or related field * 2–5 years of hands\-on experience in process improvement, Lean, industrial engineering, logistics, warehousing, or related operations * Demonstrated experience with process analysis, time studies, standard work development, and structured problem solving * Strong analytical skills; advanced Microsoft Excel * Bilingual — English and Spanish, written and spoken * Ability to work in cold\-chain environments (\~35°F) and under time\-sensitive operational pressure **Preferred:** * Lean Six Sigma certification * Experience in logistics, warehousing, food, perishables, agriculture, or flowers * Familiarity with TPM or other structured Operational Excellence frameworks * Power BI or data visualization experience * Experience with WMS or logistics management systems * Practical use of AI or digital tools to support analysis Pay: $50,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Retirement plan * Vision insurance Education: * Bachelor's (Required) Experience: * Continuous improvement, lean manufacturing: 2 years (Required) Language: * English (Required) * Spanish (Required) Ability to Commute: * Doral, FL 33122 (Required) Work Location: In person

jobs.description: **Job Title:** Data Engineer, Expert **Location:** Oakland, CA **Duration:** October 06, 2026– September 30, 2027 **Pay Rate:** $110\.00/hr. W2 **Account Manager Notes:** Local candidates only. The role is hybrid in OGO or San Ramon. * KEY SKILLS: Refer to the first 2 paragraphs below from the hiring manager's job description: **Job Description:** We are seeking a highly motivated contractor with 3\-5 years of experience in Python application development, Streamlit, Snowflake, and data engineering. The contractor will support the design, development, and deployment of data\-driven applications that streamline business processes, improve asset management capabilities, and enable operational insights for Substation Systems \& Tools and related business functions. The ideal candidate will have experience building data applications using Python and Streamlit, working with Snowflake data platforms, and developing data pipelines that integrate information from multiple enterprise systems. Experience supporting asset management, utility operations, SAP, SharePoint, or engineering workflows is highly desirable. **Responsibilities** * Design, develop, and maintain Streamlit applications jobs.description: ### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 8 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages. * 2 years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, Production Engineering, or Systems Engineering roles managing large \- scale infrastructure. * 3 years of experience designing, analyzing, and troubleshooting distributed systems. * 3 years of experience in machine learning infrastructure. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master's degree in Computer Science or Engineering. * Experience enhancing and supporting large production systems on compute infrastructure. * Experience with networking, capacity and performance. * Experience in large\-scale systems, architecture design and complex system integrations or migrations. * Experience supporting a Tier 1 rotation. * Expertise in SRE production principles and best practices. **About the job** ----------------- Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) combines software and systems engineering to build and run large\-scale, massively distributed, fault\-tolerant systems. SRE ensures that Google Cloud's services—both our internally critical and our externally\-visible systems—have reliability, uptime appropriate to customer's needs and a fast rate of improvement. Additionally SRE’s will keep an ever\-watchful eye on our systems capacity and performance. Much of our software development focuses on optimizing existing systems, building infrastructure and eliminating work through automation. On the SRE team, you’ll have the opportunity to manage the complex challenges of scale which are unique to Google Cloud, while using your expertise in coding, algorithms, complexity analysis and large\-scale system design. SRE's culture of intellectual curiosity, problem solving and openness is key to its success. Our organization brings together people with a wide variety of backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We encourage them to collaborate, think big and take risks in a blame\-free environment. We promote self\-direction to work on meaningful projects, while we also strive to create an environment that provides the support and mentorship needed to learn and grow. Vertex AI is a key pillar to the Cloud AI's mission is to responsibly deliver AI that enables industries and organizations to transform and solve real\-world problems through a single unified artificial intelligence platform that enables building, deploying, and scaling ML models faster with either pre\-trained and custom tooling. We are Tier 1 on\-call for Vertex AI Online Prediction and Large Language Models, Gen AI and are planning to continue to extend support to the most critical services within the Vertex AI suite. Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. jobs.description: ### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 4 years of experience in high\-performance ASIC design. * Experience architecting or designing RTL solutions for digital systems. * Experience developing networking IP across one or more layers, such as the media access control (MAC), link (L2\), or physical (PHY) layers. * Experience with high\-speed interconnects. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science, with an emphasis on computer architecture. * 7 years of experience in high\-performance ASIC design. * Experience with IEEE networking standards and applications. * Experience with scripting languages (e.g., Tcl, Python or Perl). * Understanding of digital design fundamentals, including synchronous and asynchronous logic, state machines, and bus protocols. * Familiarity with one or more industry\-standard tools for CDC, RDC, RTL Linting, or LEC. **About the job** ----------------- In this role, you’ll work to shape the future of AI/ML hardware acceleration. You will have an opportunity to drive cutting\-edge TPU (Tensor Processing Unit) technology that powers Google's most demanding AI/ML applications. You’ll be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's TPU. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide, and leverage your design and verification expertise to verify complex digital designs, with a specific focus on TPU architecture and its integration within AI/ML\-driven systems. Join the team designing and developing the core components of Google's next\-generation Tensor Processing Units (TPUs), the custom\-built accelerators powering our AI and machine learning workloads in data centers. As a member of the inter\-chip interconnect team, you will play an important role in designing ASIC/SoC hardware for AI and networking accelerators that drive the computational workloads behind Google's most important products. Our hardware accelerators power nearly every product Google offers. Our primary focus is AI acceleration. You will design RTL IP with a focus on chip\-to\-chip high\-speed interconnect subsystems. You will have dynamic, multi\-faceted responsibilities in areas such as project definition, RTL design, and implementation. You will participate in the design, architecture, documentation, and implementation of the next generation of data center accelerators. You will have the opportunity to solve challenging technical problems at the forefront of AI hardware, working in a dynamic and collaborative environment. The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide. We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting\-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world\-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $138000 \- $197000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Collaborate with the Verification team to develop test plans, debug RTL, and ensure functional correctness. * Work closely with the Physical Design team to meet timing, area, power, and manufacturability requirements. * Define and document the microarchitecture for complex digital designs within the TPU. * Write high\-quality, performant, and power\-efficient RTL code, primarily in SystemVerilog. jobs.description: We are seeking a Cyber Security Engineer – Data Security to design, implement, and continuously improve security capabilities that protect sensitive data across the enterprise. endpoint, and emerging AI environments.**Key Responsibilities:** * Design, implement, and maintain enterprise data security controls across cloud, SaaS, applications, databases, endpoints, and AI platforms. * Implement and improve data discovery, classification, labeling, and protection capabilities for sensitive and regulated data. * Engineer and operate Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) capabilities to identify sensitive data, excessive exposure, misconfigurations, and inappropriate access. * Develop and tune Data Loss Prevention (DLP) controls across endpoint, cloud, email, collaboration, and SaaS environments. * Assess how sensitive data is stored, processed, transmitted, and accessed and recommend appropriate security controls. * Identify excessive or inappropriate access to sensitive data and partner with IAM, Privacy and platform teams to implement least\-privilege access. * Support encryption, tokenization, masking, secrets protection, and key\-management strategies where appropriate. * Develop monitoring and detection capabilities for suspicious or unauthorized access, movement, and exfiltration of sensitive data. * Automate data security controls, assessments, monitoring, and remediation using APIs, scripting, and security tooling. * Perform security assessments and threat modeling for systems that store or process sensitive information. * Partner with application, cloud, data, and AI engineering teams to incorporate data protection requirements into system designs. * Support incident investigations involving potential data exposure or exfiltration. * Develop technical standards, security patterns, and engineering guidance for protecting sensitive data. **Minimum Qualification:** * Technical Degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security and/or a High School Diploma/GED from an accredited institution along with equivalent work experience * Entry\-level experience in at least two of the following areas: security engineering, network penetration, incident response, threat hunting, and governance risk \& compliance **Preferred Qualifications:** * 3\+ years of experience in cybersecurity, security engineering, cloud security, data security, or a related technical discipline. * Hands\-on experience implementing or operating enterprise data protection, DLP, DSPM, or data security technologies. * Strong understanding of data security principles including discovery, classification, access control, encryption, data loss prevention, and monitoring. * Experience securing data across cloud, SaaS, database, and application environments. * Understanding of IAM concepts including authentication, authorization, RBAC, least privilege, and privileged access. * Experience with at least one major cloud platform such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud. * Experience with security automation, scripting, or APIs; Python, PowerShell, or comparable experience preferred. * Strong understanding of security architecture and common data\-exfiltration techniques. * Ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues and translate identified risks into practical engineering solutions. * Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate across security and engineering teams. * Experience implementing or operating DSPM/CNAPP/data security platforms in large enterprise environments. * Experience with enterprise DLP technologies across endpoint, email, cloud, and SaaS environments. * Experience with Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Defender, or comparable enterprise data security technologies. * Experience securing structured and unstructured data across databases, data lakes, warehouses, object storage, and collaboration platforms. * Experience with encryption, key management, tokenization, masking, or secrets\-management technologies. * Experience developing automated data security controls and remediation workflows. * Experience with Infrastructure as Code and incorporating security controls into cloud deployments. * Understanding of data security considerations for generative AI and agentic AI, including preventing inappropriate access to or disclosure of sensitive information. * Familiarity with data governance, retention, privacy, and regulatory requirements. * Experience protecting PHI, PII, financial, or other sensitive data in a regulated environment. jobs.description: We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead.
