Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry. **About Landmark** ------------------ Landmark, a Halliburton business line, provides the industry’s most comprehensive suite of digital solutions for exploration, drilling, and production optimization. Its software and data platforms empower customers to model subsurface assets, manage drilling risk, and accelerate decision\-making through cloud, AI, and advanced analytics. **About the Role** ------------------ We are seeking an R\&D geophysicist to develop advanced seismic imaging, inversion, and quantitative\-interpretation technologies for reservoir characterization. The role will apply Python, machine learning, deep learning, and mathematical inversion methods to integrate seismic data with well logs, rock physics, petrophysics, sequence stratigraphy, and seismic facies information. You will develop and validate workflows that transform seismic observations into high\-resolution 3D estimates of reservoir properties such as porosity, shale volume, and fluid saturation, including associated uncertainty. Working with geoscientists, reservoir engineers, data scientists, software developers, product stakeholders, and technical customers, you will convert research concepts into tested prototypes and product\-ready technical capabilities. **Key Responsibilities** * Develop elastic full\-waveform inversion and acoustic or elastic seismic\-inversion methods for shot\-gather, post\-stack, and pre\-stack AVO/AVA applications. * Design AI and deep\-learning approaches that improve seismic imaging, inversion, seismic facies classification, and seismic\-to\-petrophysical property mapping. * Integrate seismic volumes, well logs, core measurements, rock\-physics relationships, and geologic interpretations to construct high\-resolution 3D reservoir\-property models. * Develop Python\-based research prototypes, algorithms, and reproducible technical workflows using appropriate scientific\-computing and machine\-learning frameworks. * Quantify uncertainty in predicted rock properties and fluid saturations using statistical, probabilistic, ensemble, or AI\-enabled inverse\-problem methods. * Distinguish and evaluate epistemic and aleatoric uncertainty, analyze model generalization, and identify limitations in training data and model assumptions. * Validate seismic, reservoir, and machine\-learning models using blind\-well tests, held\-out data, physical consistency checks, and comparison with known subsurface observations. * Incorporate sequence\-stratigraphic frameworks, seismic facies, geostatistical principles, and petrophysical constraints into reservoir\-characterization workflows. * Collaborate with multidisciplinary R\&D and product teams to define technical problems, prioritize experiments, assess feasibility, and translate successful research into usable software capabilities. * Document methods, assumptions, experiments, results, model limitations, and recommendations, and communicate complex findings to technical and product stakeholders. * Monitor advances in geophysics, AI, deep learning, and scientific computing, and contribute to technical publications, presentations, invention disclosures, and patents where appropriate. **Qualifications** ------------------ **Required** * Undergraduate degree in Science, Engineering, or a similar technical discipline. * Minimum of four years of related experience in applied research, technology development, product development, engineering, scientific analysis, or a comparable technical field. * Demonstrated experience applying scientific or engineering principles to seismic imaging, seismic inversion, quantitative interpretation, reservoir characterization, or a closely related technical problem. * Proficiency in Python and experience developing scientific\-computing, data\-analysis, machine\-learning, or deep\-learning workflows. * Experience designing technical investigations, experiments, model evaluations, or validation studies and interpreting the resulting data. * Ability to document technical work, manage defined R\&D deliverables, and communicate complex concepts and recommendations to multidisciplinary technical stakeholders. **Preferred** * Master’s degree or PhD in Geophysics, Rock Physics, Petroleum Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline. * Experience with full\-waveform inversion, pre\-stack AVO/AVA inversion, post\-stack inversion, quantitative interpretation, rock physics, or seismic reservoir characterization. * Experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit\-learn, or comparable AI and scientific\-computing technologies. * Experience with uncertainty quantification, probabilistic inversion, geostatistics, sequence stratigraphy, seismic facies classification, or 3D static reservoir modeling. * Energy\-industry R\&D experience, cloud or high\-performance computing exposure, and a record of technical publications, presentations, patents, or research\-to\-product delivery. Candidates who possess qualifications exceeding the minimum job requirements may be considered for higher\-level positions based on experience, additional qualifications, demonstrated capabilities, and current business needs. Depending on education, experience, and skill level, candidates may be eligible for roles ranging from Senior R\&D Scientist/Engineer, Landmark Technology to Principal R\&D Scientist/Engineer, Landmark Technology or Advisor R\&D Scientist/Engineer, Landmark Technology. **World Class Benefits** ------------------------ At Halliburton, we’re committed to supporting you and your family with a comprehensive and affordable benefits package that covers your physical, emotional, financial, and parental needs — now and in the future. When you join our team, you’ll gain access to a wide range of programs designed to help you thrive at work and at home. Click here to review a summary of the benefits available once you join. **Core Competencies** --------------------- Seismic Inversion \| Full\-Waveform Inversion \| Elastic FWI \| Quantitative Interpretation \| AVO/AVA \| Rock Physics \| Petrophysics \| Reservoir Characterization \| Subsurface Machine Learning \| Deep Learning \| Python \| PyTorch \| TensorFlow \| Uncertainty Quantification \| Seismic Facies Classification \| Sequence Stratigraphy \| Geostatistics \| 3D Reservoir Modeling **Halliburton is an Equal Opportunity Employer. jobs.description: Company Description By working at Harvard University, you join a vibrant community that advances Harvard's world\-changing mission in meaningful ways, inspires innovation and collaboration, and builds skills and expertise. We are dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming environment where everyone can thrive. **Why join the Harvard Kennedy School?** The John F. Kennedy School of Government at Harvard University is one of 12 graduate and professional schools at the university. Harvard Kennedy School’s mission is to improve public policy and leadership so people can live in societies that are more safe, free, just, and sustainably prosperous. By combining cutting\-edge research, the teaching of outstanding students, and direct interaction with practitioners, we have an impact on solving public problems that no other institution can match. When you work at Harvard Kennedy School, you make a difference. Job Description **Job Summary:** Professor Goel’s Computational Policy Lab at the Shorenstein Center at Harvard Kennedy School is seeking a Software Engineer with specialized expertise in software development, generative AI, and data science. This fellowship is housed within the Shorenstein Center on Media, Politics and Public Policy. Through teaching and research at the Kennedy School of Government and its program of visiting fellows, conferences and initiatives, the Center is at the forefront of its area of inquiry. **Job\-Specific Responsibilities:** Core responsibilities encompass specialized tasks including: * Independently perform complex applications/web development for projects of large to very large size and complexity * Design and develop complex software systems for large\-scale research projects, with a focus on education technology and generative AI\-based tools. * Leverage recent breakthroughs in machine learning and natural language processing to build, test, and deploy advanced algorithmic tools that underpin rigorous empirical research in real\-world environments. * Lead and collaborate on technically challenging projects involving AI, machine learning, natural language processing, and large\-scale experimentation. * Contribute to the design and execution of randomized controlled trials and other empirical methods used to evaluate the impact of AI\-driven interventions. * Collaborate closely with other researchers to translate theoretical models and experimental designs into high\-performance, production\-ready systems. * Co\-author or contribute to academic publications and technical reports intended for peer\-reviewed journals, conference proceedings, and lay audiences. * Stay abreast of emerging technologies and research developments related to AI, computational social science, and causal inference. * Abide by and follow the Harvard University IT technical standards, policies and Code of Conduct. Projects you will work on include, but are not limited to: * **AI in Education:** We are designing and testing AI\-powered technologies that go beyond generic tools like ChatGPT to provide tailored support for student learning. Our flagship tool, PingPong, is currently being evaluated through a large\-scale randomized experiment across universities and community colleges nationwide. In addition, we are piloting innovations such as virtual lectures, personalized student diagnostics, and teacher co\-pilot tools. This role will help design, implement, and scale these technologies so they can be rigorously tested and used in real classroom settings. * **AI in Public Policy:** We are engineering AI systems that improve public service delivery and decision\-making. Examples include tools that assist county prosecutors in making unbiased charging decisions, help public defender clients to avoid jail time due to missed court dates, and support adjudicators as they process unemployment insurance claims. In this role, you will work on building robust, production\-quality systems that can be deployed in high\-stakes government environments where reliability, fairness, and performance are critical. Qualifications **Basic Qualifications:** * Minimum of two years’ post\-secondary education or relevant work experience **Additional Qualifications and Skills:** * Bachelor's degree and/or relevant work experience in computer science, data science, or a closely related field, with a strong emphasis on advanced software engineering, machine learning, artificial intelligence, and empirical research methodologies. * Minimum of two years' relevant full\-time work experience. * Experience working with generative AI pipelines. * Experience deploying software in a cloud environment. * Demonstrated team performance skills, service mindset approach, and the ability to act as a trusted advisor. * Full stack development experience with Python / TypeScript and familiarity with Svelte / React preferred. Additional Information * **Appointment End Date:** This is a fully benefits\-eligible term appointment, ending one year from date of hire, with possibility of renewal. * **Visa Sponsorship Information:** Harvard University is unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position * **Pre\-Employment Screening:** Identity, Education * **Other Information:** This position is based on campus in Cambridge, MA, and required to work on campus 3 days/week. **Applications must include the following, or they will be considered incomplete:** * Resume * Cover letter including: + A link to a piece of code on GitHub that you wrote, ideally something that demonstrates your technical skills and you’d enjoy walking us through if you were selected for an interview + A short description of the project you linked to + Confirmation that you are legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship for at least two years **About the Center** The Shorenstein Center on Media, Politics and Public Policy is a Harvard University research center dedicated to exploring and illuminating the intersection of media, technology, politics and public policy in theory and practice. Through teaching and research at the Kennedy School of Government and its program of visiting fellows, conferences and initiatives, the Center is at the forefront of its area of inquiry. **Work Format Details** This position has been determined by school or unit leaders that some of the duties and responsibilities can be effectively performed at a non\-Harvard location. The work schedule and location will be set by the department at its discretion and based upon operational needs. When not working at a Harvard or Harvard\-designated location, employees in hybrid positions must work in a Harvard registered state in compliance with the University’s Policy on Employment Outside of Massachusetts. Additional details will be discussed during the interview process. Certain visa types and funding sources may limit work location. Individuals must meet work location sponsorship requirements prior to employment. **Salary Grade and Ranges** This position is salary grade level 057\. Please visit Harvard's Salary Ranges to view the corresponding salary range and related information. **Benefits** Harvard offers a comprehensive benefits package that is designed to support a healthy work\-life balance and your physical, mental and financial wellbeing. Because here, you are what matters. Our benefits include, but are not limited to: * Generous paid time off including parental leave * Medical, dental, and vision health insurance coverage starting on day one * Retirement plans with university contributions * Wellbeing and mental health resources * Support for families and caregivers * Professional development opportunities including tuition assistance and reimbursement * Commuter benefits, discounts and campus perks Learn more about these and additional benefits on our Benefits \& Wellbeing Page. **EEO/Non\-Discrimination Commitment Statement** Harvard University is committed to equal opportunity and non\-discrimination. We seek talent from all parts of society and the world, and we strive to ensure everyone at Harvard thrives. Our differences help our community advance Harvard's academic purposes. Harvard has an equal employment opportunity policy that outlines our commitment to prohibiting discrimination on the basis of race, ethnicity, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, religion, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law or identified in the university's non\-discrimination policy. Harvard's equal employment opportunity policy and non\-discrimination policy help all community members participate fully in work and campus life free from harassment and discrimination.

jobs.title: Clinical Product Lead
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Remote **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- All Cost CentersGeneral \& AdministrationClinicalClinical **Compensation** ---------------- * Estimated Base Salary $127,840 – $188,000 • Offers Equity We are committed to offering a comprehensive and competitive total rewards package, including robust health and wellness benefits, retirement savings, and meaningful ownership opportunities through equity. Compensation decisions are made holistically, ensuring fairness and alignment with market benchmarks while recognizing individual contributions and potential. 1 in 4 people in the US have a treatable mental health condition, but most providers don't accept insurance, making therapy too expensive for most people. **Headway’s mission is to fix this by building a new mental healthcare system everyone can access.** We started by solving the biggest barrier to care: insurance. The admin work \- credentialing, claims, payment reconciliation \- is a nightmare. We've automated that. But we're going further. Over 75,000 providers across all 50 states run their practice on our software, serving over 1 million patients. We are building the best tools for therapists to run their entire practice, reimagining the experience of finding a therapist, and investing in the platform foundations to enable this at scale. We aren't just a billing layer; we are becoming the platform where care actually happens. We're a Series D company with $325M\+ in funding (a16z, Accel, Spark Capital, etc.), looking for exceptional people to help us achieve this mission. We want your time here to be the most meaningful experience of your career. Join us, and help change mental healthcare for the better. **About the Role** ------------------ At Headway, we're building the future of behavioral health — and increasingly, that means shipping products that providers and patients rely on every day. We're hiring a **Clinical Product Lead** to own the clinical judgment behind how risk gets detected, escalated, and closed out across our platform, and to make sure every product surface we build is connected to the safety systems behind it. Headway already has real safety capability through risk detection, human triage, a 24/7 crisis partner, and more. However as our platform expands, particularly into AI tooling, so does our need for a single coherent system and point of ownership for patient safety across product surfaces. This role sits on our Clinical Product team, partnering daily with engineering, product, and clinical operations. You'll also carry the clinical safety bar for our AI surfaces. This is a first\-of\-its\-kind role. You'll help define what "safe" means for a behavioral health platform operating at the scale of our network — and then build the products and systems that make it true rather than aspirational. **You will:** ------------- * Own the clinical requirements for how patient risk is detected and mitigated through our platform surfaces including the patient portal, support chat and phone, clinical assessments, conversational intake, and more. Drive us toward one shared severity taxonomy and routing model. * Serve as the Clinical Product Patient Safety partner for product features that carry the potential for risk disclosure. Define safety requirements and safeguards, integrate the product into existing escalations structures, and red\-team the failure points. Stay with the feature after launch to review how the safeguards performed. * Audit our product surfaces to identify patient safety gaps. Collaborate within the clinical team and with cross functional partners to close those gaps. * Support us in holding the clinical safety and quality bar for our AI surfaces such as AI\-generated clinical notes, treatment planning, and conversational tools. Write rubrics, label the gold\-standard cases our models learn from, and audit model output against your own clinical assessment. * Resolve risk\-ownership questions and ensure that our policies and the platform clearly and accurately reflect that position. * Communicate tradeoffs clearly to non\-clinical stakeholders — including when speed, scale, or automation must be balanced against clinical rigor — and push back constructively when product or technical decisions conflict with sound clinical judgment. **You will love this role if:** ------------------------------- * You are an Independently Licensed Therapist (LPC, LCSW, PhD, or PsyD) with 5\+ years of post\-graduate clinical experience. * You have worked inside a safety or quality system and feel extremely confident in risk assessment and safety planning, and crisis response. * You are a systems thinker. You can look at a set of disconnected escalation paths and see the single model underneath. * You thrive working quickly and cross\-functionally with engineers, product partners, and operations teams. You're comfortable saying "what you’re proposing carries some risk, and here's the clinical reason why," and you know how to make that feedback actionable for people who don't share your clinical training. * You are a first\-principles thinker who can break down fuzzy clinical concepts (therapeutic alliance, medical necessity, risk assessment, patient safety) into something concrete enough to label, evaluate, and ship against. * You have a working understanding of how AI models are evaluated — concepts like precision, recall, and false positive rates don't intimidate you, and you can connect them to real clinical consequences (e.g., what it means for a model to miss a safety concern vs. over\-flag one). * You are flexible and energized by ambiguity. Headway's clinical AI roadmap will shift across the next year, and you're excited to flex across quality, safety, and product AI projects as our needs evolve. * You are motivated by the opportunity to improve access to high\-quality behavioral healthcare at scale. **Compensation and Benefits:** ============================== The expected base pay range for this position is $127,840 \- $188,000, based on a variety of factors including qualifications, experience, and geographic location. *We are committed to offering a comprehensive and competitive total rewards package, including robust health and wellness benefits, retirement savings, and meaningful ownership opportunities through equity. Compensation decisions are made holistically, ensuring fairness and alignment with market benchmarks while recognizing individual contributions and potential.* **Benefits offered include:** * Equity Compensation * Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage * HSA / FSA * 401K * Work\-from\-Home Stipend * Therapy Reimbursement * 16\-week parental leave for eligible employees * Carrot Fertility annual reimbursement and membership * 13 paid holidays each year as well as a Holiday Break during the week between December 25th and December 31st * Flexible PTO * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * Training and professional development We believe a team's strength is in its people, and we cannot achieve this mission without a team that reflects the diversity of this problem – across race, ethnicity, gender, sexuality, age, national origin, religion, family status, disability, military status, and experience. Headway is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Headway will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please inform the recruiter when they contact you to schedule your interview. Headway participates in E\-Verify. A notice to Headway applicants: To protect yourself against phishing and recruitment fraud, please note that Headway only accepts applications through our official careers page at https://headway.co/careers. Headway will never refer you to external websites, ask for payment or personal information, or conduct interviews via messaging apps. All official communication will come from a @findheadway.com email address. If you are contacted by someone claiming to be from Headway via an unofficial channel, please do not share any information and report it as spam.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer- CRM
jobs.description: **POS\-33519** **Principal Software Engineer\- CRM Product Platform** ====================================================== **Engineering \| Remote \- USA** **About the Team** ------------------ HubSpot's Product Platform Engineering org is building the foundational layer that powers how millions of users experience, configure, and get value from the CRM. We own the shared infrastructure, APIs, extensibility surfaces, and product foundations that run across every Hub\- not one feature team, but all of them. When we ship, it shows up everywhere. We operate as a product\-line triad with Product Management and UX\- which means tight, fast collaboration from problem discovery through production delivery. The org is in one of its most formative periods: we're redefining how customers interact with and configure HubSpot at a moment when AI is fundamentally changing what's possible in SaaS products. Engineers here don't just execute a roadmap \- they help set one. **About the Role** ------------------ We are seeking a **Principal Software Engineer** to lead one of the most compelling product challenges in the CRM space right now: making HubSpot deeply, genuinely configurable for every customer\- without sacrificing the reliability and consistency enterprise software demands. The shift is already happening. Things that once required expensive custom engineering \- personalizing workflows, building bespoke CRM applications, extending the product to fit a team's exact needs \- are becoming dramatically more accessible with coding agents and AI. The question we're solving is: *how do you productize that level of deep customization at scale?* This person won't just follow a technical roadmap\- they'll help define what's possible, build the custom workspaces and extensibility foundations that make it real, and raise the bar for how product\-minded engineering gets done across a 100\+ engineer org. **Key Expectations** -------------------- * **Architectural Leadership for CRM Configurability:** Define the technical patterns for how customers can deeply configure and extend HubSpot\- from custom workspaces and no\-code/low\-code surfaces to AI\-powered personalization that scales across millions of users. * **Zero\-to\-One Product Building:** Act as the technical anchor for a genuinely new problem space. You stay current with where AI and coding agents are heading, prototype rapidly, and turn early\-stage ideas into production\-grade product features\- not just POCs. * **Hands\-On, High\-Leverage Contributor:** You ship production code at 75%\+ of your time. You lead from the front \- moving from architectural vision to working software, personally. If your preference is strategy with others implementing, this isn't the role. You architect by delivering. * **Cross\-Functional Influence at Scale:** This work touches \~120\+ engineers across multiple groups, plus Product and UX partners. You'll need to build alignment, communicate trade\-offs clearly across all levels, and move a large org without steamrolling it. * **Technical Mentorship \& Multiplier:** You elevate the engineers around you\- raising the bar on full\-stack product thinking, AI\-enabled development, and what it means to build software that customers actually use and love. * **Product \& Customer Obsession:** You understand the pain of a CRM customer who needs software to flex to their workflow, not the other way around. You bring that perspective into every technical decision you make. **What You Bring** ------------------ * **Full\-Stack Product Engineering Depth:** You've delivered meaningful impact on both sides\- backend systems and product\-facing layers\- and you own end\-to\-end. You're not purely infrastructure, and you're not purely UI. You span both because the best product outcomes require it. * **AI Shipped to Production:** You've gone beyond experimentation. You've delivered AI\-powered product features with real user impact\- ideally at the intersection of configurability, extensibility, or no\-code/low\-code tooling and AI capability. * **A Product\-First Mindset:** You care deeply about the "why" behind the "what." You've built things people use every day, and you advocate for the customer experience in design reviews\- even when it means rethinking the technical approach. * **SaaS Product Background:** You've operated inside a product\-led SaaS company that moves fast and operates at scale. You understand the difference between building for enterprise customers and building for storefronts or one\-off client engagements. (E\-commerce, agency, and IT\-cost\-center experience tends not to translate to this environment.) * **A Bias for Working Software:** You prefer a working prototype over a 20\-page design doc. You turn ambiguity into clarity through shipped code \- and you're energized, not slowed down, by a problem that doesn't have a clear answer yet. *At HubSpot, we value both flexibility and connection. Whether you're a Remote employee or work from the Office, we want you to start your journey here by building strong connections with your team and peers. If you are joining our Engineering team, you will be required to attend a regional HubSpot office for in\-person onboarding. If you join our broader Product team, you'll also attend other in\-person events, such as your Product Group Summit and other gatherings, to continue building on those connections.* *If you require an accommodation due to travel limitations or other reasons, please inform your recruiter during the hiring process. jobs.title: Electrical Testing Specialist III - Iron Mountain, MI
jobs.description: **Electrical Testing Specialist III \- Iron Mountain, MI** ========================================================== **Date:** Sep 21, 2026 **Location:** Iron Mountain, MI, US, 49801 **Company:** Hubbell Incorporated **Job Overview** ---------------- As an Electrical Testing Specialist III, you are responsible for ensuring the quality and compliance of electrical power systems and related equipment within a laboratory testing environment, or in the field at a Customer jobsite. This role focuses on detailed analytical tasks and testing of protective relaying equipment, electrical panels, and other electrical devices and equipment installed in an equipment enclosure. **A Day In The Life** --------------------- * Perform functional testing and final acceptance testing on electrical panels and related equipment by interpreting schematics and customer standards to simulate desired conditions * Utilize testing equipment and power supplies to inject proper voltages and currents during the functional testing process, protecting against improper wiring or design that would cause damage to equipment * Work and interact with Customers, in the plant and in the field, to develop and execute proper testing processes to meet Customer requirements for all specified and installed equipment * Install Customer\-provided relay settings and upgrade relay firmware as necessary to meet Customer requirements and standards * Assist engineering in the correction of wiring diagrams and schematic drawings in order to meet Customer design requirements * Guide production resources to correctly and safely apply power to electrical equipment * Ensure processes and documentation comply with all quality department procedures and any Customer requirements * Provide mentoring, oversight and training for Level I and Level II Electrical Testing Engineers, ensuring proper testing and safety practices are followed * Develop and maintain standard work procedures for any new equipment and new Customer requirements * Work safely in and around energized electrical equipment, adhering to all safety protocols and standards **What will help you thrive in this role?** ------------------------------------------- * Associates Degree in Electrical Engineering or related field, electrical power certification or equivalent work experience * Minimum of 6 years of experience in the testing of electrical equipment * Have completed applicable NFPA and OSHA safety certifications * Advanced understanding of 3\-phase power principles, and the function and operation of electrical relaying devices and associated equipment * Expertise in relay test software and ability to program microprocessor\-based relaying equipment * Strong analytical skills to accurately test all panels and circuits to simulate conditions and document all test procedure results * Excellent troubleshooting skills, with the ability to identify and resolve issues effectively * Excellent written and verbal communication skills * Demonstrated leadership and collaboration skills with all levels of stakeholders **Hubbell Incorporated** Hubbell creates critical infrastructure solutions that power our customers, communities, people and the planet. Our company is strategically aligned around enabling grid modernization and electrification. As more products plug in to an aging grid, Hubbell solutions enable the transition to a more reliable, resilient and efficient energy infrastructure. Founded in 1888 our innovation has made us a leading global manufacturer of high quality electrical and utility solutions enabling customers to operate critical infrastructure reliably and efficiently. Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications and Hubbell Electrical Solutions (HES) are essential to managing power across a wide range of industries and applications. Our vertical market solutions can be applied to markets including Data Centers, Renewables, Commercial Buildings, Industrial, Telecom and Transportation. Supporting both of our business segments is our corporate and Hubbell Unified Business Solutions teams that provide consistent process, tools technologies across our businesses. We are committed to operating sustainably and ethically while promoting an inclusive and supportive culture for our people to grow and develop in their careers. Our employees proudly work and serve our communities from our headquarters in Shelton, CT, across the United States and around the globe. **Hubbell Utility Solutions** Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications. HUS provides the critical components that allow the grid to reliably transmit and distribute energy, as well as the communications and controls technologies to make the grid smarter and more flexible. jobs.title: Principal Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: **Become a part of our caring community** ========================================= The Principal Storage Engineer is a senior technical leader responsible for defining and advancing the enterprise storage architecture and long\-term data infrastructure strategy. This role establishes standards, develops five\-year technology roadmaps, and designs secure, resilient, scalable, and cost\-effective storage platforms for business\-critical, analytics, and artificial intelligence workloads. The engineer serves as the organization’s storage subject\-matter expert and partners with infrastructure, cloud, security, data, application, architecture, finance, and vendor teams to translate business requirements into sustainable technology capabilities. The Principal Storage Engineer is a senior technical leader responsible for defining and advancing the enterprise storage architecture and long\-term data infrastructure strategy. This role establishes standards, develops five\-year technology roadmaps, and designs secure, resilient, scalable, and cost\-effective storage platforms for business\-critical, analytics, and artificial intelligence workloads. The engineer serves as the organization’s storage subject\-matter expert and partners with infrastructure, cloud, security, data, application, architecture, finance, and vendor teams to translate business requirements into sustainable technology capabilities. **Key Responsibilities** * Define the enterprise storage vision, reference architecture, engineering standards, and five\-year roadmap across block, file, object, software\-defined, and hybrid storage services. * Lead architecture decisions for on\-premises AI infrastructure, including high\-throughput and low\-latency storage for model training, inference, data pipelines, GPU platforms, and large unstructured datasets. * Develop data placement, lifecycle, tiering, retention, encryption, immutability, replication, archival, and secure disposition patterns aligned with data governance, privacy, regulatory, and business requirements. * Design highly available and recoverable storage solutions that meet performance, capacity, resilience, disaster recovery, and service\-level objectives. * Create workload\-aligned storage service tiers and reusable architecture patterns for virtualized, containerized, database, analytics, and AI environments. * Own capacity forecasting, performance modeling, technology refresh planning, and financial analysis to optimize capital and operating expenses. * Evaluate emerging storage technologies and conduct proofs of concept, benchmarks, risk assessments, and total\-cost\-of\-ownership analyses. * Provide technical leadership for platform modernization, migrations, consolidations, upgrades, and decommissioning initiatives with minimal business disruption. * Establish observability, automation, infrastructure\-as\-code, configuration management, and self\-service capabilities that improve reliability and reduce operational effort. * Partner with cybersecurity, risk, compliance, and data governance teams to strengthen controls, evidence, recoverability, and ransomware resilience. * Serve as the escalation point for complex storage performance, availability, interoperability, and data integrity issues; lead root\-cause analysis and permanent corrective actions. * Develop architecture documentation, standards, decision records, executive presentations, and investment recommendations for technical and business leadership. * Mentor engineers, lead design reviews, and raise engineering practices across storage, backup, compute, network, cloud, and platform teams. * Manage strategic technical relationships with Dell Technologies, Pure Storage, NetApp, IBM, and other infrastructure partners, including roadmap alignment, solution validation, support escalation, and commercial input. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. * Typically 10 or more years of enterprise infrastructure experience, including significant responsibility for storage engineering and architecture in large, complex environments. * Demonstrated success creating multi\-year technology strategies, reference architectures, roadmaps, standards, and investment plans. * Deep expertise in SAN, NAS, object storage, storage networking, replication, snapshots, data reduction, quality of service, and high\-availability design. * Hands\-on architecture and engineering experience with Dell Technologies, Pure Storage, NetApp, and IBM storage platforms. * Strong understanding of data governance, data classification, retention, legal hold, encryption, access control, privacy, compliance, and secure data disposal. * Experience designing storage for on\-premises AI and high\-performance data platforms, including GPU\-intensive workloads, parallel data access, high\-bandwidth networking, and large\-scale data pipelines. * Expert on initiatives with controlled risk and minimal service disruption. * Strong governance adoption, audit readiness, vendor accountability, and stakeholder confidence in storage investment decisions. **Use your skills to make an impact** ===================================== **Bachelor’s degree** in computer science, information systems, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. **10\+ years of enterprise infrastructure experience**, including significant responsibility for **storage engineering** and architecture in large, complex environments. Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self\-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information. Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required. **Scheduled Weekly Hours** 40**Pay Range** The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc. $142,300 \- $195,700 per year This job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.**Description of Benefits** Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole\-person well\-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short\-term and long\-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.**About us** ============ About Humana: Humana Inc. jobs.title: Product Development Engineer (Design Specialist - Packaging Hot Runner)
jobs.description: Husky TechnologiesTM is a company with a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships, a strong sense of community and a unique culture and values. We are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky TechnologiesTM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation. Husky TechnologiesTM United States manufacturing facility is located in Milton, Vermont on a large, beautiful campus located just 30 minutes north of downtown Burlington, Vermont. Features include an onsite cafeteria, open office concept, fitness center, intramural sports activities and clean, state\-of\-the\-art manufacturing facilities with outstanding safety records. We offer a great work environment, competitive total compensation and attractive benefits package. Additional things you might like to know about working at Husky TechnologiesTM in Milton, Vermont; * 200,000 square foot bright, clean machine shop * Shift work premiums (25% afternoon shift and 40% evening shift) * Annual incentive bonus * Outstanding 401k contribution and match program * 700 acres of private land to walk, bike, run or cross country ski * On site gym facility * On site cafeteria * Opportunity to work for a world class company with great people Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team! Range: $125,000\-$155,000 Vacancy: ADD Are you interested in developing new products and technologies? Have experience defining and developing tooling for the packaging market? Do you enjoy working in a dynamic learning environment? Are you interested in joining a team of innovative engineers working for the leading global supplier of injection molding equipment for the plastic industry? If you answered yes, this role is for you. Our Development Engineering team is looking to hire an experienced Product Development Engineer. The successful candidate will lead the technical development of packaging products working with business development, completing engineering, and subsequent launch into our manufacturing operations. **Role Description:** * System level design with limited guidance, frequently in the absence of specific design standards. * Product Architect * Participate in the formulation and/or evaluation of business cases. * Work within a team of Engineers/Design Specialists in the development of new Injection Molding tooling products following appropriate steps within a formal product development process. * Guide and approve the content of design documents and validation plans. * Contribute to, verify and monitor engineering documentation. * Apply scientific/engineering principles design execution. * Sizing and selection of components (for example, but not limited to linear motors, sensors, bearings, gearboxes, belts, seals, servo motors, pneumatic and hydraulic components etc.) as well as material selection and application of design standards. * Provide leadership, mentoring and training to team members. * Create system level concept designs in various levels of detail including function block diagrams, CAD layouts, functional decomposition. * Lead and contribute to design reviews and brainstorming sessions. Responsible for decision making in the context of product definition and architecture. * Participate in or lead continuous improvement activities. * Verify all concept and systems level process steps of the product development process and Product Release process are followed. * Drives the product development process levering team collaboration. * Design risk mitigation including participation or facilitation of FMEA. * Champion of product compliance with regulatory requirements. * Cross discipline interaction and communication including cross discipline inputs – Business Development, Analysis, Electrical, Software, Fluid Power, Metallurgy, Manufacturing, Validation/Test. * Represent Husky technically in front of customers, suppliers and technical partners. * Represent the Innovation and Sustainability department in front of internal customers including the executive. **Education:** * Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering **Qualifications and Skills:** * 10 \+ years of design experience in a relevant industry. * Excellent communication (verbal and written) and strong presentation skills. * Specialized knowledge of products, tools, standards, processes and technology. * Specialized knowledge within injection molding, tooling and or plastics processing market. * Skilled in CAD modeling techniques – Unigraphics preferred. * Expert in calculating design parameters and applying engineering principles to design. * Strong time management and organizational skills for maximum efficiency. * Illustrates attention to detail when completing tasks. * Strong problem\-solving skills. * Advanced creativity and innovation skills. * Strong sense of ownership. * Advanced understanding of manufacturing and assembly processes related to injection molding tooling. * A flexible team player. * Demonstrated ability to lead and work both autonomously, and as part of a highly cohesive cross functional team. * Experience selecting appropriate materials and sizing various components. (for example, but not limited to, linear motors, sensors, bearings, gearboxes, belts, seals, servo motors, pneumatic and hydraulic components, etc.) as well as material selection and application of design standards. * Well\-rounded – hands\-on mechanical ability and passion for interests and hobbies outside of work. Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please. If you need special assistance or an accommodation in applying, please contact our Human Resources Department at talent@husky.ca. Equal Opportunity Employer as to all protected groups, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. The contractor will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor’s legal duty to furnish information. 41 CFR 60\-1\.35(c).

jobs.title: Strategic Account Executive
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ **Strategic Account Executive \- Government Segment** ===================================================== **Location:** United States **Work Arrangement:** Remote **About the Role** ------------------ The Strategic Account Executive is responsible for developing and maintaining key business relationships within a specialized area of business for existing and prospective accounts — with the objective of consistently meeting or exceeding sales goals. **Technology Tools** -------------------- * CRM Platforms * Opportunity Management \& Account Planning Tools * Microsoft Windows * Microsoft Office **Your Role Responsibilities? Here's What You'll Do.** ------------------------------------------------------ * Lead the overall strategy for designated accounts — owning and developing the sales plan for existing and prospective accounts while operating as a trusted advisor to senior and executive\-level leadership, leveraging long\-term vision, strategy, and roadmaps to generate and maintain constant pipeline. * Develop and communicate accurate sales forecasting on a real\-time basis — recording all customer account information in the CRM, including opportunities, commitments, meaningful conversations, customer visits, and sales calls while leveraging expertise and best practice knowledge to educate customers on the benefits of the company's solutions and create new opportunities. * Partner with sales solution engineers in the development and delivery of software demonstrations — actively contributing to the demonstration process while engaging company specialists and support resources to advance opportunities and determining the viability of RFP requests to directly influence the development of responses. * Develop the closing plan and strategy for accounts — leading negotiation and contracting processes to ensure deals close on time as forecasted while building and maintaining strategic internal working relationships to enhance sales execution across key stakeholders and leadership levels. * Attend and actively contribute to trade shows — ensuring customers or potential customers are participating in company marketing efforts, tailoring plans to meet customer needs, and proactively educating and influencing key executives on future business and technical needs to pursue opportunities for company expansion and integration. * Operate as an innovative thought leader and subject matter expert for the sales team — contributing significantly to the overall strategy and vision of the sales team, mentoring, coaching, and influencing team members, and strategizing to implement market trends and best practices. **Role Essentials** ------------------- *You'll be set up for success if you have:* * Bachelor's degree or significant equivalent experience — with significant experience as a Sales Account Manager in a complex technical environment and a proven track record of year\-over\-year sales generation success * Deep knowledge and expertise in sales, a jobs.title: Senior/Staff Physical Verification and PDK Engineer
jobs.description: HyperLight is at the forefront of the commercialization of thin\-film lithium niobate (TFLN) integrated photonics — a material and process technology that is enabling high\-performance, scalable optical components across AI/datacom infrastructure, hyperscale computing, quantum computing, sensing, and beyond. Photonics, TFLN, and electro\-optic device experience are not required. We have deep in\-house expertise and will teach you. jobs.title: Senior Product Owner – ERP Finance Transformation
jobs.description: **Senior Product Owner** ***Workday Finance Transformation \| Enterprise Data Hub on Azure \| Insurance*** **Location: Cary, NC (hybrid; onsite several days per week)** **Experience: 10\+ years** **Full time with Altimetric** **Salary: $120K** **Must have exp with ERP Finance** **The Role** We are looking for a senior Product Owner with deep ERP Finance functional experience to own the Finance data, integration, and reporting backlog for this transformation. You will sit between Finance business teams, Workday functional consultants, and the Azure data engineering team, turning close, reporting, and control requirements into a trusted, well\-governed set of finance data products. You do not need to be a Workday expert. You do need to know Finance cold in at least one major ERP (PeopleSoft, Workday, SAP, Oracle, or Microsoft Dynamics), and you need the maturity to drive decisions and hold a roadmap steady across a multi\-phase, high\-visibility program. **What You Will Do** **Product ownership \& delivery** Own, groom, and prioritize the Finance backlog for data, integrations, and reporting across the Data Hub and Workday interfaces. Translate Finance requirements into epics, user stories, business rules, and acceptance criteria that the data engineering team can build from without rework. Maintain a clear, sequenced roadmap tied to close cycles, cutover milestones, and downstream consumer dependencies. Run backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and demos; make scope and trade\-off calls and document the rationale. **Finance functional leadership** Bring hands\-on functional depth across General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, financial close, intercompany, reconciliations, controls, and financial and statutory reporting. Partner with Controllership, FP\&A, Treasury, Procurement, and Finance Systems stakeholders to understand processes, data definitions, reporting needs, and current pain points. Support mapping of PeopleSoft Finance data to the Workday Finance data model and the Data Hub, including chart of accounts, worktags, and hierarchy redesign decisions. Challenge legacy customizations and manual spreadsheet workarounds rather than carrying them forward by default. **Data quality, governance \& reporting** Define finance data\-quality rules, reconciliation requirements, balancing controls, and reporting validation criteria. Work with engineers to shape curated finance data products and certified datasets for analytics, regulatory, and statutory reporting. Establish data definitions, lineage expectations, and ownership so Finance can trust what the hub publishes. Contribute to the reusable patterns that the Actuarial, Investment, Reinsurance, and Risk phases will adopt. **Testing, cutover \& adoption** Plan and coordinate UAT with Finance users: scenarios, test data, defect triage, and sign\-off. Lead finance data validation and parallel reconciliation through conversion, cutover, and post\-go\-live stabilization. Drive adoption of the new data products and retire dependency on legacy PeopleSoft extracts and manual reporting. Act as the connective tissue between Finance business teams, ERP functional consultants, and technical delivery. **What You Bring** **Required** 8\+ years in ERP Finance, Finance Systems, finance data, business analysis, functional consulting, or product ownership, including time as the accountable Product Owner or functional lead on a significant workstream. Strong functional knowledge of Finance modules in at least one major ERP platform: Workday, PeopleSoft, SAP, Oracle, or Microsoft Dynamics. Solid command of GL, AP, AR, Fixed Assets, financial close, reconciliations, financial controls, and financial reporting. Demonstrated experience on ERP implementation, modernization, migration, or finance transformation programs, ideally including at least one full lifecycle through go\-live. Proven ability to elicit requirements and produce user stories, acceptance criteria, process and data documentation, and UAT scenarios. Comfort operating across both worlds: credible with CFO\-organization stakeholders and equally effective with data engineers on mappings, transformations, and defects. Experience in Agile delivery using Jira, Azure DevOps, or a comparable backlog\-management tool. Excellent communication, stakeholder management, facilitation, and problem\-solving skills; able to drive decisions in ambiguity. Ability to work a hybrid schedule from Cary, NC. **Preferred** Insurance or financial services experience, with exposure to statutory reporting, insurance accounting (STAT/GAAP), or data from actuarial, investment, reinsurance, or risk functions. Hands\-on experience with PeopleSoft Financials and/or Workday Financial Management, including Workday integration patterns (EIB, Core Connectors, Prism) or FDM design. Experience with finance data migration, data integration, data warehousing, or building certified data products. Familiarity with Azure, Databricks, ADF, ADLS Gen 2, Synapse, Microsoft Fabric, or Snowflake, enough to reason about feasibility and cost with engineers. Exposure to FP\&A, budgeting, planning, consolidation, procurement, or enterprise reporting tools (e.g., Adaptive, Anaplan, Power BI, OneStream). Product Owner, Agile/Scrum (CSPO, PSPO), ERP Finance, or accounting certification (CPA, CMA) a plus.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** We are seeking a dynamic and technically skilled Forward Deployed Engineer to join our innovative team. Your expertise will enable us to deliver seamless digital experiences and robust infrastructure that empower our clients and internal teams alike. **Key Responsibilities** * Partner with business units to identify workflow gaps and rapidly prototype, configure, or build integrations between the core banking platform (e.g., Jack Henry, FIS, Fiserv), digital banking, loan origination, and other third\-party systems. * Serve as the primary technical liaison during fintech/vendor implementations — attending vendor working sessions, writing integration code (APIs, ETL, middleware), and resolving issues on\-site or in real time. * Build and maintain secure data pipelines between systems, ensuring data mapping, reconciliation, and audit trails are accurate. * Design solutions with compliance requirements embedded from the start (privacy, access controls, audit logging, data retention) rather than retrofitted after deployment. * Support due diligence, testing, and validation of new vendor technologies prior to production release. * Document system architecture, data flows, and integration logic for audit, examiner, and internal control purposes. * Participate in incident response and change management processes for any system it touches. * Provide training and technical support to end users following deployment. * Escalate and remediate security or compliance gaps identified during implementation. **Qualifications** Required: * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related degree. * 3\+ years of software engineering, systems integration, or solutions engineering experience. * Experience with artificial intelligence including creating and managing Agents. * Proficiency with REST/SOAP APIs, SQL, and at least one modern programming language (Python, Java, or similar). * Proficiency with standard Microsoft Office applications. * Working knowledge of information security principles (encryption, access controls, secure coding). Our commitment to independence, entrepreneurship, and personalized service drives everything we do. We value energetic problem\-solvers eager to work at the intersection of technology development and enterprise deployment—helping us build resilient systems that serve our clients’ needs today—and tomorrow. Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager
jobs.description: **Who We Are** -------------- Imprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers. We started with co\-branded credit cards and rebuilt them to be smarter, more rewarding, and brand\-first. We partner with companies like Crate \& Barrel, Rakuten, Booking.com, H\-E\-B, Fetch, and Shell to launch modern credit programs that deepen loyalty, unlock savings, and drive growth. But the card is just the beginning. We combine advanced payments infrastructure, intelligent underwriting, and deep customer data to create delightful and personalized experiences for members as well as efficient and profitable relationships for our brand partners. Our robust technology and world\-class operations allow us and our brand partners to offer powerful financial products without becoming a bank. In the U.S., co\-branded cards alone account for over $300 billion in annual spend, and most still run on decades\-old legacy bank systems. Imprint is the modern alternative: flexible, embeddable, and built for how people actually pay today. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Thrive Capital, Ribbit, and Khosla Ventures, we're building a world\-class team to redefine how people pay and how brands grow. If you want to move fast, solve hard problems, and own real outcomes, we want to meet you. Engineering leadership is the lever for this next stage. As Imprint expands into new financial products, launches new brand partnerships, and scales the infrastructure underneath all of it, the quality of our engineering teams determines the quality of everything we ship. AI has made execution faster; the differentiator is the judgment to decide what to build, how to sequence it, and when to say no. That judgment, applied to how teams are built, how they make decisions, and how they're managed, is what Senior Engineering Managers own. **The Opportunity** ------------------- * **Bring structure to complex, ambiguous domains:** Imprint's products sit at the intersection of payments, credit, compliance, and brand strategy. You'll lead a team through problems that aren't fully scoped, where the right answer requires synthesizing technical constraints with product, legal, and financial realities. * **Operate as a true cross\-functional partner:** Not just "align with product." You'll work directly with product, compliance, legal, capital markets, and solutions engineering on decisions where the lanes overlap significantly. You will help represent Engineering in the room when strategy is set. * **Lead with technical credibility, amplified by AI:** AI has collapsed the distance between management and IC work. Managers at Imprint use AI tools to investigate codebases, assess the complexity and viability of work, and bring clarity to ambiguous asks. You don't need to be on the critical path writing code (though some managers are), but you need real technical judgment and the modern tools to exercise it. * **Build and develop a team as a craft:** You have a real philosophy on how to hire, develop, and retain strong engineers. You have opinions on how work is scoped and delivered, how to balance short and long\-term priorities, and how to give feedback that actually changes outcomes. Clear communication, written and verbal, is key. * **Operate in the details:** This is not a role where technical context and project management are abstracted to other roles or organizational layers. You define the roadmap, scope the work, and manage individuals to outcomes. Even if you've led multiple teams before, the question is: can you take a new team and run it end\-to\-end? * **Own outcomes at a company in a defining growth moment:** Imprint is growing rapidly, launching new products, and deepening our platform. You'll have the scope and autonomy to shape how your team builds, and your work will be visible in the trajectory of the business. **Your Profile** ---------------- * 5\+ years of engineering management experience, with a track record of building, developing, and retaining strong engineering teams * You've managed through periods of rapid growth, ambiguity, or significant technical change, and your teams came out stronger * A strong technical foundation: you were a strong engineer before moving into management, and you've maintained technical credibility through hands\-on engagement or modern AI tools * You've managed Staff\-level ICs and helped senior engineers grow into bigger roles * Experience in domains with real complexity: financial systems, distributed infrastructure, regulated environments, or similarly demanding technical areas * You communicate with clarity and directness in writing, in 1:1s, in rooms with executives, and in rooms with engineers * You drive delivery through your team, not around them. You know how to scope work, set priorities, and create the conditions for engineers to do their best work * Experience using AI tools to stay close to technical work (investigating codebases, assessing feasibility, bringing clarity to asks), or genuine enthusiasm to adopt them Some of our teams are full\-stack (frontend, backend, and mobile); others are backend\-focused. We're looking for strong engineering leaders regardless of your specific technical background. We don't expect every candidate to match every bullet. If you're excited about what we're building and confident you can contribute, we'd love to talk. **Stack** --------- Our backend runs on Go, MySQL, DynamoDB, Temporal, Kafka, Kubernetes, and AWS. Read more about how we build at Imprint on our engineering blog. **Perks \& Benefits** --------------------- * Competitive compensation and equity packages * Leading configured work computers of your choice * Flexible paid time off * Fully covered, high\-quality healthcare, including fully covered dependent coverage * Additional health coverage includes access to One Medical and the option to enroll in an FSA * 20 weeks of paid parental leave for the primary caregiver and 8 weeks for all new parents * Access to industry\-leading technology across all of our business units, stemming from our philosophy that we should invest in resources for our team that foster innovation, optimization, and productivity *Imprint is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Imprint is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. Imprint welcomes talented individuals from all backgrounds who want to build the future of payments and rewards. If you are passionate about FinTech and eager to grow, let’s move the world forward, together.* Compensation Range: $220K \- $235K

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer & Data Scientist – Commercial Intelligence
jobs.description: **Senior Data Engineer \& Data Scientist – Commercial Intelligence** ==================================================================== JOB\_DESCRIPTION.SHARE.HTML CAROUSEL\_PARAGRAPH JOB\_DESCRIPTION.SHARE.HTML* International * Lisle, Illinois * Digital / IT / Strategy * Regular Full Time Employee * 9/21/2026 * USD $160,000\.00/Yr. * USD $240,000\.00/Yr. * 59878 International Motors, LLC **Job Description** ------------------- **Position Overview** International is on a bold journey to redefine commercial transportation. Evolving beyond our legacy as a truck and bus manufacturer, we are becoming a provider of integrated, sustainable transportation solutions powered by digital innovation, data, and AI. We are investing in the technologies, products, and talent that will shape the future of our industry. We have an exciting opportunity for a Senior Data Engineer \& Data Scientist – Commercial Intelligence to help build the data and intelligence foundation behind Retail Sales Management (RSM), International’s digital sales platform supporting our dealer network. This is a highly hands\-on technical role at the intersection of data engineering, data science, commercial strategy, and digital product development. You will create trusted, scalable commercial data products that bring together customer, prospect, dealer, vehicle, sales, service, parts, CRM, and other enterprise data and transform it into actionable intelligence embedded directly into sales workflows. The challenge goes beyond building pipelines and dashboards. You will help answer the questions that matter to a salesperson: Who should I engage next? Why? What opportunity exists? And what action is most likely to create value? We are looking for someone with a strong sense of ownership, curiosity, and a solution\-oriented mindset: “we may not have done this before—let’s figure it out and learn quickly.” This is a full\-time position be based in Lisle, Illinois Monday through Thursday with hybrid in\-office and remote work flexibility on Friday **Responsibilities** * Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and data products supporting RSM and broader commercial intelligence capabilities. * Integrate, normalize, and model customer, prospect, dealer, vehicle, sales, service, parts, CRM, digital interaction, and external data. * Develop robust approaches for identity resolution, entity matching, deduplication, normalization, lineage, and data quality across complex commercial datasets. * Build and operationalize analytical and machine\-learning models for lead scoring, opportunity identification, customer segmentation, propensity, prioritization, and next\-best\-action recommendations. * Translate complex commercial data into actionable intelligence embedded directly into dealer and sales workflows—not simply reports and dashboards. * Partner with Product, Sales, Commercial, UX, Data, and Engineering teams to turn high\-value business problems into scalable data and analytical solutions. * Design reusable commercial data models, semantic structures, and ontology concepts for customers, prospects, vehicles, dealers, opportunities, and sales activity. * Define and monitor data quality, model performance, and business\-impact metrics and resolve issues affecting the trustworthiness of commercial intelligence. * Prototype and evaluate AI/ML approaches, including generative AI and LLM\-based capabilities, that improve commercial decision\-making and sales effectiveness. * Establish engineering and data\-science practices covering testing, observability, documentation, governance, versioning, CI/CD, and production deployment. * Own what you build, including operational readiness, production support, incident response, quality standards, and technical lifecycle management. * Serve as a senior technical leader within the RSM product team, influencing architecture and technical direction while mentoring other practitioners. * Communicate complex analytical findings and technical decisions clearly to technical teams, product leaders, jobs.description: At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. The Senior Structural Engineer is a hands ‑ on senior individual contributor responsible for structural engineering ownership of product structures supporting CDU, switchgear, and related data center infrastructure equipment, including frames, enclosures, skids, and anchorage systems . This role ensures that structures meet all load, seismic, transport, installation, and operational requirements across global deployment environments. The position provides authoritative structural analysis, design validation, and code compliance, while ensuring structural intent is accurately captured in CAD models and released documentation. The role requires a licensed P rofessional Engineer (PE) with deep experience in structural systems supporting heavy electrical and mechanical equipment. Close collaboration with mechanical, manufacturing, quality and PLM teams is essential to mitigate structural risk, support regulatory and customer approval processes, and prevent late \-stage redesigns or field driven corrective actions. **Key Responsibilities** **Structural Engineering Ownership \& Analysis** * Own structural design and analysis for data center centric power and cooling systems, including frames, enclosures, skids and mounting structures. * Proficient in structural analysis software such as RISA 3D, SAP2000, RAM Structural, IdeaStatica , Enercalc , Hilti Profis , ETABS or similar. * Perform and review structural calculations for static, dynamic, seismic, transport , wind, snow, installation, and live load cases. * Ensure structural designs meet applicable codes, standards and jurisdictional requirements for global deployment. * Required familiarity with ASCE 7, AISC 360 and ACI 318\. * Exercise professional engineering judgment as the responsible structural authority. **Seismic Qualification \& Load Management** * Lead seismic qualification efforts, including floor response spectra evaluation and anchorage requirements. * Evaluate floor loading limits, elevated installations and site ‑ specific structural constraints. * Ensure designs safely support heavy components such as large bus structures and transformers under all operating and fault conditions. * Assess interactions with forklifts, cranes, and rigging operations during manufacturing, transport, and installation. **Structural CAD \& Design Intent** * Ensure structural intent is accurately reflected in CAD models, drawings, and released documentation. * Review and guide structural CAD layouts, weldments, fastener strategies and anchoring details. * Partner with mechanical and CAD teams to maintain alignment between analytical assumptions and physical design implementation. * Verify manufacturing drawings clearly communicate load paths, interfaces and installation requirements. **Regulatory \& Customer Approval Support** * Act as the technical authority for regulatory, AHJ and customer structural signoff requirements. * Prepare, review, and certify structural documentation required for compliance and customer acceptance. * R espond to structural inquiries, findings and deviations from customers, inspectors and third ‑ party reviewers . **Cross** **Functional Risk Mitigation** * Collaborate with manufacturing, quality, and supply chain teams to identify and mitigate structural risks early. * Support prototype builds, qualification testing, and production ramp up through structural guidance and issue resolution. * Proactively identify structural risks that could lead to late\-stage redesigns, production delays, or field retrofits. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Civil , Structural, or Mechanical Engineering f rom ABET accredited university . * Active Professional Engineer (PE) license in the United States. * 10\+ years of experience in structural engineering for industrial or infrastructure class equipment with 3\+ years in data center design . * Demonstrated experience performing and certifying structural analyses for heavy equipment assemblies. * Ability to independently own structural decisions and provide stamped deliverables if required . **Preferred Experience** * Masters ’s degree in Civil , Structural, or Mechanical Engineering from ABET accredited university. * Structural engineering experience supporting CDU, switchgear or mission critical power infrastructure. * Deep understanding of ASCE 7 Chapter 13: Seismic Design Requirements For Nonstructural Components. * Familiarity with CAD (SolidWorks) , PLM (Windchill) , and BlueBeam . * Active Structural Engineer (SE) license in the United States. * Hands on experience with seismic qualification , anchorage design and elevated or constrained installations. * Experience designing structures supporting large bus bar systems , heavy transformers, or other high mass electrical components. * Familiarity with manufacturing and installation interactions, including crane, forklift, and rigging requirements. * Experience supporting customer or regulatory structural acceptance and signoff processes. **Core Competencies** * Senior level structural engineering judgment and accountability * Strong expertise in seismic, load and transport analysis * Clear translation of structural intent into CAD and documentation * Risk based thinking with focus on early mitigation * Effective cross functional collaboration without managerial authority * High ownership, rigor, and attention to detail in regulated environments The pay range for this role is $145,000 \- $261,000\.
