jobs.title: Full-Stack Engineer, Client Solutions
jobs.description: Rechat is the operating system for real estate. Marketing, CRM, transactions, listings and AI in a single product, replacing the disconnected stack of tools most agents are forced to stitch together. Some of the largest brokerages and networks in North America run their business on us, and tens of thousands of agents use Rechat every week. We have spent the last two years rebuilding the product to be AI\-native, and we are growing quickly. **REMOTE (Work may be performed anywhere)** Every brokerage leader we talk to knows AI should change how their business runs. Almost none of them know where to start, and the generic tools they have tried don't fit how a brokerage actually works. **You are here to close that gap, fast and over and over again.** You will get on calls with brokerage executives and managers, figure out what they actually need (which is often not what they first ask for), and turn it into working software on Rechat's platform. Manager dashboards, business trackers, listing tools, workflows, and AI agents that do real work in the background: watching deals, summarizing activity, flagging risk, taking action. **Speed is the job.** With AI, a good idea can go from a client call to a working prototype in a morning and to production in days. We have already done it. We need someone who can do that every week, across many clients, and keep the quality high while they do it. You will write most of your code with AI, and you will ship a lot of it. You own what you build, end to end: the call, the spec, the prototype, the launch, and the fix when something breaks. Some of what you build will be for one brokerage. The best of it will become part of Rechat for everyone. This is a new function for us and you will help define how it works. **What You'll Own:** * **Discovery.** Running calls with brokerage leaders, asking the questions that get past the first request to the real problem, and writing it down as a clear spec. * **Rapid prototyping.** Turning a spec into something a client can react to in days, not weeks, using AI to do most of the building. * **Shipping.** Taking prototypes to production on Rechat's APIs, many of them, at a fast pace. * **AI agents.** Building features where AI acts on its own: what triggers it, what data and tools it uses, what it does, and what happens when it gets something wrong. * **Everything after launch.** Debugging and supporting what you ship. If it breaks, you fix it. * **Productizing.** Spotting when three brokerages are asking for the same thing, and building it once so every client can use it. * **Adoption.** Making sure what you built actually gets used. An app nobody opens is a failed project, however clean the code is. **Who You Are:** You are an engineer and a builder who is good at client facing roles as well. The kind of person who has shipped side projects on a weekend, hacked together a tool their team ended up relying on, and gets restless when something takes a month that could take a day. You are not the engineer who wants to spend three weeks perfecting an architecture. You are also not someone who only prompts and hopes. You understand code well enough to read what AI writes, catch what is wrong, and stand behind it in production. **Our Stack:** Node.js, TypeScript, React and PostgreSQL **Education/Experience:** Be prepared to walk us through each of these in detail. * **3 to 5 years as a full\-stack software engineer**, with things in production that real people used. * **Strong in Node.js and TypeScript.** Comfortable across the stack: APIs, data, frontend, and getting something deployed. * **You build with AI every day** and it has made you dramatically faster. You can show us something you built in days that would once have taken weeks. * **You have worked directly with customers or non\-technical people** to turn a vague need into something shipped. * **You have debugged and supported something after launch**, not just handed it off **Strongly Preffered:** * **You have built an AI agent.** By that we mean something where an LLM calls tools or APIs and takes action on its own, and you had to deal with it being wrong. Not a chatbot wrapper. Tell us what it did, how you knew whether it was working, and what you changed when it wasn't. * **Real estate or proptech experience.** You know the difference between a listing and an off\-market, an offer and a contract, and how a brokerage actually makes money. You won't need this explained on a client call. **How You Work:** * Strong product sense. You care whether people actually use what you built. You put love into what you build and pay attention to all the details. * You ask 'what decision does this help someone make?' before you ask 'what should it look like? * You would rather ship ten useful things than perfect oneYou can say no to a client, explain why, and offer something better * You use AI tools daily and know when not to trust them * Excellent spoken and written English. You are comfortable leading a call with a CEO * You are hands\-on and resourceful. When you are stuck, you find a way **Probably not the right fit:** * You prefer to perfect one thing over shipping many * You have never talked directly to a customer and prefer to receive finished specs * You don't use AI heavily in how you build today * You need detailed requirements and clean processes to be effective. You will create them here * You want to manage a team soon. This is an individual contributor role **Why You'll Love Working Here:** * Competitive compensation and benefits * Fully remote with flexible work/life balance * A diverse, inclusive, and highly collaborative culture * Meaningful work with a product used by real professionals every day * Flexible Paid Time Off *We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. All employment decisions are made without regard to legally protected characteristics. Background and reference checks required.*

jobs.title: Software Engineering Intern
jobs.description: RentVision is looking for Software Engineering Interns to join our Product Team as a summer ‘26 intern! Our paid internships will run from May 17th, 2027 \- August 13th 2027\. **About You:** * You’re a Computer Science or Software Engineering student who has coded in Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, CSS, MySQL, and React. * You are willing to work hard, be a team player, and want to learn and grow. * You like to have fun, play games, and eat snacks. If you have an affinity for card games, you're in. **Requirements** **About the Role:** * Code high\-volume and scalable software. * Create web applications and back\-end services using a variety of coding languages. * Investigate and resolve software issues/bugs. * Partner closely with cross functional teams in design, product, and other business functions. **What’s it like at RentVision?** We think it’s pretty awesome! Our Glassdoor reviews reflect that sentiment, and we’ve also recently been certified as a Great Place to Work™. Our office environment is casual, team\-based, and full of high performers. Our employees enjoy a healthy work\-life balance and a good mix of productivity and fun. **What should I expect as an Intern?** Our internships are paid and our wages are competitive. We’ll treat you like a regular employee and expect you to act like one. We think the best learning opportunities come through experience and mentorship, so you’ll be provided with both. Learn, grow, explore your talents, and be taught some valuable skills. We’re a small company and we’re looking for interns that want an opportunity to make major contributions to our small teams. **Benefits** * **1 on 1 Mentorship**. From day one, you’ll be paired with a mentor who is invested in your growth and will help guide you through real\-world projects, feedback, and career development. * **401(k) Match**. We invest in your future by contributing to your retirement savings, helping you get a head start on long\-term financial security. * **Fizzy Fridays**. You work hard all week, so why not have a little fun on Friday? At 3:30 PM we celebrate a week’s worth of work with games, snacks, and fizzy beverages. Hope you like competition! * **Catered Recognition Lunches**. You’re one in a million, and we want you to know that. Every month we celebrate our employees with a free lunch and recognition galore. * **Unlimited Coffee and Espresso**. Need a pick\-me\-up? We’ve got an espresso machine stocked full of cappuccinos, lattes, black coffee, and more. We’ve also got a couple of coffee snobs that love quality pour\-over and are usually game to share a fresh pot. * **Ping Pong Table**. Take a quick break, challenge a coworker, and keep the energy high with some friendly competition. * **“Lincoln’s Best Places to Work” Winner**. We’ve been recognized as one of the top workplaces in Lincoln \- proof that our culture and people make this an outstanding place to work. About RentVision RentVision was founded in 2009, after our Founder and CEO, David Watson, spent multiple weekends hunting for an apartment. After weeks of searching, he signed a lease on a unit he’d never seen. Frustrated by this experience, David believed there had to be a better, easier way to confidently rent an apartment. This sparked the idea for a new innovation—the industry's first Walkthrough Video Tour. RentVision has been innovating, developing, and growing ever since. Today, we create software platforms, build websites, offer strategic advising, deliver media solutions, and travel the country sharing industry knowledge. We are part tech company and part full\-service organization, combining the best of both worlds: excellent software solutions with remarkable client service. **Our Purpose**: To consider others as more important than ourselves. **Our Mission**: To make renting apartments easy. **Our Vision for Our Clients**: To deliver a predictive leasing platform that optimizes marketing and revenue management. **Our Vision for Prospective Residents**: To help people rent an apartment without needing to drive anywhere. **Our Core Values**: * **Be Remarkable** \- We use our intelligence, personality, and unique skills to deliver amazing results. * **Systemize Excellence** \- We build and do what is excellent, efficient, and repeatable. * **Considerate Candor** \- We seek and give direct feedback that is thoughtful and productive. * **Maximize Talent** \- We know our weaknesses. We live in our strengths. * **Team Hustle** \- We deliver success through hard work and camaraderie.

jobs.title: AI Enablement Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** Founded in 2021, Revalize empowers manufacturing businesses to better design, model, develop, and sell—powering greater outcomes across the entire manufacturing value chain. Revalize leads with an AI\-forward mindset—using technology as a catalyst, not a compass. We’re shaping the future of manufacturing technology with industry\-leading CPQ, PLM, and design solutions that transform data into opportunity and accelerate the journey from idea to cash. Revalize serves more than 16,000 global customers and is a portfolio company of TA Associates and Hg. **Job Description** The AI Enablement Engineer will help build, deploy, and support production AI tools, agents, and workflows used across Revalize. Working closely with business stakeholders and senior engineers, they help translate business needs into secure, reliable, and scalable solutions that integrate with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce and Microsoft 365\. The role contributes across the full solution lifecycle \- from scoping and development through launch, monitoring, user support, documentation, and continuous improvement \- with guidance from more experienced team members. The ideal candidate is building strong software engineering and applied AI skills, brings a practical mindset, and communicates clearly with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. **Responsibilities** * Help build and ship AI\-powered tools and agents: tool and API integrations, agent workflows, backend services, and lightweight user\-facing interfaces * Help operate what you ship: monitor system health, help investigate incidents, and support internal users \- with guidance from senior engineers * Contribute to integrations between AI systems and enterprise platforms such as CRM (e.g. Salesforce) and Microsoft 365, working within established auth and permission models * Help develop LLM pipelines: retrieval, structured data extraction, scoring logic, prompt and tool design, and validation of outputs before they touch business systems * Use AI coding tools as a core working method, reviewing and governing their output to production quality * Follow security\-first practices: least\-privilege access, service accounts, and audit logging * Work with business stakeholders to understand requests and help turn ambiguous asks into shippable tools * Help internal users adopt AI tooling: answer questions, run short enablement sessions, and evaluate new tools as they emerge * Write documentation as you build \- runbooks and decision notes that let others operate what you made **Qualifications** * 1\+ years building software (internships, academic, or professional projects count), with some exposure to LLM/generative AI features beyond simple prototypes * Working Python skills; familiarity with REST APIs and some exposure to a modern frontend framework (e.g. React with TypeScript) * 1\+ years of experience with AWS and/or Azure (related certifications a plus) * Experience in LLM tool\-calling or agent frameworks, and workflow/automation platforms (e.g. n8n, Power Automate, or similar) * Understanding of LLM fundamentals: RAG, embeddings, structured extraction, prompt design, and judgment about when outputs need human review * Eager to make progress in ambiguous situations and asks good questions rather than waiting for complete specs Communicates clearly with non\-technical colleagues; writes documentation others can actually use * **Nice to have** * Experience with MCP servers, the Anthropic/Claude ecosystem, or enterprise AI platform administration * Exposure to predictive ML (scoring, classification) or evaluation design for AI systems * Salesforce API and data\-model experience; Microsoft Graph or Entra ID experience * Manufacturing, CPQ/PLM, or B2B vertical SaaS domain exposure * Experience supporting or training end users on technical tools **Additional Information** All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Qualified applicants will be asked to complete a 30\-minute online assessment as a part of your application. *Revalize designates standard working hours as 8:00 am to 5:00 pm Eastern Time (ET) for employees based in the United States and 08:00 to 17:00 Central European Time (CET) for employees operating within the EMEA region.* *Revalize is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Revalize participates in the E\-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.* *The compensation offered to the successful candidate will be based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, the candidate’s work experience, education and licenses, work\-related training, key skills, the core duties of the role and its associated responsibilities, additional benefits offered, and the location where the work will be performed. All fulltime (30\+ hours) employees are eligible for PTO, Sick and Parental Leave; Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance; 401(k) Plan; Health Savings Account; Life Insurance; Employee Assistance Program.* *This is a full\-time, bonus eligible position. Base Salary is one part of our competitive total compensation and benefits package and is determined using a range. The listed compensation range represents our good faith estimate for this position and represents the range for new hire salaries across all U.S locations. Please note that the salary information is a general guideline only.* *Qualified applicants will be asked to complete a 30 minute online pre\-employment assessment as part of the recruitment process.*

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend - Data Products
jobs.description: **About Rippling** ------------------ Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system. Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds. Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes. We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses. **About The Role** ------------------ The Data Cloud team is building an end\-to\-end analytics and business intelligence system for our customers and will replace their need for Data Lakes, Data Warehouses and data pipelines. We are building systems for ingestion, transformation, lineage, data catalogs and visualization. Most companies cobble together data pipelines from Fivetran, Airbyte, Airflow, DBT, Snowflake, DataBricks, Kafka and a host of other technologies. Rippling is in the unique position of being the source of the vast majority of this data, hence we can provide an all encompassing solution out of the box. In addition, we are exploring the use of ML and LLMs to provide automated insight generation and conversational experiences to allow data consumers to have a virtual data scientist as their analytics copilot. **What You'll Do** * Work on distributed processing engines and distributed databases * Develop high\-quality software with attention to detail using tech stacks like Python, MongoDB, CDC, and Kafka * Leverage big data technologies like Aurora, Trino, Presto, Pinot, Iceberg, Flink and more. * Build custom programming languages within the Rippling Platform * Create data platforms, data lakes, and data ingestion systems that work at scale * Design, develop, code, and test software systems, improvements, products, and user\-facing experiences * Work alongside software architects and senior developers doing state\-of\-the\-art development work * Contribute to product design and implementation discussions * Find and build unique solutions to implement projects from the idea phase to production **What You'll Need** -------------------- * 6\+ years experience in backend engineering roles * Experience writing testable and performant backend code * Experience working in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment * Experience mentoring less\-experienced developers * Ability to thrive in an environment that grants you a lot of autonomy to explore creative solutions **Additional Information** -------------------------- Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accomodations@rippling.com Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role. This role will receive a competitive salary \+ benefits \+ equity. The salary for US\-based employees will be aligned with one of the ranges below based on location; see which tier applies to your location here. A variety of factors are considered when determining someone’s compensation–including a candidate’s professional background, experience, and location. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed below. **The pay range for this role is:** 168,000 \- 280,000 USD per year(US San Francisco Bay Area) 168,000 \- 280,000 USD per year(US Tier 1\)

jobs.description: **Join us in building the future of finance.** ---------------------------------------------- Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. ### **About the Team** The Security Operations (SecOps) team at Robinhood proactively safeguards our platform and millions of customers. We monitor, detect, and respond to security threats in real time while staying ahead of risks through threat intelligence, Red Team operations, and research partnerships. We are building the next generation of security operations—leveraging AI\-driven automation, Autonomic Security Operations (ASO), and innovative detection frameworks to set the standard across the cybersecurity industry! ### **About the Role** As a Senior Security Engineer (IC5\) on the Detection \& Response team, you will drive our incident response strategy and build robust detection engineering frameworks. In this high\-impact role, you will command high\-stress incident responses, eliminate operational noise by developing an AI\-native detection platform, and help shape the broader AI\-agentic ecosystem for SecOps. You will work closely with cross\-functional partners in Proactive Security, Security Engineering, Insider Trust, Infrastructure, Legal, and Communications to protect Robinhood's ecosystem. **This role is based in our Bellevue, WA, Menlo Park, CA, and Denver, CO office(s), with in\-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.** At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in\-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high\-performing teams. **What you'll do** ------------------ * **Lead Incident Response:** Command security incident response workstreams with decisive leadership, rapidly containing threats, quantifying impact, and communicating effectively with leadership. * **Elevate Detection Rigor:** Build, tune, and maintain our global detection catalog across our cloud and kubernetes environments to ensure high precision and actionable alerting. * **Drive Strategic Innovation:** Architect our Autonomic Security Operations (ASO) roadmap, integrating AI agents and automated issue discovery to transform response capabilities. * **Code \& Architecture Analysis:** Read and reason through complex, multi\-language codebases to identify security vulnerabilities, evaluate threat vectors, and guide remediation. * **On\-Call Support:** Participate in an on\-call rotation (1 week per rotation) to maintain real\-time operational readiness. **What you bring** ------------------ * **5\+ years of experience** in Detection \& Response, Incident Response, or Security Operations. * **Proven Command Presence:** Demonstrated success leading complex incident responses under pressure with clear, action\-oriented executive communication. * **Deep Cloud \& Infrastructure Expertise:** Advanced technical experience securing cloud environments with a focus on Kubernetes. * **Code Reasoning Skills:** Ability to fluently read, analyze, and reason through code across multiple programming languages to solve complex security challenges. * **Detection Engineering Mastery:** Track record of designing, tuning, and operating scalable detection engineering pipelines and SOAR playbooks, as well as leveraging AI technologies to improve speed, scale, and quality. * **AI Experience:** Hands\-on experience designing and implementing agentic AI workflows for security operations. * **Agility:** Ability to thrive in high\-growth, fast\-paced environments with evolving threat landscapes. **Bonus Points** ---------------- * Hands\-on experience with Threat Hunting, Threat Intelligence, Vulnerability Management, or Red Team operations. * Background in high\-growth fintech, crypto platforms, or managed security service providers. Familiarity with DeFi/crypto, blockchain, and related technologies. * **What we offer** ----------------- * Challenging, high\-impact work to grow your career. * Performance\-driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching. * Best\-in\-class benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents. * Lifestyle wallet — a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more. * Employer\-paid life \& disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits. * Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! * Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. jobs.description: San Mateo, CA, United StatesEngineeringID: 42821 Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators. At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there. A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone. Roblox is looking for a Director of Capacity Planning \& Engineering to lead the team responsible for translating platform demand into physical infrastructure reality — from supply\-demand modeling and hardware procurement through data center deployment and FinOps. This is a high\-impact leadership role at the intersection of infrastructure strategy, operational execution, and software engineering. You will lead a team of approximately 20 people organized across four functional areas and will be responsible for scaling Roblox's infrastructure footprint as it continues to grow rapidly. What You'll Own Capacity Planning * Translate platform demand forecasts into hardware requirements * Own the supply\-demand matching process end\-to\-end, working closely with Data Center, Hardware Engineering, and Supply Chain teams * Build and refine capacity models that give the business confidence in infrastructure availability months ahead Deployment \& Delivery * Oversee hardware lifecycle from procurement through physical installation and software provisioning. * Partner with platform and data center operations teams to bring new capacity online reliably and on schedule. * Own delivery execution for major milestones including new data center buildout (Q4\). Data Center Automation (Software Engineering) * Lead a software engineering sub\-team that builds and maintains DCIM (Data Center Infrastructure Management) systems. * Drive automation for rack delivery, decommissioning, and capacity planning tooling. * Identify opportunities to scale automation coverage as Roblox's 25\+ global data centers expand. FinOps * Oversee cloud spend optimization and on\-prem vs. cloud allocation decisions. * Grow and develop the FinOps function, which is lean today but increasing in strategic importance as cloud spend scales. * Partner with Finance to ensure infrastructure spend is visible, justified, and optimized. You Have: * 10\+ years of experience in infrastructure, data center operations, or related fields, with at least 3 years in a director\-level or senior leadership role. * Deep expertise in capacity planning and supply\-demand analysis for large\-scale infrastructure environments. * Hands\-on familiarity with DCIM systems and data center automation — this role is lower in the stack than platform software (not Kubernetes/cloud\-native). * Experience working across supply chain systems, hardware procurement, and deployment execution. * Proven ability to lead and scale cross\-functional teams including software engineers, planners, and operations specialists. * Strong analytical and communication skills; comfortable translating complex infrastructure decisions for C\-suite audiences. * Familiarity with AI/GPU infrastructure \- Roblox is actively building GPU factory capacity aligned with NVIDIA's next\-generation hardware roadmap. * Experience managing a FinOps function or cloud cost optimization at scale. * Background in hyperscale, colocation, or edge data center environments. * Exposure to liquid cooling infrastructure for high\-density compute. You Will * Own a critical piece of infrastructure for a platform used by hundreds of millions of people worldwide. * Scale the team to support ongoing growth and new product features. * Drive improvements in partnership with other engineering teams across Roblox * Create a culture and practice of production excellence, security, and cost\-efficiency * Hire and develop senior engineers, managers, and leaders You are: * + Collaborative, low\-ego environment where candid feedback is welcomed and acted on. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Traffic Proxy
jobs.description: San Mateo, CA, United StatesEngineeringID: 43551 Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators. At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there. A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone. The Traffic Proxy Services team powers the front line of Roblox — operating the global edge network and high\-performance Layer 7 proxies that handle billions of web and API requests daily while defending the platform against large\-scale automated attacks. In this role, you'll help pioneer the next generation of our edge infrastructure: replacing legacy proxy configurations with programmable, memory\-safe Rust services running on Kubernetes, and building intelligent, automated defense systems. Working alongside principal engineers and key partners across Security, Reliability, and Platform teams, you'll tackle high\-stakes systems challenges where efficiency, scale, and uptime are critical. **You Are:** * An experienced systems engineer with 7\+ years building and operating backend or infrastructure software, including time owning a tier\-0 service in production. * Fluent in a systems language. Rust strongly preferred; strong Go experience with the appetite to work in Rust is welcome. * Deeply comfortable with networking fundamentals: TCP, TLS, HTTP/1\.1 and HTTP/2, QUIC and the internals of at least one production L7 proxy (HAProxy, Envoy, NGINX, Pingora or similar). Able to troubleshoot a live network problem. * Familiar with how the kernel and userspace interact, and comfortable tuning the kernel to optimize for efficiency and reliability. * Experienced with high\-performance packet processing in and around the kernel — kernel\-bypass and kernel\-path techniques such as eBPF/XDP. * Able to independently design, build, and operate systems on Kubernetes end to end, and to reason about node\-level behavior when latency and resource isolation matter. * Able to write a design doc that survives review by senior stakeholders across several teams, and to disagree productively when it doesn't. * Motivated by problems where the blast radius is real and the feedback loop is immediate. * Genuinely curious. You pull on the thread until you understand why a system behaves the way it does, and you would rather learn an unfamiliar layer of the stack than route around it. **You Will:** * Design and build high\-performance services that sit directly in the request data path, where performance, reliability, and security are of utmost priority. * Effectively leverage AI tools to speed up research, development, and troubleshooting while keeping a critical eye * Evolve our edge architecture toward something simpler and programmable, migrating policy incrementally with parity testing and exercised rollback. * Improve traffic classification and intelligence to detect and mitigate DDoS and abuse traffic. * Build feedback loops that automate mitigation and reduce MTTR. * Raise the efficiency of the edge * Own your work in production as part of the team's on\-call rotation, and raise the reliability bar through design, code review, incident review. * Collaborate across Networking, Security, Reliability, and Compute to deliver on Infrastructure and company priorities. * Be a gatekeeper for a high code quality bar, architectural designs, and pragmatic vs. long\-term approaches. * Uphold our company vision by putting the Roblox community first and exemplifying our values. jobs.title: Sr. Sourcing Specialist
jobs.description: **Job Description:** Ryan Companies US, Inc. is seeking a proactive, highly motivated, and results\-driven **Sr. Sourcing Specialist** to join our Talent Acquisition team. In this critical role, you will champion top\-of\-funnel candidate identification, engagement, and talent pipeline strategies across our fully integrated platform—spanning Construction, Real Estate Development, and Architecture \& Engineering (A\+E). As our dedicated sourcing partner, you will identify, engage, and nurture relationships with high\-caliber passive talent for Construction, Real Estate Development, and Architecture \& Engineering (A\+E). Core searches include Field Operations (Superintendents, Field Coordinators, Safety Managers), Project Management (Project Managers, Project Executives, Estimators), and Design/Engineering professionals (Architects, Structural Engineers, MEP Coordinators). Working in close partnership with Full\-Cycle Recruiters and Construction/A\+E Leadership, you will serve as Ryan’s brand ambassador in the market, converting passive industry talent into valued team members. **To be successful in this role you will have:** Talent Sourcing \& Pipeline Development * **Proactive Talent Identification:** Mine social media, professional networking platforms, trade associations, and talent databases (e.g., LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed, Google X\-Ray, Handshake) to uncover top passive talent in commercial construction and design disciplines. * **Advanced Sourcing Methodologies:** Develop and execute sophisticated Boolean search strings, market\-mapping techniques, and competitive talent intelligence to locate niche, hard\-to\-find technical and operational talent. * **Talent Communities \& CRM Management:** Build, categorize, and actively nurture talent pools within our CRM and ATS (Workday) to support both active immediate hiring needs and strategic future project demands. * **Market Intelligence \& Research:** Monitor industry hiring trends, competitor organizational structures, regional labor market conditions, and compensation benchmarks across our operating regions. Candidate Engagement \& Outreach * **Personalized Outreach Campaigns:** Craft persuasive, compelling candidate outreach communications that articulate Ryan’s distinct company culture, integrated project delivery model, and value proposition. * **Initial Screening \& Qualification:** Conduct initial discovery calls and phone screenings to assess candidate interest, technical background, career aspirations, and cultural alignment. * **Relationship Nurturing:** Establish warm relationships with prospective candidates early, maintaining regular touchpoints over months and years to ensure Ryan remains top\-of\-mind when they are ready to explore new opportunities. * **Candidate Experience:** Ensure every prospect receives an exceptional, transparent, and respectful experience representing Ryan Companies from the very first interaction. Stakeholder Collaboration \& Workflow Integration * **Strategic Partnership with TA \& Leadership:** Partner closely with Talent Acquisition Managers, Recruiters, and regional Construction/A\+E Leaders to calibrate job profiles, review pipeline metrics, and adjust sourcing strategies in real time. * **Referral Generation:** Proactively engage internal construction teams, project sites, and design studios to source employee referrals and maximize organic talent networks. * **Handoff Coordination:** Coordinate seamless introductions and interview scheduling between qualified prospects, assigned recruiters, and hiring managers to sustain momentum throughout the recruitment lifecycle. * **Data Integrity \& Reporting:** Maintain meticulous candidate tracking records in Workday/CRM, delivering regular updates on sourcing volume, conversion rates, and pipeline health. **To be successful in this role you will have:** * **Experience:** Minimum of 6\+ years of dedicated talent sourcing or full\-cycle recruiting experience. * **Industry Focus:** Proven experience identifying and engaging talent within Commercial Construction, Real Estate Development, or Architecture and Engineering (A\+E). * **Technical Sourcing Capabilities:** Demonstrated mastery of LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search logic, candidate relationship management systems (CRM), and enterprise Applicant Tracking Systems (e.g., Workday). * **Construction Knowledge:** Working understanding of commercial construction lifecycles, project delivery methods (Design\-Build, CM at Risk, General Contracting), and key operational roles (Superintendent, Project Manager, Estimator, Architect, MEP Engineer). * **Communication Skills:** Outstanding verbal and written communication abilities with demonstrated success in crafting customized, high\-conversion candidate outreach. * **Drive \& Organization:** Self\-starter mindset with strong organizational habits, capable of prioritizing multiple urgent searches across diverse geographic regions. * Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Communications, Construction Management, or equivalent practical experience. * Prior experience sourcing for large national general contractors, design\-build firms, or multidisciplinary real estate development organizations. * Familiarity with campus/early\-career pipeline initiatives and regional staffing recovery strategies. * Experience utilizing candidate outreach tools, automated campaign sequencers, or AI\-assisted recruitment platforms. **Eligibility:** Position jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Developer
jobs.description: **Summary** ----------- Welcome to Ryerson, where exceptional career opportunities await. As a leading provider of industrial metal products and services since 1842, we are committed to excellence and best\-in\-class customer service. Join our team and be a part of a legacy of excellence, where your contributions will be valued, and your development supported. Ryerson offers a dynamic, quality\-focused, environment, ideal for advancing your career and making your mark in the metals industry. As a Senior Full Stack Developer at Ryerson, you will be responsible for developing and designing front/back\-end web architecture, ensuring the responsiveness of applications, and working alongside graphic designers for web design features. This is a hybrid role requiring three days per week in our Downers Grove office. **Roles and Responsibilities** ------------------------------ * Managing the complete software development process from conception to deployment * Build reusable, accessible UI components and pages in React using TypeScript, following team coding standards and patterns * Design and implement serverless services using Serverless.com. * Maintaining and upgrading the software following deployment * Reviews peers' code constructively; optimizes performance; anticipates scalability issues * Managing the end\-to\-end life cycle for the production of software and applications * Overseeing and guiding the analysis, writing, building, and deployment of software * Overseeing the automated testing and providing feedback to management during the development process * All other duties as assigned or duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice **Requirements** ---------------- * Minimum of 5 years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor’s in Computer Science or similar field or 10 years of relevant work experience with a High School Diploma * Proficiency with the creation of Unit Tests and the use of the library JEST * Minimum of 3 years of relevant work experience with React.js and TypeScript * Knowledge of Node.js and Serverless.com * Familiarity with database technology such as MySQL and MSSQL * Basic experience in using Cloud Technologies (AWS, Azure Cloud) * Excellent verbal communication skills Salary: $93,401 \- $140,101 annually plus bonus. A starting salary higher than $93,401 annually is based on a level of experience and education that significantly exceeds the minimum requirements and is commensurate with the compensation scale. Ryerson offers eligible employees the following benefits: * Medical, dental, and vision insurance programs * Flexible spending accounts * 401K plans with employer\-matching contributions * Tuition reimbursement * Paid vacation, sick, and holidays \#LI\-Hybrid \#LI\-GC1 We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex (including gender identity, sexual orientation or preference, and pregnancy), age, national origin, religion, disability or genetic information, marital status, status as a veteran, or any other federal, state or local protected class or artificial barrier.

jobs.title: Application Software Developer
jobs.description: **Company Overview** SCS Global Services is a pioneer and leader in the field of sustainability standards and third\-party certification, working across the economy in the natural resources, built environment, food and agriculture, consumer products, and climate sectors for over 40 years. As a Benefit Corporation, we are committed to socially and environmentally responsible business practices, and through the application of sound science, we are driving positive change. **Job Overview** The Application Software Developer will be responsible for designing and developing innovative software solutions that meet our clients' and business needs and expectations. The Application Software Developer will be responsible for analyzing user requirements, designing and coding software programs or systems, testing and debugging software solutions, and documenting work. This position will assist in code reviews and participate in providing input for technology standards, best practices, and software development lifecycle processes. The Application Software Developer will work with software development teams (including resources both onshore and offshore) through the software development process. This position will be reporting directly to the Senior Software Development Manager. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** * Deep technical expert and thought leader that helps identify and accelerate adoption of leading engineering practices, while staying up on industry innovations, trends, and practices * Participate in proof\-of\-concepts with Software Development leadership for emerging technologies that should be integrated and/or introduced to ensure IT has the capabilities needed to respond to future business requirements * Ensure adherence to best practices regarding technology standards, change management, release management, application lifecycles, and enterprise architecture * Analyze software specifications and system requirements to design scalable and functional applications and solutions * Develop software programs or systems using various programming languages and technologies, including microservices/serverless patterns and technical influence on architecture * Take ownership of the deployment pipeline, ensuring that every code commit is automatically tested, scanned for security vulnerabilities, and deployed via modern CI/CD tools * Document software programs in code and with diagrams, charts, mark down, and other documentation formats and/or systems * Collaborate with other software engineers, project managers, product owners, QA engineers, and business stakeholders to ensure quality and timely delivery * Participate in the entire software development lifecycle, from planning to deployment to support * Learn about industry developments to stay on top of the latest advancements **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor's Degree in computer science, information systems, or related field, or equivalent work experience **and** * Familiarity with modern application architectures and coding, to include backend and frontend development (e.g., Python, Node.js, jQuery, Angular, React, Flask, etc.) **and** * Experience with SQL, NoSQL, and other database types **and** * Experience with web services and APIs (RESTful, SOAP, etc.) **and** * Experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, etc.) **and** * Experience with both AI\-powered development tools for code acceleration, quality, **and** automated testing and building AI\-integrated capabilities **and** * Experience with lean and Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, etc.) * Excellent communication, teamwork, and problem\-solving skills * Strong organization, prioritization, analytical, and problem\-solving skills * Initiative, innovative, good judgment, and ability to work independently under pressure in a changing environment * Ability to make sound decisions in a timely manner when solutions are not clear, risk is variable, and information ambiguous The above description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Additional duties outside of normal responsibilities may be required from time to time as assigned. **Working Remotely** SCS Global Services is recruiting all open roles to be remote; allowing our employees the ability to work flexibly and allowing SCS Global Services as a company to diversify the experience and perspectives of our growing workforce. This is a home\-office based role and may include travel with local, domestic, and/or international trips. Details will be clarified during the recruitment process. At this time, SCS Global Services is recruiting all open roles to be remote; allowing our employees the ability to work flexibly and allowing SCS Global Services as a company to diversify the experience and perspectives of our growing workforce. This role will be based out of your home office. **Estimated Annual Salary** $61,102\.08 \- $83,017\.87 **EEOC Statement** SCS Global Services provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, amnesty, or status as a covered veteran in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws. SCS Global Services complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including, but not limited to, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Cloud
jobs.description: ### **THE COMPANY** Saildrone is a maritime defense company and the global leader in autonomous unmanned surface vehicles (USVs). With more ocean miles and real\-world operational experience than any USV manufacturer or operator, Saildrone maintains active, combat\-deployed systems supporting national security and force projection around the world, 24/7/365\. Saildrone's manufacturing and R\&D headquarters are located in Alameda, CA, with business development and sales operations in Washington, DC, and deployment hubs in Europe and the Middle East. By combining proven autonomous operations, edge computing, advanced sensing, renewable power, and the most advanced and robust unmanned surface technology on the planet, Saildrone is shaping how the Navy of the future operates. Join a fast\-moving, mission\-driven team at the forefront of maritime security and autonomous innovation. **THE POSITION** ---------------- Saildrone's autonomous vessels generate continuous streams of sensor, detection, and operational data that must become useful information for engineers and mission operators. As a Software Engineer, Cloud, you will build the cloud services that ingest, process, store, and expose that information across a distributed fleet. You will work across backend software, data systems, and cloud infrastructure, building reliable services that connect autonomous vessels to the applications used to monitor and operate them. **THE RESPONSIBILITIES** ------------------------ * Design, build, and operate production cloud services supporting autonomous vessels. * Develop backend services and APIs in Python and TypeScript. * Design data models and database systems for operational and sensor\-derived data. * Build services that ingest and process data from distributed, intermittently connected vehicles. * Expose detection and operational information to downstream applications and mission operators. * Design for reliability, scalability, observability, and graceful handling of delayed or incomplete data. * Deploy, monitor, debug, and improve services running in AWS. **THE QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------- * Strong software engineering skills in Python, TypeScript, or both. * Experience building and operating production cloud or distributed systems. * Strong understanding of database fundamentals and data modeling. * Experience designing APIs and services that integrate distributed systems. * Experience with AWS or another major cloud platform. * Strong systems thinking and an ability to reason about reliability, performance, and failure modes. * Experience owning production software from design through deployment and operation. **NICE TO HAVE** ---------------- * Experience with real\-time or streaming data systems. * Experience with robotics, autonomous vehicles, IoT, aerospace, defense, or other distributed physical systems. * Experience processing sensor, telemetry, video, or geospatial data. To view Saildrone's candidate privacy policy, please visit: https://www.saildrone.com/privacy\-policy. ### **BENEFITS** At Saildrone, we're building operational capability that matters—and that requires people who can do their best work over the long term. We invest in our team's well\-being, financial security, and professional growth so you can focus on delivering real\-world impact with confidence and stability. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to support you and your family while you contribute to a mission with lasting significance. * **Generous Time Off:** Competitive Paid Time Off (PTO) accrual plus a robust annual holiday schedule and paid sick leave ensure you can rest, reset, and sustain performance over time. * **Comprehensive Health Coverage:** Premium, multi\-tier Medical, Dental, and Vision plans with significant company contributions for employees and dependents—providing security and peace of mind. * **Shared Ownership in the Mission:** Equity grants are a core part of our compensation, allowing you to participate in the long\-term value you help create through meaningful, operational work. * **Retirement Savings:** Access to a 401(k) retirement plan with flexible pre\-tax and Roth payroll contribution options supports long\-term financial planning. * **Investment in Your Growth:** We support your continuous learning through an annual professional development reimbursement program, empowering you to sharpen your skills and stay ahead of the curve in a rapidly evolving field. * **Relocation Support:** For eligible roles, we offer relocation assistance to help bring the world's best talent to our mission\-critical locations. Saildrone is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: Lead Data Engineer
jobs.description: **About Nexcess** Nexcess provides specialty cloud solutions for organizations where performance and compliance have to coexist. We serve businesses worldwide, from agencies scaling client sites to enterprises running mission\-critical operations. We've built our reputation on deep technical expertise and genuine partnership with every client we work with. Behind every environment we manage is a team of people who take the craft seriously and keep showing up when it matters. **Overview** ============ The Lead, Data Engineer leads the Data Engineering team and provides technical direction for the data infrastructure, pipelines, and systems that support reporting, analytics, and data products across the organization. This role combines people leadership, technical expertise, and business partnership to ensure data solutions are reliable, scalable, and aligned with organizational priorities. The Lead, Data Engineer remains hands\-on technically while guiding the work of the team and partnering with Finance, Data \& Analytics, and other business leaders to translate business needs into practical data solutions. **Responsibilities** **Team Leadership \& Delivery** ------------------------------- * Lead, mentor, and develop the Data Engineering team, establishing clear expectations for performance, quality, and ownership. * Manage team priorities, workload, and delivery in alignment with broader business objectives. * Provide technical guidance and oversight for engineering work, including architecture, design, and production readiness. * Serve as an escalation point for complex technical, data quality, and delivery challenges. **Data Engineering \& Architecture** ------------------------------------ * Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines, integrations, warehouses, and supporting infrastructure. * Establish and maintain engineering standards for data architecture, modeling, reliability, performance, and maintainability. * Remain hands\-on in development and resolution of complex or business\-critical technical issues. * Drive improvements to automation, tooling, monitoring, and engineering practices that strengthen the data environment. **Strategy \& Business Partnership** ------------------------------------ * Establish technical direction and priorities for Data Engineering in alignment with organizational objectives. * Partner with Finance and other business and technical stakeholders to translate data needs into effective solutions. * Evaluate technologies, processes, and architectural approaches that improve the organization's ability to use and scale data. * Communicate technical strategy, risks, recommendations, and infrastructure needs to technical and business leadership. ### **Additional Expectations** * Demonstrates and promotes the company's Impact Behaviors in all interactions and decision\-making. * + Design + Ownership + First Team + Performance * Maintains a professional, collaborative, and client\-focused approach while supporting team and organizational objectives. * Performs other duties, responsibilities, and special projects as assigned to meet business needs. **Qualifications** ================== **Required** ------------ * 7\+ years of related data engineering experience, including 2\+ years leading, supervising, or providing technical direction to others. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, a related discipline, equivalent technical training, or equivalent professional experience. * Strong experience designing, building, and maintaining data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, data warehouses, and related infrastructure. * Advanced SQL skills and strong programming experience with Python, Java, Scala, or a comparable language. * Strong understanding of data architecture, modeling, scalability, performance, reliability, and data quality practices. * Experience with modern cloud data platforms, orchestration frameworks, and data processing technologies. * Demonstrated ability to remain hands\-on technically while leading and developing a team. * Strong business acumen with the ability to translate business requirements into practical technical solutions. * Strong communication and stakeholder management skills across technical and non\-technical audiences. **Preferred** ------------- * Experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform. * Experience with orchestration and transformation tools such as Airflow, dbt, or similar technologies. * Experience with distributed or streaming data technologies such as Kafka or Spark. * Experience with infrastructure\-as\-code and CI/CD practices for data environments. * Experience building, scaling, or maturing a Data Engineering function. **Key Performance Indicators** ============================== * Reliability and availability of critical data pipelines and infrastructure. * Timeliness and quality of Data Engineering deliverables. * Data quality and reduction of recurring production issues. * Progress against Data Engineering roadmap and priorities. * Team performance, development, and delivery effectiveness. * Effectiveness of data solutions in supporting business and stakeholder needs. **Work Environment** ==================== The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an individual to successfully perform the essential duties of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential duties. * While performing the essential duties of this job, the individual is regularly required to speak and hear * While performing the essential duties of this job, the individual is regularly required to use hands for keyboarding, gross manipulation, and fine manipulation * Works at a desk and computer screen for extended periods of time * Works in a traditional climate controlled office environment or from home * Works in a highly stressful environment dealing with a wide variety of challenges, deadlines and diverse employee population **Disclaimer** ============== *This job description is only a summary of the typical functions of the position. It is not intended to be an exhaustive or comprehensive list of all job responsibilities, tasks, or duties. Additional duties and tasks may be assigned as part of the job function. Liquid Web Inc. reserves the right to modify, interpret, or apply this job description in a way that best supports the organizational needs. The job description in no way creates or implies an employment contract. The employment contract remains “at will”.* *Equal Employment Opportunity Policy: Liquid Web is committed to offering equal employment opportunity without regard to age, color, disability, gender, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, military status, national origin, race, religion, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.* \#LI\-Remote

jobs.title: Business Systems Analyst II
jobs.description: **PURPOSE OF THE POSITION** Identifies high priority needs, captures those needs as requirements / user stories, and works with the development and product management teams to deliver effective technology solutions; becoming immersed in the understanding of business processes to help solve business problems and drive positive business outcomes. **ESSENTIAL POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES** **Customer Advocacy.** Look at every problem and our solutions in the eyes of our business partners. Works with stakeholders in all business units to formulate scope and objectives for new initiatives. Partners with business stakeholders and Product Managers to prioritize, analyze, define and manage backlog by gathering enhancement requests and helping with project requests as the business needs evolve. Develops and maintains working relationships with business users to assess current state, recommended directional changes for future state, and effectiveness of solutions. **Contributes to the solution areas by** developing business specifications for development or enhancements and by being the key interface between business users and application engineers. Defines project requirements by identifying key deliverables, phases and acceptance criteria, and translates those requirements into solutions**.** Formulates and defines business scope and objectives through research and fact\-finding combined with an understanding of business and industry requirements. Contributes to and documents dynamic \& interactive requirements gathering sessions with stakeholders throughout the enterprise. Leads and documents requirements from one on one and small group requirements sessions. Leverages findings and recommendations from Analytics, User Experience, and Development teams. Develops functional requirements documentation in the form of user stories, process flows, and user acceptance criteria. Supports QA and UAT efforts. Prototypes/produces system documentation data models, data flows, and process flows. Work closely with the Product Manager to manage requirements volatility, integrity and continuity. Analyzes the current business environment to detect critical deficiencies and identify improvement opportunities. **Serves as a subject matter expert.** Responds to platform questions and troubleshoots efforts by having a thorough understanding of the business processes and flows, thereby enabling the analysis of business requirements and the development of solutions for the business functions. Assists the different business unit teams with defining best practices for solutions and providing recommendations on proposed solutions. Understands and translates the business problem into an application solution. Researches, analyzes and recommends solutions which meet the business needs for new requests. Analyzes business requirements, explores and evaluates various options, configures the application to meet requirements and coordinates testing with QA and User acceptance testers. **Participates as a member of the Team.** Participates in the ongoing development, communication and implementation of team concepts, programs and policies; coordinates work to ensure best practices with all team members. Attends appropriate team meetings. Accepts responsibility to quickly identify any areas that lack cohesiveness, bringing them to the attention of the team leader and working with the team in a supportive manner to resolve issues and actively look for ways, and reinforce actions needed, to achieve synergy possible within the larger organization. **Simmons Operating systems principles and objectives:** Is familiar with Simmons’ established operating systems (e.g. quality, security, office environment, company policies, LEAN); understands the responsibility to maintain familiarity with the systems and this position’s role in support of these systems \- including a consideration of the impact of individual actions on the systems and the responsibility to communicate concerns and improvement ideas. **Performs other duties as necessary in support of business objectives:** This position description is intended to guide the activities of the person in this position and is not intended to limit the thinking and creativity of the person as to the work of this function nor is it intended that this describe all the work that may be required of the person in this position. **Physical Activities:** Enters and locates information on a computer. Visually verifies information, often in small print. Communicates with Customers, Vendors, or Employees via telephone, in person, and/or electronic mail. May present information to small or large groups. Must be able to work in various temperatures. Move about in a manufacturing environment and surrounding property. May travel via car or plane to various work locations. **Personal Protective Equipment (PPE):** As required by visiting facility. **Travel:** Approximately 15% travel, including travel to Simmons facilities, one to two offsite classes or conferences per year, and to Toronto Office. Must have or be able to obtain a passport. **Technical Experience:** 5\+ years experience as a Business Analyst or similar role. Ability to create report mockups. Experience using SCRUM/Agile methodologies with enterprise\-level application projects. **Industry Experience:** Preference for food processing organization. **Minimum Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or related field, or 4 years related experience. **Preferred Education:** MS degree in Information Services, Computer Science, or MBA We value military experience and welcome veterans to join our team. Note: The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed and the competencies required by persons assigned to this job. They are not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, knowledge, skills, abilities, and working conditions associated with this job. This job description is not an employment contract and Simmons Foods reserves the right to change this description at any time. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: Senior Applications Engineer
jobs.description: Simplesense builds, deploys, and sustains the Installation Resilience Platform that enables mission operators to rapidly adapt and respond. The Platform protects critical infrastructure from cyber attack while unlocking previously siloed information to monitor, diagnose, and improve response times to incidents. Our adversaries rapidly adopt the latest technology: we help defense users respond in kind. Simplesense is a non\-traditional defense contractor and prime on the Air Force's Installation Resilience Operations Command and Control (IROC) program, which is now expanding to five additional Air Force, Space Force, and Army installations from the one prototype installation, Tyndall Air Force Base. Our team combines over 100 years of direct mission experience solving hard problems with 50 years technical expertise deploying DevSecOps, cybersecurity, and cloud infrastructure, giving us a deep appreciation for our customers' mission and end users' priorities. We build for scale, architecting and prioritizing technical work for long term sustainability. **Senior Applications Engineer** ================================ **Location:** We prioritize candidates who reside in the Denver, CO metro area (hybrid as needed) but we are open to exceptional remote talent. **Department:** **Engineering** **About Simplesense** --------------------- Simplesense keeps military installations mission\-ready. The infrastructure their operations depend on — power, water, fuel, facilities, security, and communications — runs continuously, often under strain. When it fails without warning, mission readiness is at risk, and the people who run these installations need to see what's happening in time to act. That's the foundation of Continuous Mission Assurance. We securely integrate Operational Technology and Control Systems (OT/CS) from the building edge to the cloud, applying Zero Trust principles to protect critical infrastructure from cyber and physical threats. By unlocking previously siloed data, we put timely awareness in front of the decision\-makers who need it. As prime on the Air Force's Installation Resilience Operations Command and Control (IROC) program, we hold a continuous Authority to Operate (ATO) and have proven the capability at scale at Tyndall Air Force Base. That work is now expanding across the Air Force, Space Force, and Army. Our team pairs over a century of boots\-on\-the\-ground mission experience with deep technical expertise across DevSecOps, cybersecurity, and cloud infrastructure. We engineer resilient infrastructure — the software, integration, and operational backbone behind it — for the operators who depend on it in the field. Persistent resilience, built for the mission. ### **About the Role** As the **Senior Applications Engineer**, you will build containerized ETL applications deployed and orchestrated in Kubernetes. This isn't a one\-size\-fits\-all integration problem: each source system has its own quirks, protocols, and failure modes, and you will figure out reliable extraction strategies and pair it with efficient data translation methods. **Work Model:** We prioritize candidates who reside in the Denver, CO (hybrid as needed) but we are open to exceptional remote talent. * **Locals:** Onsite as needed for collaborative workspace time. * **Remote:** Quarterly travel to hub locations for team syncs and alignment. **Our Performance Culture** --------------------------- We measure performance across two key dimensions: **How** you perform your role (Our Core Values) and **What** your role entails (Your Execution). ### **How You'll Work — Our Core Values** At Simplesense, we value high\-trust autonomy. We look for builders who can comfortably navigate ambiguity and are deeply driven by our shared national security mission. * **People Always – Win as One Team:** We foster a culture of psychological safety and mutual support. We operate as an integrated team where we assume noble intent as our default setting, ensuring that even the toughest feedback is rooted in trust. We trade our silos for a shared mission because collective impact always outweighs individual achievement. * **Empathize – Obsess Over the Customer:** We don't just solve technical problems; we empathize and advocate for the operators using our products. We look beyond the surface to build what our customers—both internal and external—actually need to succeed, not just what they asked for. * **Focus – Ruthlessly Prioritize with Urgency:** We focus on the highest\-impact work and ruthlessly say no to distractions. We build resilient systems so that our solutions can repeat and scale under pressure. * **Let's Go – Catalyze the Change You Seek:** We don't wait for the industry to change; we drive it. We seek to understand why things are the way they are, but we never use "the way it's always been" as an excuse. We aren't afraid to change course when the data or our mission demands it. ### **What You'll Do** * Build and maintain resilie esigning or working with data pipelines. + Experience deploying, configuring, and troubleshooting containerized applications in a K8s environment (deployments, services, config maps/secrets, health checks, resource management). + Experience authoring and maintaining CloudFormation templates for provisioning AWS resources in a repeatable, automated way. + Domain Knowledge: Familiarity with building management systems (BMS) and industrial control system architectures, including an understanding of how operational technology data is structured, generated, and communicated across these systems. * ### **Preferred Qualifications:** + Strongly prefer candidates residing in the Denver, CO metro area. + Prior experience working within DoD, Air Force, Space Force, or fast\-paced Federal contractor/dual\-use startup environments. + Relevant technical certifications such as AWS Certified Security \- Specialty, GIAC GICSP/GRID, or CISSP. + Experience with Operational Technology (OT), ICS/SCADA environments, OT/CS security tooling (e.g., Nozomi), automating DISA STIG/NIST 800\-53 frameworks, and familiarity with DoD Zero Trust strategy. ### **What Success Looks Like** * **30 Days:** You are fully onboarded to our architecture and have shipped a small, well\-tested improvement to an existing ETL integration, demonstrating comprehension of our NodeJS patterns and deployment process. * **60 Days:** You have independently built and deployed a new ETL application for an additional system integration, from protocol investigation through Kubernetes deployment, and proposed at least one improvement to our shared tooling or patterns. * **90 Days:** You are a major contributor to our ETL application portfolio, actively shaping architectural decisions about scaling the framework, and have a complete understanding of our CI/CD pipeline.
