jobs.title: Principal Engineer, Mobile
jobs.description: **ABOUT SLATE** At Slate, we’re building safe, reliable vehicles that people can afford, personalize and love—and doing it here in the USA as part of our commitment to reindustrialization. The spirit of DIY and customization runs throughout every element of a Slate, because people should have control over how their trucks look, feel, and represent them. **Who We Are Looking For** Slate is looking for a Principal Engineer to anchor the technical depth of the Mobile Experience pod. This is the senior\-most individual contributor on the mobile team — the person who shapes architecture, sets the engineering quality bar, and personally closes the hardest technical gaps standing between our current build and a November GA launch. The Slate mobile app covers a wide technical surface: a React Native / TypeScript product layer, a custom native module for vehicle communication, a dedicated mobile backend\-for\-frontend, platform\-level security and encryption, and integrations spanning EV charging, service scheduling, account management, and over\-the\-air update delivery. You need to be equally comfortable driving complex product features in React Native and reasoning through low\-level native module behavior, and you should be able to step into backend service work when mobile product needs require it. You must be able to thrive and succeed in a fast\-paced startup environment where your contributions have a direct impact on the company's direction and success and should not be hindered by ambiguity or competing priorities. **What You Get to Do** Vehicle Communication and Native Module Engineering * Serve as the architectural owner of the C\+\+ Turbo Module that bridges the React Native JS layer to the vehicle Secure Gateway Module over USB/DTLS — setting direction, leading design decisions, and being the escalation point for the hardest debugging and performance issues in the native layer. * Own the TypeScript/C\+\+ boundary defined by the TurboModule Codegen spec — vehicle data polling, UDS diagnostic requests, CAN bus messaging, OTA update management, DTC operations, and security access — and ensure the team is building to that contract correctly. * Provide architectural guidance on CAN decoder design and the shared CAN message definitions package; review and approve significant changes to the vehicle communication data model. * Drive the DTLS session lifecycle architecture: certificate issuance, BFF\-mediated vehicle security endpoints, and cryptographic operations within the native layer. * Lead the evaluation and outcome decision on protobuf\-based dynamic DID mapping to align vehicle communication with the source\-of\-truth data model. Apply and reinforce the Definition of Done for vehicle communication PRs in code reviews; serve as the technical bar for what constitutes a well\-tested, merge\-ready change in the native communication layer. * Mobile Application Architecture and Product Features * Own the overall layered application architecture — from Presentation through Native Modules and Data Persistence — making binding calls on structure, patterns, and technology decisions as the app scales toward GA and beyond. * Drive architecture and implementation across active epics: EV Charging, Service Scheduling, Vehicle Settings, and Key Management / Plugged\-In flows; jump into hands\-on implementation where the team needs technical leadership or the problem requires it. * Set the standard for server state management patterns across the app — caching, synchronization, optimistic updates, and stale\-while\-revalidate behavior — and ensure consistent application across charging, vehicle data, and scheduling endpoints. * Own the encrypted local storage architecture and its per\-VIN partitioning scheme; provide direction on schema validation hardening across all storage reads and writes. * Lead warm\-start lifecycle hygiene: diagnose and resolve lifecycle risks across screens and establish preventative patterns the team applies going forward. * Provide architectural direction on embedded WebView integrations — Account Management, Finance, E\-Commerce — including secure session\-token passing and native\-to\-web message bridge contracts. Own the push notification architecture end\-to\-end: backend integration approach, client\-side token management and permission flow, deep\-link routing strategy, and encryption requirements. * Backend\-for\-Frontend and Service Integration * Provide technical direction on the mobile BFF — jump in to extend or debug service endpoints for charging, service scheduling, vehicle security, and auth flows when mobile product needs it. * Own the mobile API client architecture: JWT refresh strategy, API key gating, and version\-safe endpoint evolution that accommodates multiple installed app versions in the wild. * Drive charging API ownership resolution and close any gap between mobile BFF needs and backend service contracts. Provide technical oversight on RepairPal BFF integration, ensur le of engineering capability across the Digital org. * **What You Bring to the Team** **Required** • Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent work experience. • 10\+ years of professional software engineering experience with at least 4 years in mobile application development (iOS, Android, or React Native). • Deep familiarity with C\+\+ native module architecture in a React Native context: sufficient to lead design decisions, diagnose native\-layer crashes, and provide meaningful technical direction to engineers working in the layer — without necessarily being the primary author. • Deep React Native expertise: Turbo Modules, Expo ecosystem (EAS Build, EAS Update, Expo Router), TypeScript, and state management patterns. • Demonstrated ability to build or maintain backend services: REST API design, authentication middleware, JWT lifecycle, and integration with third\-party services. • Experience with serial or embedded communication protocols: CAN bus, UDS diagnostics, DID\-based data polling, or DTLS/TLS in constrained hardware environments. • Fluency with mobile security patterns: hardware\-backed key management, encrypted local storage, certificate\-based device authentication, and secure WebView session injection. • Strong CI/CD and release engineering skills: multi\-environment build pipelines, OTA update strategy, and App Store / Google Play submission experience. • Experience with mobile observability tooling: setting up instrumentation, diagnosing production crashes, and running performance profiling. **Strongly Preferred** • Automotive software experience: secure gateway architectures, vehicle certificate issuance flows, or embedded cryptography. • Experience integrating EV charging networks or fleet telematics platforms. • Familiarity with Protocol Buffers or dynamic vehicle data configuration mapping. • Prior work scaling a mobile product from pre\-GA to GA launch with hard date constraints. **Salary Range** The compensation for this position is the range Slate reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for the position taking into account the wide variety of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions, including job\-related knowledge; skillset; experience, education and training; certifications; work location; and other relevant business and organizational factors. Base Pay Range (Annual) $202,610\.00 \- $337,684\.00 USD Additional Compensation and Benefits: Slate offers a wide range of competitive benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability insurance, vacation, and 401k. The successful candidate may also be eligible to participate in the equity program and/or a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing such programs. **WHY JOIN TEAM SLATE?** At Slate, we’re fueled by grit, determination, and attention to detail. The start\-up spirit of ingenuity and resourcefulness move our business forward. Team Slate fosters a culture of excellence, innovation, and mutual respect, and is motivated by shared principles. * Safety First * Delight Customers * One Team * Relentless Improvement * Fast, Frugal, and Scrappy * Respectful Collaboration * Positive Legacy **WE WANT TO WORK WITH PEOPLE THAT REFLECT THE COMMUNITIES IN WHICH WE OPERATE.** Slate is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, marital status, parental status, cultural background, organizational level, work styles, tenure and life experiences. Or for any other reason. Slate is committed to providing reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at **slate\-talent\_acquisition@slate.auto.**

jobs.description: **About SmartAsset:** SmartAsset is an online destination for consumer\-focused financial information, educational content, personalized calculators, and tools. Our mission is to help people make smart financial decisions, reaching an estimated 23 million people each month through our educational content, publishing partners, calculators, and tools.\* To extend that mission, we also operate the SmartAsset Advisor Marketing Platform (AMP), which helps connect consumers with participating fiduciary financial advisors. SmartAsset has been recognized as a 2025 ThinkAdvisor Luminaries winner in the Firm Award – Product or Service Innovation category and was ranked \#2574 on the Inc. 5000 list in 2023\. SmartAsset has also been featured on Y Combinator's list of Top Companies, a curated compilation rather than a numerical ranking.\*\* In 2021, SmartAsset completed a $110 million Series D funding round that valued the company at over $1 billion. * Based on average monthly reach data for 2025 across SmartAsset\-owned properties and publishing partners. \*\*Other than application, licensing, or similar administrative fees, SmartAsset did not provide compensation in connection with the referenced awards or recognitions. **About the team:** You'll be working on the Web Platform team that is responsible for the content management architecture at SmartAsset. This team is building the future content management systems to create, serve, and innovate on the financial information that attracts our users and has built our brand. Your role on this team will involve working on both front and backend services as we build and migrate our new content management system while working closely with senior engineers and architects to design the future of how we serve content. ### **About the Job:** **Responsibilities**: * This position presents a high\-growth opportunity to be part of a dynamic engineering team that owns the technical and architectural domains of our web platform domain. * You will be part of an AGILE SCRUM team, responsible for running and scaling our web site and other web products. * You will be collaborating closely with everyone around you including our product team and other stakeholders to complete sprint and triage commitments. * You will actively participate and support making key technical decisions, documenting technical and improving processes as we revamp and reshape the services we provide. * Your role will be pivotal in guiding technical designs and ensuring the successful implementation of your team's roadmap. * Your relentless drive to learn, coupled with a "no challenge is too big" approach, will shape your team's decisions around technology, tooling, and processes. * You present excellent communication skills that enhance collaboration in an asynchronous and fully remote environment **Skills/Experience you have**: * **Engineering Expertise:** 3\+ years of experience building, maintaining, and scaling highly available, performant web platforms with Java (or similar) and deep expertise in ReactJS and NodeJS for modular, modern web applications. * **Technical Proficiency:** Strong knowledge of relational databases and SQL, version control with Git, and designing and implementing complex cloud solutions (preferably AWS). * **Leadership \& Strategy:** Proven ability to drive project and product success in Agile environments through strategic thinking, clear communication, and decisive action. * **Team Development:** Passionate about coaching and mentoring others while continuously improving yourself, fostering a culture of growth and collaboration. * **Execution \& Adaptability:** Adept at identifying risks, creating effective mitigations, and thriving in fast\-paced, cross\-functional teams with a startup mindset and a relentless drive for improvement. **Skills/Experience preferred**: * Knowledge of least privilege principle, application structure and OOP patterns. * Experience working in or developing in a CI/CD environment * Familiarity using IAC tools (ex. Terraform, Cloudformation) * Knowledge operating incidents, releases, problem, and change management processes * Experience using or integrating headless WordPress or other Content Management tools. **Physical Requirements:** * Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer * Must be able to communicate via phone calls and/or video conferences ### **Available Benefits and Perks:** * All roles at SmartAsset are currently and will remain remote \- flexibility to work from anywhere in the Contiguous US. * Medical, Dental, Vision \- multiple packages available based on your individualized needs * Life/AD\&D Insurance \- basic coverage at 100% company paid, additional supplemental available * Supplemental Short\-term and Long\-term Disability * FSA: Medical and Dependant Care * 401K * Equity packages for each role * Time Off: Vacation, Sick and Parental Leave * EAP (Employee Assistance Program) * Financial Literacy Mentoring Program * Pet Insurance * Home Office Stipend *SmartAsset is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact us at Recruiting@smartasset.com.* *California, Colorado, Connecticut, Maryland, Nevada, Rhode Island, Washington, and New York City residents\* $119,500 \- $180,000 base salary* *\+ RSUs \+ benefits.* *Salary at SmartAsset is determined based on permissible, non\-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location within the contiguous United States.*

jobs.title: VP of Growth Marketing
jobs.description: **Who We Are:** SmithRx is a rapidly growing, venture\-backed Health\-Tech company. Our mission is to disrupt the expensive and inefficient Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM) sector by building a next\-generation drug acquisition platform driven by cutting edge technology, innovative cost saving tools, and best\-in\-class customer service. With hundreds of thousands of members onboarded since 2016, SmithRx has a solution that is resonating with clients all across the country. We pride ourselves for our mission\-driven and collaborative culture that inspires our employees to do their best work. We believe that the U.S healthcare system is in need of transformation, and we come to work each day dedicated to making that change a reality. At our core, we are guided by our company values: * **Integrity:** Our purpose guides our actions and gives us confidence in the path ahead. With unwavering honesty and dependability, we embrace the pressure of challenging the old and exemplify ethical leadership to create the new. * **Courage:** We face continuous challenges with grit and resilience. We embrace the discomfort of the unknown by balancing autonomy with empathy, and ownership with vulnerability. We boldly challenge the status quo to keep moving forward—always. * **Together:** The success of SmithRx reflects the strength of our partnerships and the commitment of our team. Our shared values bind us together and make us one. When one falls, we all fall; when one rises, we all rise. **Job Summary:** We are looking for an entrepreneurial, highly experimental VP of Growth Marketing to build and scale our revenue engine in the Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM) space. PBM is a huge market that never got modern growth marketing. The job is to bring the gold standards other industries take for granted to one that isn't using them, and find the levers specific to how this market buys. Lots of ground to take. In this role, you will build a team and a function dedicated to discovering, testing, and scaling the unique growth and engagement tactics that win in our industry. Managing a small but growing team, you will architect a culture of rapid experimentation, holding a healthy tolerance for failure as long as it drives fast, actionable learning. **What you will do:** * **Architect an Experimentation Engine:** Build a culture of high\-velocity testing across messaging, channels, and outreach strategies. Manage a rigorous pipeline of growth experiments, pivoting quickly from failures and scaling what works. * **Discover PBM\-Specific Growth Levers:** Work with Sales and Product to find the channels and partnership loops that land with complex healthcare buyers and the brokers who advise them. Build for both motions: selling direct to employers, and winning through the broker channel that drives much of PBM selection. It's regulated, so build compliance in as you go. * **Manage \& Scale a Hybrid Team:** Run Growth as GTM Engineering: Lead the current Growth Ops and BDR team toward sharper targeting and automation. Build a human\-and\-agent operating model: agents doing research and personalization at scale, people directing strategy and creative. * **Build a Technical Growth Pod:** Empower this technical pod to build bespoke internal growth tools, engineer new acquisition loops, and test technical hypotheses that standard marketers can't execute. **What you will bring to SmithRx:** * **Creative and rigorous**: You have the ability to generate bold, high\-variance ideas. You also hold them to hard measurement. Both halves matter: the creative swings, and the discipline to know which ones actually worked. * **First\-Principles Thinker:** You don't just copy/paste the B2B SaaS playbook. You have a proven ability to evaluate complex, nuanced markets (like healthcare, fintech, etc) and design bespoke growth strategies from scratch. * **Scientific Mindset:** You treat growth as a science. You have a strong track record of designing rigorous tests, a high tolerance for failed experiments, and a relentless focus on capturing and applying learnings. * **Full\-Funnel \& Outbound Expertise:** You understand how to experiment with outbound sales cadences, BDR metrics, and pipeline generation just as well as digital acquisition. * **Technical Acumen:** You know how to deploy technical talent (Growth PMs and Developers) to build programmatic growth engines, run complex tests, and bypass traditional marketing limitations. * **AI\-Powered Experimentation:** You go past using ChatGPT to write emails. You use AI/LLM agents for account research and personalized outbound at scale (Clay, Cargo, agent tooling), and you build the team around that model. * **Growth Architecture:** You are comfortable designing workflows across modern growth stacks. You have hands\-on experience with advanced data enrichment, behavioral product analytics (e.g., PostHog, Amplitude), intent\-signaling platforms, and conversion optimization tools (e.g., Mutiny, VWO). * **No\-Code / Low\-Code Operations:** You and your Growth Ops lead can move fast without waiting on IT. You know how to use modern LLM platforms to build the tools and infrastructure you need. * **Proven Leader with Hands\-On Experience:** 8\+ years of experience in growth marketing, demand generation, or revenue operations at a high\-growth, venture\-backed startup. **What SmithRx Offers You:** * Highly competitive wellness benefits including Medical, Pharmacy, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance and AD\&D Insurance * Flexible Spending Benefits * 401(k) Retirement Savings Program * Short\-term and long\-term disability * Discretionary Paid Time Off * Paid Company Holidays * Wellness Benefits * Commuter Benefits * Paid Parental Leave benefits * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * Well\-stocked kitchen in office locations * Professional development and training opportunities **Compensation \& Benefits** * **Base Salary:** The range listed above reflects our standard pay scale and actual pay will vary based on work location, job level, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. * **Total Rewards:** In addition to base pay, this role may be eligible for bonuses, commissions, or equity. SmithRx offers a variety of benefits to help you live well, including: time off programs, medical, dental, vision, mental health support, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance and 401(k). Individual offers are tailored to your geography, experience, skills, and education. Your recruiter can share more specific details during the hiring process. In the meantime, feel free to explore our comprehensive benefits here.

jobs.title: Process Engineer
jobs.description: **Position:** Process Engineer**Job Code:** MEPEP1 \+ Eng I, Process Eng**Location:** Delaware Water Gap, PA **The Opportunity:** The Process Engineer is responsible for managing technical projects aimed at product and process problem\-solving and/or improvements, cost reduction, and profitability improvement. Process Engineers provide technical assistance to the operating departments to help them achieve the mill’s goals and objectives while driving continuous process improvement. **How you will impact Smurfit Westrock:** **Major Job Responsibilities:** *Business Excellence** Determine and implement process changes and/or trials to improve operating efficiency and performance and minimize variation * Perform daily checks of production output and contributing factors * Partner with operations, E\&I, and Process Control Engineers to understand all processes and how teams and individuals are involved and impacted at each step * Provide operators, other managers, and salaried employees with analytical support and problem\-solving related to operating processes * Drive continuous process improvement within an operating area through the coordination and management of process trials * Translate production efficiencies and reduced variances to revenues and costs * Use material balances to identify process problems with transmitters and other equipment * Serve as the owner and subject matter expert for Process Book (the mill’s software to view Distributed Control System equipment), ensuring that all data and documentation is accurate and up to date * Develop PI pages to capture insight into processes and equipment, including the creation of new PI tags (e.g. flow, pressure, temperature, and mode on the equipment) * Track and analyze data related to any trials, changes and continual production information to inform recommendations and decisions * Gather and cleanse production and process data and perform statistical/analytical tests to uncover important variables and their impacts * Generate production reporting, create process monitoring reports, and perform daily troubleshooting of the process *People and Culture** Review and share best practices with peers in technical subject areas including computer software and systems (PI Vision/Process Book, Excel, quality data tracker, EhkoSoft) * Support the area operations management with daily production reporting * Regularly communicate process\-related data to operations and management in readily consumable way * Deliver presentations to operations team and leadership providing an executive\-level summary of Process Excellence projects * Could be responsible for vacation coverage for Shift Supervisors *Critical Skills / Capabilities** **Analytical:** Logically processes information to produce insights in a consumable format; aggregates, cleanses, and disseminates data in structured formats to support better business decisions and improved performance; process\-analysis skills to evaluate data and make decisions to drive process improvements * **Process\-****Oriented**: Plans, designs, manages processes while focusing on refining and improving to increase efficiency and effectiveness; understands process inputs, activities, outputs, roles and sequencing * **Problem\-Solving:** Identifies and analyzes problems; weighs relevance and accuracy of information; generates and evaluates alternative solutions; makes recommendations; demonstrates tackling a problem by using a logical, systematic, or sequential approach * **Communication:** Clearly exchanges thoughts, ideas, and messages through written, verbal, and non\-verbal methods that promote an understanding with the target audience; listens carefully and attentively; can clearly convey process\-related data to operations and management in readily consumable way * **Interpersonal:** Can relate to and communicate effectively with others to build rapport and relationships * **Organizational Skills:** Plans, arranges and/or monitor's work to ensure achievement of desired results; establishes a systematic course of action to accomplish objectives * **Time Management:** Plans, prioritizes, and manages time spent on accomplishing tasks to increase productivity and efficiency; demonstrates awareness and control over amount of time spent on activities; meets deadlines * **Growth and Results Oriented**: Demonstrates an interest, willingness and drive to learn new things; seeks to understand concepts, processes, and ideas within area of functional expertise; naturally inquisitive; sets meaningful goals for personal work productivity *Technical Skills** Proficient computer skills including experience with the following systems and applications: + Microsoft Office – Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, Word + OSISoft PI Platforms or other data management systems *Work Environment** Time split between office and operating floor – 4\+ hours in operating environment (nonclimate controlled conditions) **What you need to succeed:** **Experience:*** Required: 0\-2 years of experience in a process engineering role * Preferred: Work experience in the paper industry or similar industry through an internship or co\-op **Education:*** Required: Bachelor’s degree or higher in science or engineering; paper science \& engineering or chemical engineering preferred * Preferred: PI Training **What we offer:*** Corporate culture based on integrity, respect, accountability, and excellence. * Comprehensive training with numerous learning and development opportunities. * An attractive salary reflecting skills, competencies, and potential. * Benefits package to include medical, dental, vision, life insurance, 401k with match, tuition reimbursement, employee discounts, employee referral bonus, and much more! * A career with a global packaging company where Sustainability, Safety and Inclusion are business drivers and foundational elements of the daily work.

jobs.description: **Job ID** 16865 **Department** B2R/P2P/H2R/R2D/ECM/BI **Employment Status** Regular **Type** Full Time \- Salaried **\# of Openings** 2 **Union Classification** Non Union **Work Location** Office Hybrid **Job Location** Everett, Washington (US\-WA) **Closing Date** 10/05/2026 **Salary/Wage** $93,677\.00 \- $184,253\.00 annually **Posting Information** ----------------------- **The successful candidates will be placed in the appropriate job title based on qualifications.** **We strongly encourage you to submit a cover letter along with your application to help us understand why you would make a strong fit as Applications Configuration Engineer on Team PUD.** **Job Definition** ------------------ We are seeking a highly skilled SAP Enterprise Content Management (ECM) Configuration Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in OpenText Communications (Exstream), integrations, batch, invoice processing, letter template development, and experience configuring multiple output connectors. The role requires a high level of analytical and troubleshooting skills, as well as in\-depth knowledge of utility industry business processes, application \& data security, communication skills and analysis of business requirements. Performs independent research within business to resolve business issues and process improvements. Formulates and defines business scope and objectives through research and fact\-finding combined with an understanding of business and industry requirements. With this knowledge, develops or modifies complex business process. Performs functional analysis, technical requirements definition and application module configuration and testing. jobs.title: I&C Renewables & BESS Site Lead Engineer/Specialist - I&C Renewables Project Support
jobs.description: **WORK LOCATION, SCHEDULE, \& TRAVEL:** * The successful candidate may be located at GPC Headquarters in Atlanta or at an operational plant site within our service territory, based on organizational needs and candidate qualifications. * Hybrid work schedule (both in\-office and telecommute); currently four (4\) days in\-office and one (1\) day telecommute (subject to adjustment). * Relocation assistance may be provided if the successful candidate does not currently live within a reasonable commute distance. This position will require some travel (day and overnight, up to 30%) and the ability to work successfully in a remote/virtual environment with access to internet service. * **POSITION SUMMARY** The I\&C Renewables \& BESS Site Lead Engineer/Specialist at Southern Company is pivotal in the renewable and resilient energy sector and is responsible for the design, integration, implementation, operation, maintenance, and lifecycle management of plant control systems, SCADA systems, and communications infrastructure supporting renewable and resilient energy facilities including solar, battery energy storage systems (BESS), distributed energy resources (DERs), microgrids, and other emerging grid technologies. The successful candidate will be a member of the I\&C Renewables Project Support team, providing call\-out, project, technical, and operational support to ensure the reliable operation of plant control systems, SCADA systems, and communications infrastructure across Southern Company's renewable and resilient energy fleet. **POSITION QUALIFICATIONS** **Education:** * Bachelor's degree in Engineering (ABET accredited), Computer Science, Information Systems, or related technical discipline preferred. Associate degree in Engineering Technology, Industrial Controls, or related technical fields with relevant experience will be considered. * **Experience:** * Minimum three (3\) years of experience supporting, maintaining, or managing plant control systems and/or SCADA systems. * Experience with designing, troubleshooting, and maintaining plant control system hardware and software strongly preferred. * Experience with configuration, programming, and communications connectivity of Real\-Time Automation Controllers (RTACs) and/or Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs) strongly preferred. * Experience with design, testing, and configuration in logic scripting languages such as structured text, ladder logic, and function block preferred. * Experience with SCADA integration fundamentals such as tagging, alarming, Human\-Machine Interfaces (HMIs) preferred * Experience with data management techniques using industrial automation communication protocols (e.g. Modbus, OPC, DNP3\) preferred. * Experience with communications technologies such as fiber optic networks, Ethernet, VPN, and cellular communications a plus. Experience with Inverter\-Based Resource (IBR) control systems a plus. * **Key Responsibilities:** * Provide site ownership, call\-out support, and representation for assigned plant control systems. * Serve as a technical expert pertaining to hardware, software, and architecture for assigned sites. * Coordinate control system activities during project implementation and outages. * Support real\-time operations through troubleshooting and maintenance of SCADA systems, communications networks, and remote monitoring infrastructure. * Collaborate with the broader team to support Remote Operations Center (ROC) integration and operational readiness for applicable sites * Lead contractors and vendors during control system deployments. * Improve and maintain plant control and automation systems used for real\-time monitoring and control of renewable and resilient energy facilities * Develop, configure, and maintain process control equipment, including RTACs, PLCs, and renewable generation\-related instrumentation. * Create and maintain schematics, documentation, and diagrams as needed for existing systems, new implementations, upgrades, and changes. * Assist in specification, procurement, configuration, field checkout, and commissioning of control systems. * Assist in developing project scope definitions, estimates, and schedules. Assist with maintaining compliance with Southern Company’s cybersecurity standards, regulatory compliance, and NERC/CIP requirements applicable to renewable and resilient energy facilities. * **Additional Useful Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:** * Knowledge of I/O, metering, and protective relays. * Knowledge of networking and firewalls, including concepts such as NATs and VLANs, and experience using tools such as Wireshark. * Knowledge of engineering drawing tools such as AutoCAD, Microsoft Visio, and draw.io. * Knowledge of field instrumentation communications (e.g., meteorological stations, combiner boxes, inverters). * Knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL, hypervisors, and Windows Server. Knowledge of commissioning and start\-up testing for reactive power, active power, curtailment, availability, and performance. * **Behavioral Attributes:** * Must consistently demonstrate the behavior of Our Values – Safety First, Intentional Inclusion, Act with Integrity, and Superior Performance + **Safety First:** Prioritize the safety and well\-being of employees, customers, and communities. + **Intentional Inclusion** : Foster a culture of belonging and value diversity within the team. + **Act with Integrity** : Conduct business with honesty, respect, and fairness. + **Superior Performance** : Focus on continuous improvement and exceptional service delivery. * **People Priority:** Commit to developing yourself and those around you. * **Growth Mindset:** Take Lessons Learned opportunities to grow skills, learn from prior efforts, and foster collaboration. * **Proactivity** : Take personal ownership and responsibility for work. For a list of our competitive benefit offerings, please visit this link . **About Southern Company** Southern Company (NYSE: SO ) is a leading energy provider serving 9 million customers across the Southeast and beyond through its family of companies. Providing clean, safe, reliable and affordable energy with excellent service is our mission. The company has electric operating companies in three states, natural gas distribution companies in four states, a competitive generation company, a leading distributed energy solutions provider with national capabilities, a fiber optics network and telecommunications services. Through an industry\-leading commitment to innovation, resilience and sustainability, we are taking action to meet customers' and communities' needs while advancing our goal of net\-zero greenhouse gas emissions by 2050\. Our uncompromising values ensure we put the needs of those we serve at the center of everything we do and are the key to our sustained success. We are transforming energy into economic, environmental and social progress for tomorrow. jobs.title: Fluids Engineer (Power Generation) - Memphis
jobs.description: SpaceXAI's mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge. Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands\-on and to contribute directly to the company's mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates. **ABOUT THE ROLE:** The Power Generation Engineering team is seeking a talented Fluids Engineer where you will have the opportunity to utilize your knowledge, experience, and creativity to rapidly design, build, and activate fluid systems supporting power plants and related generation infrastructure. **RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Design, build, and activate fluid systems for power generation plants, including fuel gas, ammonia, water, compressed/instrument air, and HVAC * Utilize knowledge of thermodynamics, fluid flow, and control theory to design and analyze power plant process and utility fluid systems * Model piping assemblies using CAD software and perform piping stress analysis * Read and develop detailed piping and instrumentation diagrams of complex fluids systems * Select components, such as valves, pumps, piping, tanks, heat exchangers, and filters, and provide detailed specifications for their purchase * Coordinate with engineers from other disciplines (civil, structural, electrical, controls, etc) to establish a complete system design * Manage the fabrication and installation of fluid systems and other construction projects occurring at the power plant, hands\-on in the field, alongside skilled technician teams * Perform planning, analysis, and troubleshooting of system performance during real\-time plant operations, commissioning, and post\-outage data reviews * Work closely with operations teams to ensure system design is well\-understood and easy to operate long term * Provide innovative solutions to problems under minimal supervision or direction **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:** * Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline * 1\+ years of experience with fluid systems or process engineering **PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:** * Master's degree in mechanical, chemical, or related engineering discipline * 5\+ years of hands\-on experience working with industrial fluid systems in a professional setting or outside the classroom project team * Experience with fuel gas, ammonia (storage, delivery, and/or process use), water treatment or cooling water, compressed/instrument air, and HVAC or chilled\-water systems * Demonstrated expertise in the design, build, and operation of pressurized fluid systems per ASME B31, ASME B\&PV Code Section VIII, or other applicable standards * Experience using Siemens NX, SOLIDWORKS, or similar CAD software * Experience using CAESAR II or similar pipe stress analysis programs * Experience using python or other programming languages for data review and analysis * Familiarity with industrial piping, fittings, and specifications (ASME/ANSI) * Familiarity with instrumentation selection in industrial or severe service * Experience operating and troubleshooting control systems required for remote or plant operations * Excellent written and oral communication, especially translating technical concepts for non\-technical audiences * Ability to work with and lead technicians during fabrication and commissioning of systems * Familiarity with Root\-Cause Analysis and Risk Mitigation process * Adaptability to change in direction of projects **ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:** * Must be willing to travel to other SpaceX locations as necessary * Schedules vary due to plant operational needs \- flexibility is required * Ability to lift up to 25 lbs. unassisted * Lifting, standing, climbing, bending, grasping, sitting, pulling, pushing, stooping, stretching, and carrying are generally required to perform the functions of this position *SpaceXAI is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer – ERP & MES
jobs.description: **Position Summary** Stainless Structurals is seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer to help design and build a new ERP platform while supporting and enhancing our existing in\-house manufacturing system. Reporting to the **Head of AI**, this is a hands\-on role combining business process discovery, requirements gathering, software development, database design, system integration, data migration and production support. The engineer will work directly with users across Sales, Accounting, Purchasing, Production and Quality to understand business needs and translate them into reliable software solutions. This is a hybrid position based in the Greater Houston area. Local candidates are preferred. Relocation assistance is not provided. **Key Responsibilities** * Lead discovery and requirements gathering with business users, including understanding current workflows, identifying pain points and translating business needs into clear functional and technical requirements. * Design and develop ERP functionality for quoting, orders, inventory, purchasing, shipping, invoicing, AR/AP and related workflows. * Maintain and enhance our existing MES/manufacturing application supporting work orders, production planning, quality and material traceability. * Migrate business data and functionality from existing systems into the new platform. * Design and maintain database schemas, APIs and integrations between ERP, MES, reporting tools and other systems. * Test, deploy and support business\-critical applications in production. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems or a related field. * 3–5 years of professional software development experience, including experience with business\-critical applications. * Experience with ERP, order management, inventory management or other transactional business systems. * Strong SQL and relational database design skills; MySQL experience preferred. * Strong backend software development experience using C\#/.NET, Java, Python or a comparable modern programming language, with working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML and CSS. * Experience with APIs, system integrations and data exchange between applications. * Experience across the full software development lifecycle, from discovery and requirements gathering through deployment and support. * Strong understanding of software and database architecture. * Proficiency with Git. * Ability to work independently and communicate effectively with non\-technical users. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with MES or other manufacturing systems. * Experience with data migration from legacy systems. * Manufacturing or industrial experience. * Experience as a lead or principal developer for a business\-critical internal application. * Experience using AI\-assisted development tools such as Claude, Codex or similar. **About Us** Stainless Structurals is a manufacturer and supplier of stainless and carbon steel structural shapes, tubing and custom profiles. Based in Conroe, Texas, we use advanced laser\-welding and fabrication technologies to produce both standard and custom solutions for customers across a wide range of industries. Pay: $120,000\.00 \- $135,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid holidays * Paid time off * Vision insurance Application Question(s): * Are you legally authorized to work in the United States? * Will you now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status? * How many years of professional software development experience do you have? * Do you have professional experience working with ERP, order management, inventory management, or another transactional business system? * Do you have experience with relational databases and SQL? * Do you have experience gathering requirements directly from business users and translating them into software solutions? jobs.description: **Job Description** ------------------- The Bureau of Bridges and Structures (BOBS) Structural Fabrication Unit serves as the statewide fabrication authority responsible for implementing the Michigan Department of Transportation’s (MDOT) quality assurance program for fabricated and manufactured bridge, culvert, and highway structural products supplied to MDOT projects. This position serves as the recognized resource Fabrication Technical Engineer. Fabricated/manufactured bridge, culvert, and highway structural products consist of steel bridge beam/girders; prestressed concrete bridge girders; bridge bearings (mechanical and high\-load multi\-rotational); bridge expansion joints (modular bridge expansion and finger joints); bridge railings; steel highway structures (cantilever, truss, dynamic message sign, traffic signal mast arm \& pole, and bridge mounted signs); spun concrete poles; culverts; noise walls; mechanically stabilized earth wall panels; and precast concrete bridge element systems. This position is responsible for reviewing fabricator/manufacturer technical documents (e.g., request for information, nonconformance reports, corrective action request, concrete mix design, standard repair procedures, welding procedure specifications, etc.) and contract documents to verify compliance with statewide and national industry standards related to fabrication and manufacturing. This position also participates in the development of and serves as a technical reviewer of fabrication related special provisions used for MDOT projects. Additionally, this position is responsible for assisting with troubleshooting fabrication issues related to materials, fabrication process, or design. This position requires possession of a valid driver’s license to perform fabrication facility visits and project site reviews. We need you to be open to ideas and to bring your own new ideas to the team. We offer a fun, engaging, supportive environment in which your talent can thrive. So, if you’re looking for a place where you can constantly learn more, be more and contribute to a team, this is it. **Does this sound just like you so far? Okay, good. related technologies: Windows Server, Azure, Exchange, SQL, SharePoint, etc. * Implement and support disaster recovery solutions. * Technical services and support at the network level: WAN and LAN connectivity, routers, firewalls, and security. * Remote access solution implementation and support: VPN, Remote Desktop / Terminal Services, and Azure Virtual Desktop. * System documentation to include system reviews and recommendations. * Travels to customer sites to perform work when appropriate (company vehicle provided). * Maintains familiarity with industry best practices. * Communicate effectively with customers and the Service Team * Actively participates in team and company meetings. * Install, configure, test and maintain operating systems, application software and system management tools * Proactively ensure the highest levels of systems and infrastructure availability * Monitor and test application performance for potential bottlenecks, identify possible solutions, and work with developers to implement those fixes * Maintain security, backup, and redundancy strategies * Provide 2nd and 3rd level support **Requirements** * BS degree in Computer Science, Virtual Desktop or Terminal Services (RDS) + Small Business Networks + Microsoft SQL + Microsoft Windows Server 2016, 2019, 2022 * PREFERRED (one or multiple): * Microsoft AZURE * Microsoft MCSA, MCSE jobs.title: Sales Account Management, Staff
jobs.description: Austin, Texas, United States **Category** Sales **Hire Type** Employee **Job ID** 18737 **Base Salary Range** $126000\-$189000 **Date posted** 09/20/2026 ### **We Are** Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. ### **You Are** You have spent years in the semiconductor space and you understand that emulation is not just another tool, it is the difference between a chip that tapes out on time and one that burns six months chasing bugs in silicon. You know how to listen to a verification manager describe their problem and translate it into a solution that involves emulation, FPGA prototyping, or virtual platforms without sounding like you are reading a datasheet. You are comfortable in technical conversations where the customer knows more about their design than you ever will, but you also know how to frame the business case for a VP who cares about schedule risk and engineering headcount, not clock cycles. You have closed deals that took months to develop because you stayed close, brought the right technical resources at the right time, and did not disappear after the contract signature. You think in customer outcomes, not quotas. When a deal gets complicated, you do not hand it off, you work through it. At Synopsys, you will sell products that actually matter to teams trying to verify the next generation of chips powering everything from data centers to autonomous vehicles. ### **What You'll Be Doing** * Drive sales of Synopsys emulation, FPGA prototyping, and virtual prototyping solutions to semiconductor and system companies in your territory * Work directly with design and verification teams to understand their hardware and software verification challenges and position the right technical solution * Collaborate with Synopsys field application engineers and technical specialists to scope solutions, run evaluations, and build proof of value with customers * Develop and present business proposals that connect technical capabilities to customer schedule, cost, and risk priorities * Negotiate and close complex, multi\-quarter sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders across engineering, procurement, and executive leadership * Partner with customer success and technical account teams post\-sale to ensure deployment success, adoption, and expansion opportunities * Maintain accurate pipeline forecasting and account planning in Salesforce, keeping leadership informed on deal progress and risk ### **The Impact You Will Have** * You will directly enable semiconductor companies to reduce verification cycles and get products to market faster by deploying the right emulation and prototyping platforms * Your ability to position technical value will help engineering teams justify and secure budget for verification infrastructure that scales with their design complexity * The relationships you build will create long\-term partnerships where Synopsys becomes the trusted verification platform provider across multiple product generations * You will influence product roadmap priorities by surfacing real customer needs and competitive gaps back to product management and engineering * Your deal structuring and negotiation will contribute measurably to Synopsys revenue growth in one of the highest\-value product lines in the EDA portfolio * The solutions you help deploy will support verification of chips that power AI, automotive, mobile, and cloud infrastructure used by millions of people * You will help customers adopt newer technologies like virtual prototyping and hybrid verification flows that fundamentally change how they develop hardware and software together ### **What You'll Need** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent technical field * 5 to 8 years of experience in IC design, verification, or technical sales within the semiconductor industry * Demonstrated success selling or supporting complex technical products, ideally in EDA, emulation, simulation, or verification tools * Strong understanding of chip design and verification workflows including RTL simulation, emulation, FPGA prototyping, and software bring\-up * Proven ability to manage multi\-stakeholder sales cycles involving engineering teams, IT, procurement, and executive decision makers * Experience using Salesforce or similar CRM tools to manage pipeline, forecast, and track customer engagement * Experience selling business value and ROI to director and VP\-level executives is a strong plus ### **Who You Are** * You can sit in a technical deep dive with a verification lead and then walk into an executive meeting an hour later and explain why this deal matters in two sentences * You do not wait for the perfect moment to engage a customer, you find a reason to add value and start the conversation even when there is no active opportunity * You are disciplined about pipeline hygiene and forecast accuracy because you know your manager and the business depend on reliable data, not optimism * You bring technical resources into deals at the right time, not too early when the customer is not ready and not too late when you have lost credibility * You handle objections and competitive pressure without getting rattled, you listen, acknowledge the concern, and refocus the conversation on what the customer is actually trying to solve * You follow through after the sale because you know that reference customers and expansions come from teams that actually succeeded with your product, not just signed a contract ### **The Team You'll Be Part Of** Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process. ### **Rewards and Benefits** We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process. At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability. In addition to the base salary, this role may be eligible for an annual bonus, equity, and other discretionary bonuses. Synopsys offers comprehensive health, wellness, and financial benefits as part of a competitive total rewards package. The actual compensation offered will be based on a number of job\-related factors, including location, skills, experience, and education. Your recruiter can share more specific details on the total rewards package upon request. The base salary range for this role is across the U.S.

jobs.title: Application Engineer
jobs.description: **Position Overview** Application Engineer (Entry Level) will support our sales team and drive client relations to promote and sell our advanced conductor product. The ideal candidate will have a solid engineering background, excellent communication skills, and a passion for working in both technical and business development roles **Essential Functions** **Sales \& Business Development Support:** Assist engineers and the sales team, providing technical insight to effectively present and sell our advanced conductor. **Technical Consultation:** Support client inquiries, providing basic technical assistance and explaining how our product can be integrated into high\-voltage transmission lines. **Technical Presentations:** Assist in preparing and delivering presentations or product demonstrations to clients, helping to explain the benefits and features of our products in an understandable way. **Travel:** Assist with client visits and industry events as required, gaining hands\-on experience in business development and client interaction. **Independent \& Team Collaboration:** Work independently on assigned tasks while also collaborating with the sales and engineering teams to meet overall company goals. **Other Skills/Abilities** Technical Knowledge: Familiar with Transmission and Distribution T\&D industry. Familiar with basic power engineering concepts: AC, DC power transmission, power factor, phase angle, voltage transmission efficiency, sag tension analysis and theoretical understanding of material’s stress strain relationship. Thermal rating and material science understanding of heat capacity, current heating and thermal exchange forms: solar radiation heating, convection heat loss etc.Analytical and Problem\-Solving Skills: Engineers should have strong analytical skills to analyze complex problems and propose effective solutions. They should be able to break down problems into smaller components, conduct research, gather data, and apply critical thinking to identify the root causes and develop innovative approaches to problem\-solving. Attention to Detail: Engineers must pay close attention to detail, ensuring accuracy in their work. They should be meticulous in following engineering standards, specifications, and documentation requirements. Communication Skills: Effective communication is crucial for engineers to collaborate with team members, understand project requirements, and present their ideas or findings. They should be able to convey technical and design information clearly, both verbally and in writing. This position requires proficiency in the ability to speak and read English. Teamwork and Collaboration: Engineers often work as part of multidisciplinary teams. They should be able to collaborate effectively, share knowledge, and contribute to team goals. Being a good team player and demonstrating interpersonal skills is important in achieving project objectives. Adaptability and Learning Agility: Engineers should be adaptable to new technologies, changing project requirements, and evolving industry practices. They should be willing to learn and acquire new skills quickly as the engineering field continues to advance. Time Management and Organization: Engineers need to prioritize tasks, manage their time effectively, and meet project deadlines. They should be able to work on multiple assignments simultaneously and maintain a well\-organized workflow. Professional Ethics: Engineers should demonstrate a strong sense of professional ethics, integrity, and responsibility. They should adhere to engineering standards, regulations, and safety protocols. Maintaining confidentiality and respecting intellectual property rights are also important aspects of professional conduct. Continuous Learning: Engineers should have a growth mindset and a commitment to lifelong learning. They should actively seek opportunities to enhance their technical skills, stay updated with industry trends, and pursue professional development activities. Leadership Potential: While not always a requirement at the junior level, possessing leadership qualities and the ability to take initiative can contribute to career growth. Engineers who show potential in leading projects, taking ownership, and mentoring others may have increased opportunities for advancement. **Incentives*** Benefits offered the first of the month following 30 days of employment, include: medical, dental, life insurance, long term disability, paid time off (sick and vacation), 9 company holidays, 401(k), etc. * Referral Rewards program **Requirements** * Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Electrical, Mechanical, or related field). * Internship or prior experience in energy, engineering consulting, or utilities industry. * Exposure to or interest in advanced materials such as carbon fiber or products used in electrical transmission systems. * Strong public speaking and presentation skills. * Excellent written and verbal communication. * Self\-motivated, ambitious, and willing to work independently to achieve business goals. * Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage time effectively while balancing multiple tasks. * A passion for engineering, business development, and a desire to grow in a sales or business development role. * Basic knowledge of business development or sales in a technical field. **Training and Experience** * A recent graduate with a degree in Engineering (Electrical, Mechanical, or related field). * Understanding of high\-voltage transmission systems or an eagerness to learn about this area. * Strong technical aptitude and problem\-solving skills, with a keen interest in learning more about advanced engineering products. * Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and PLS\-CADD software is a plus. * Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage time effectively while balancing multiple tasks. * A passion for engineering, business development, and a desire to grow in a sales or business development role. * Willingness to travel for client meetings, conferences, and industry events as needed. **Work Environment** Manufacturing warehouse environment with exposure to machinery, noise and varying temperatures. Use of personal protective equipment (PPE) as required. Fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment.

jobs.title: AI Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: ### **AI Platform Engineer** ### **About Tessera Labs** Tessera Labs is redefining how enterprises adopt and operationalize Artificial Intelligence. Backed by Foundation Capital and led by a world\-class founding team, we build multi\-agent AI systems that automate complex business workflows across platforms like SAP, Salesforce, Workday, Snowflake, DataBricks, and more. Our mission is simple but ambitious: bring real AI automation to the enterprise — with speed, precision, and measurable impact. We move fast, operate with extreme ownership, and build at the frontier of applied AI. ### **About the Team** The AI platform team builds and operates the foundational AI agent infrastructure that lets Tessera run reliably, securely, and consistently across customer environments. This includes a portable cloud infrastructure that makes each environment production\-ready: container orchestration (Kubernetes), networking, and automation that ensures our product behaves the same regardless of the underlying cloud provider. This is a high\-impact role because it directly enables our ability to onboard and operate enterprise customer environments under strict security and compliance constraints while preserving developer velocity. The work reduces integration risk, standardizes operational practices across hyperscalers, and ensures product teams can ship safely without infrastructure becoming a bottleneck. ### **The Role** As an AI Platform Engineer, you’ll design and own production\-grade AI agent infrastructure that supports Tessera’s AI systems across multiple cloud providers. You’ll work on everything from Kubernetes and Terraform to observability, security, and reliability with real ownership over architectural decisions. This is a hands\-on, senior IC role for someone who enjoys thinking deeply about systems and building AI agent infrastructure the right way. ### **What You’ll Do** * Design, build, and maintain production\-grade AI agent infrastructure * Be part of a team that supports Tessera’s AI infrastructure across every cloud provider * Build and be the primary owner of the Azure or Oracle Cloud variant of Tessera’s cloud infrastructure, also support GCP and AWS. * Enable portable infrastructure across customer environments * Improve observability, security, and system reliability * Deploy and operate applications using Kubernetes and Terraform * Partner closely with product and platform engineers to unblock delivery * Design and build CI/CD pipelines, own the end\-to\-end automation of build, test, and deployment workflows for both infrastructure and application code * Build and maintain a reusable automation framework for day\-to\-day DevOps and developer workflows, covering environment provisioning, secret rotation, dependency updates, compliance checks, and release management * Automate operational runbooks and recurring processes, identify manual work across the engineering org and systematically eliminate it through scripts, pipeline stages, and self\-service tooling * Champion an automation\-first mindset across the team, if something is done twice, it should be automated; if it's automated, it should be observable and maintained like production code ### **Must\-Have Qualifications** * 5\+ years experience as a Cloud Infrastructure Engineer * Strong hands\-on experience with Terraform * Strong hands\-on experience with Kubernetes * Strong hands\-on experience in Azure, Oracle Cloud, GCP or AWS * Proven track record designing and owning CI/CD systems, pipeline architecture, GitOps\-driven deployments, release automation, and pipeline\-as\-code practices expanded * Experience building automation frameworks for DevOps and developer workflows, including scripting (Bash, Python, or similar), workflow orchestration, and self\-service tooling that reduces manual intervention across engineering processes expanded * Strong networking fundamentals * Proven experience deploying and operating real production systems ### **Nice\-to\-Have Qualifications** * Experience with FluxCD or other GitOps controllers (ArgoCD, etc.) * Understanding of cloud security and DevSecOps, integrating security gates, SBOM generation, and compliance checks into CI/CD pipelines * Deep networking expertise \- \- duplicate from above * A passion (and curiosity) about clean, unified infrastructure and best practices * Experience with software development and SDLC and a builder mindset ### **Who You Are** * Somebody with a passion for learning new things and robust, reliable infrastructure * Comfortable owning and defending complex AI agent infrastructure decisions * Experienced in startups and/or big tech environments * Highly self\-motivated with a strong ownership mindset * Someone who enjoys building foundational systems that other engineers rely on ### **Why Join Tessera Labs** * Work on cutting\-edge AI infrastructure with real enterprise impact * Own foundational systems at an early\-stage, high\-growth company * Collaborate with a sharp, execution\-focused founding team * Shape how AI is deployed across the largest enterprise platforms in the world Compensation Range: $200K \- $250K

jobs.description: **Job Title:** Senior Director, Software Engineering Senior Director, EviCore Software Engineering The Senior Director, EviCore Software Engineering AI Transformation is a strategic technology executive responsible for leading software engineering organizations that deliver scalable, secure, and innovative digital solutions supporting EviCores business growth and customer experience objectives. This leader drives the modernization of technology platforms, accelerates AI\-enabled transformation, and champions organizational change across product, engineering, operations, and business teams. The role serves as a key technology partner to business leaders, product management, operations, customer experience, and enterprise architecture teams to define and execute a technology vision that advances business strategy, customer outcomes, and operational excellence. The Senior Director will lead large engineering functions, establish modern engineering practices, accelerate adoption of Artificial Intelligence and automation capabilities, and cultivate a high\-performing culture focused on innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement. This leader will play a critical role in transforming how technology is delivered by leveraging AI\-powered development, intelligent automation, advanced analytics, and modern software engineering practices to improve speed\-to\-market, enhance customer experiences, optimize operations, and create sustainable competitive advantage. Responsibilities Technology Software Engineering Leadership * Provide strategic leadership for software engineering teams responsible for the design, development, delivery, and support of enterprise\-scale applications and platforms. * Establish and execute multi\-year technology roadmaps aligned to enterprise strategy, customer needs, and business objectives. * Ensure engineering solutions are scalable, secure, resilient, maintainable, and aligned with enterprise architecture standards. * Drive adoption of modern software engineering practices including Agile, DevSecOps, CI/CD, cloud\-native architecture, observability, and platform engineering. * Foster a culture of technical excellence, innovation, accountability, and continuous learning across engineering teams. AI Transformation Leadership * Define and execute an enterprise AI transformation strategy that embeds Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, machine learning, and intelligent automation into business and technology processes. * Partner with business leaders to identify and prioritize AI use cases that improve customer experience, operational efficiency, productivity, decision\-making, and business outcomes. * Drive responsible AI adoption, governance, compliance, risk management, and ethical AI practices across the organization. * Lead transformation initiatives that leverage AI\-enabled software development, automated testing, predictive analytics, intelligent workflows, and digital assistants. * Evaluate emerging technologies and establish frameworks for scaling AI capabilities across products, platforms, and operational functions. * Champion data\-driven decision making through advanced analytics and AI\-powered insights. Organizational Transformation Change Leadership * Lead large\-scale organizational transformation efforts that improve operating models, team effectiveness, delivery predictability, and business agility. * Establish a transformation vision that aligns technology investments, organizational structures, talent strategies, and business priorities. * Drive cultural change by fostering innovation, collaboration, customer\-centricity, continuous improvement, and measurable business value. * Develop change management strategies that enable successful adoption of new technologies, operating models, and ways of working. * Influence executive stakeholders and matrix partners to build alignment around strategic transformation initiatives. Customer Experience and Product Partnership * Collaborate with customer experience leaders, product managers, designers, and operational teams to ensure customer needs are reflected in technology strategies and delivery plans. * Leverage customer insights, journey mapping, and market intelligence to identify opportunities for digital innovation and experience improvement. * Ensure engineering and platform investments directly support enhanced customer, client, provider, and employee experiences. * Drive seamless integration of customer experiences across digital channels, platforms, and operational touchpoints. Portfolio and Delivery Management * Oversee large technology portfolios, balancing strategic initiatives, operational priorities, risk management, and resource allocation. * Partner with product and business leaders to prioritize investments that maximize customer impact and business value. * Establish metrics, KPIs, and executive reporting to measure engineering effectiveness, customer outcomes, transformation progress, and business c vision with operational excellence and execution discipline. * Adaptable and resilient, with the ability to lead effectively in dynamic and evolving business environments. * Continuous learner who stays current on industry trends, AI advancements, technology innovation, and evolving customer expectations. * Courageous change agent who challenges conventional thinking and drives organizational transformation. * Experience leading geographically distributed teams and fostering a high\-performance, inclusive culture. * Strong understanding of customer journey management, digital experience strategy, and customer\-centric product delivery practices. * Proven ability to balance long\-term strategic vision with near\-term execution and operational excellence. * Experience driving adoption of Agile, DevSecOps, cloud, data, AI, and platform modernization capabilities across enterprise organizations. Familiarity with agile delivery processes and practices. jobs.title: Staff Data Engineer - Hybrid
jobs.description: **Job Details** --------------- Location: Hartford, CT Category: Data Engineering Employment Type: Full time, Hybrid Job Ref: R2627123\-168 Sr Staff Data Engineer \- GE07DE Staff Data Engineer \- GE07CE We’re determined to make a difference and are proud to be an insurance company that goes well beyond coverages and policies. Working here means having every opportunity to achieve your goals – and to help others accomplish theirs, too. Join our team as we help shape the future. As a Senior Staff Data Engineer supporting Employee Benefits Sales, you will play a key role in shaping how Sales and Underwriting data is ingested, transformed, and delivered across the organization. You’ll work on modern, cloud‑based data platforms to ensure high‑quality, governed data products that drive operational efficiency, analytics, and decision‑making. This role combines deep technical expertise with strong partnership across Underwriting, Product and Enterprise Data teams. The position offers a strong growth path toward Technical Leadership, with hands\-on ownership of Quote and Underwriting data pipelines and opportunities to mentor and influence across teams. This role will have a Hybrid work schedule, with the expectation of working in an office location (Hartford, CT; Chicago, IL; Columbus, OH; and Charlotte, NC) 3 days a week (Tuesday through Thursday). **Responsibilities:** * Accountable for building small or medium\-scale pipelines and data products. End\-to\-End solution delivery involving multiple platforms and technologies with small to medium complexity or certain sub\-systems of large, complex implementations, leveraging ELT solutions to acquire, integrate, and operationalize data * Provides significant input to influence solution architecture * Build and implement capabilities for continuous integration and continuous delivery aligned with Enterprise DevOps practices. * Accountable for team development and influencing pipeline tool decisions * Accountable for data engineering practices (e.g. Source code management, branching, issue tracking, access, etc.) to be followed for the data pipeline * Independently review, prepare, design and integrate complex (type, quality, volume) data, correcting problems and recommend data cleansing/quality solutions * Provide expert documentation and operating guidance for users of all levels. * Document technical requirements and present complex technical concepts to audiences of varying sizes and levels. * Rapidly architect, design, prototype/POC, implement, and optimize Cloud/Hybrid architectures * Research, experiment, and utilize leading big data methodologies (AWS, Hadoop/EMR, Spark, Kafka, Snowflake) with cloud/on premise hybrid hosting solutions, on a project level * Implement, and test data processing pipelines, and data mining/data science algorithms on a variety of hosted settings (AWS,Client technology stacks) * Stay up to date on emerging data and analytics technologies, tools, techniques, and frameworks. * Evaluate and recommend all technology\-based decisions for tools and frameworks for effective delivery * Support the development and implementation of project and portfolio strategy, roadmaps and implementation **Qualifications:** * Candidates must be authorized to work in the US without company sponsorship. The company will not support the STEM OPT I\-983 Training Plan endorsement for this position. * 8\+ years of data engineering experience and best practices in Distributed systems, Data warehousing solutions SQL and NoSQL, ETL tools, CICD, Bigdata, Cloud Technologies (AWS/AZURE), Python/Spark, Data mesh and Data Lake, Data Fabric * Must have hands on experience in Snowflake, Oracle, Informatica Cloud/Power center, Github * Must have hands\-on experience and knowledge on replication tools like Qlik, Informatica mass ingestion, Shareplex, open flow, DMS * Must be familiar with ETL using Pyspark/Python/snowflake native features * Must be familiar with AWS services such as EMR, S3, Lambda * Certifications on Cloud services such as AWS/GCP and Snowflake * Familiar with AI tools/tech stack **Nice to have qualifications:** * Certifications on AI foundation * Hands\-on experience with AWS Bedrock and Google Vertex **Compensation** The listed annualized base pay range is primarily based on analysis of similar positions in the external market. Actual base pay could vary and may be above or below the listed range based on factors including but not limited to performance, proficiency and demonstration of competencies required for the role. The base pay is just one component of The Hartford’s total compensation package for employees. Other rewards may include short\-term or annual bonuses, long\-term incentives, and on\-the\-spot recognition. The annualized base pay range for this role is: $135,040 \- $202,560 The posted salary range reflects our ability to hire at different position titles and levels depending on background and experience. Equal Opportunity Employer/Sex/Race/Color/Veterans/Disability/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity or Expression/Religion/Age
