jobs.title: RESEARCH FELLOW
jobs.description: **How to Apply** ---------------- Interested candidates should submit a single PDF containing the following to Prof. Sherif El\-Tawil at eltawil@umich.edu * A Cover Letter explicitly detailing your experience in agentic AI/LLMs and confirming your availability for a two\-year minimum commitment. * A detailed Curriculum Vitae (CV) including links to public code repositories or portfolio projects (e.g., GitHub), if applicable. * A Research Statement (1\-2 pages) highlighting your AI background and vision for human\-agentic teaming in complex physical systems. * Contact information for three professional references. **Who We Are** -------------- At Michigan Engineering, we develop the talent and technologies that move society forward and serve our state and national interests. Through discovery and innovation, we create the foundational knowledge and practical technologies to solve not only today's most pressing challenges, but also power industries and change lives. Our programs and community are designed to promote personal well\-being and achievement enabling everyone to unlock their potential and contribute with confidence. **Job Summary** --------------- The Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering at the University of Michigan invites applications for a Postdoctoral Research Fellow to lead the AI architecture development for the newly launched initiative: MResilience\-HAACUR (Center for Human\-Agentic AI Collaboration for Urban Resilience). Working under the supervision of Prof. Sherif El\-Tawil (Civil Engineering) and Atul Prakash (Computer Science), the successful candidate will serve as a key architect for an AI\-enabled urban operations simulation platform. This interdisciplinary initiative connects agentic AI framework design, large language models (LLMs), and interactive digital twins with real\-world municipal decision\-making. The project focuses on deploying auditable, human\-in\-the\-loop AI agents to aid in routine urban operations and emergency response (e.g., severe flooding, power outages, and critical water main failures). **Responsibilities\*** ---------------------- * Agentic AI \& Multi\-Agent Architecture: Architect, build, and evaluate multi\-agent systems powered by LLMs and machine learning, incorporating Orchestrator and Memory agents, vector databases, and knowledge graphs to enable complex goal planning and scenario execution. * Natural\-Language Interaction \& Workflows: Develop conversational, human\-in\-the\-loop interfaces that allow domain experts and non\-technical stakeholders to query real\-time data, execute complex simulations, and run "what\-if" analyses using natural language. * System \& Simulation Integration: Integrate legacy utility documentation, real\-time sensor streams, and domain\-specific engineering/mechanics modeling tools into a unified AI\-driven digital twin testbed. * AI Safety \& Privacy Execution: Implement secure\-by\-design agentic architectures, including sandboxing, tenant isolation, and audit logging to safely handle sensitive municipal and utility infrastructure data. * Pilot Execution \& Translation: Collaborate with computer scientists, civil engineers, and operational partners from the City of Detroit and the Great Lakes Water Authority (GLWA) to run and validate real\-world pilot exercises. * Research Dissemination: Lead the authoring of high\-impact journal articles on agentic AI frameworks, present at premier AI and computational engineering conferences, and contribute to center\-scale extramural grant proposals. **Required Qualifications\*** ----------------------------- * Ph.D. in Civil/Infrastructure Engineering (with an AI focus), Artificial Intelligence, Computational Engineering, or a closely related field. * Strong expertise in Agentic AI \& LLM Systems: Demonstrated experience designing, building, and deploying multi\-agent architectures, tool\-using AI agents, or retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) systems. * Advanced Technical Skills: High proficiency in Python and modern AI/LLM orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, LlamaIndex, PyTorch, or vector databases). * Strict Two\-Year Commitment: Ability to commit to a minimum two\-year appointment. * Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to bridge computer science concepts with domain engineering and municipal applications. **Desired Qualifications\*** ---------------------------- * Experience with human\-in\-the\-loop systems, interactive simulation environments, or digital twin platforms. * Working knowledge or background in mechanics, infrastructure systems, hydrodynamics, or urban asset management. * Experience with enterprise AI security, sandboxing, or privacy\-preserving machine learning. * Track record of working in multidisciplinary teams or collaborating with public sector/industry partners. **Modes of Work** ----------------- Positions that are eligible for hybrid or mobile/remote work mode are at the discretion of the hiring department. Work agreements are reviewed annually at a minimum and are subject to change at any time, and for any reason, throughout the course of employment. Learn more about the work modes. **Additional Information** -------------------------- **Term length** Due to the structured phases and pilot execution timelines of this initiative, this position requires a minimum two\-year commitment. The initial appointment is for a one\-year term with the expectation of a one\-year extension, contingent on performance and funding availability. The anticipated start date is between November 1, 2026 to January 1, 2027\. **Research Environment** The fellow will be embedded within a rich collaborative network, working under the auspices of the Urban Collaboratory and in close connection with the Michigan Institute for Computational Discovery \& Engineering (MICDE). * World\-Class Infrastructure: Access to high\-performance computing resources, advanced AI testbeds, and state\-of\-the\-art testing facilities. * Direct Real\-World Impact: Leverage existing data\-sharing cooperation with Detroit and GLWA to deploy and test agentic AI systems in active municipal contexts. * Interdisciplinary Ecosystem: Collaborate across top\-ranked departments in engineering, computer science, public policy, and information sciences. **Background Screening** ------------------------ The University of Michigan conducts background checks on all job candidates upon acceptance of a contingent offer and may use a third party administrator to conduct background checks. Background checks are performed in compliance with the Fair Credit Reporting Act. **Application Deadline** ------------------------ Job openings are posted for a minimum of seven calendar days. The review and selection process may begin as early as the eighth day after posting. This opening may be removed from posting boards and filled any time after the minimum posting period has ended. **U\-M EEO Statement** ---------------------- The University of Michigan is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. ### **Job Opening ID** 283286 ### **Working Title** RESEARCH FELLOW ### **Job Title** RESEARCH FELLOW ### **Work Location** Ann Arbor Campus Ann Arbor, MI ### **Modes of Work** Onsite ### **Full/Part Time** Full\-Time ### **Regular/Temporary** Regular ### **FLSA Status** Exempt ### **Organizational Group** College Engineering ### **Department** CoE Civil \& Environmental Engr ### **Posting Begin/End Date** 9/21/2026 \- 11/20/2026 ### **Salary** $63,480\.00 \- ### **Career Interest** Research Fellows

jobs.title: Staff Platform Engineer - Materia AI
jobs.description: **Job Description** **Staff Platform Engineer\- Materia AI** Are you excited about building cloud\-native platforms that power Agentic workloads? Join a dynamic and highly skilled team at Thomson Reuters, where we combine the agility and innovation of a startup with the stability and resources of a global leader. As a Platform Engineer, you will contribute to leading the design, development, and evolution of our next\-generation cloud\-native platforms. You will contribute to technical strategy, champion engineering excellence, and build highly scalable, reliable, and secure infrastructure that empowers our product development teams. You will be a hands\-on technical leader, influencing architectural decisions, mentoring team members, and championing best practices in a dynamic and fast\-paced environment. **Key Responsibilities:** *In this opportunity as a Staff Platform Engineer\- Materia AI you will:* * **Innovate with Startup Speed and Enterprise Scale:** Be part of a team that maintains the innovation velocity of a startup while leveraging the operational maturity of a global enterprise. You'll work with top AI and software development experts, building intelligent and scalable systems for accounting professionals. This role is for the CoCounsel for Tax and Accounting team, evolved from the acquisition of Materia, now integrating best\-in\-class enterprise practices with rapid innovation cycles. * **Deliver AI\-Driven Systems:** Launch backend services into production that power generative AI agents and orchestration systems. This role requires both creativity and rigor to ensure our AI\-driven solutions are secure, performant, reliable, and adaptable to real\-world use cases. * **Collaborate Across Functions:** Work closely with AI/ML engineers, frontend developers, product managers, and SREs to build robust services and developer experiences. Help to build out AI native products for tax, accounting, and audit professionals. * **Developer Enablement** : Build and maintain "golden path" reference implementations for automated build, test, and deploy workflows that development teams can adopt and customize. * Design, implement, and manage reference CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions, Playwright, and Snyk. * Develop Go command\-line tools and services that streamline and empower developer workflows, from local development to production deployment. * Establish, measure, and continuously improve DORA metrics, for example deployment frequency, change failure rate to optimize the velocity and quality of product delivery. * **Production Engineering** : Lead the design and implementation of scalable, resilient, secure, and cost\-effective production infrastructure using Kubernetes, Vercel, AWS, GCP, and AI platforms. * Establish and enforce platform security best practices using multi\-cloud strategies and open\-source CNCF solutions, integrating with cloud\-native security tools and Thomson Reuters internal infrastructure. * Design and implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions using tools such as DataDog and LLM observability tools. * **Collaboration and Leadership** : Set up the necessary processes and documentation to support a team of 150\+ product managers, researchers, and engineers. Align with product, development, and operations teams on business objectives. * Foster a culture of experimentation and continuous improvement, exploring new AI technologies and methodologies. jobs.title: Process Engineer II
jobs.description: *Come join the Tillamook Team, one of the fastest\-growing dairy brands in the US, where we* ***Play to Win*** *to create over 200 dairy products in 7 different categories: cheese, ice cream, yogurt, sour cream, butter, cream cheese and frozen* *meals. Our* ***Uncompromising Quality*** *has led us to become the \#1 Cheddar, \#2 Cream Cheese and \#3 Family Size Ice Cream brand, but we’re not stopping there. We’re loading up for our best years to come and want you to join us.* *As a farmer\-owned cooperative since 1909, we know that being* ***Good Stewards*** *for our stakeholders and doing a little extra always pays off. We’re looking for team members with a* ***One Team*** *and* ***Genuine Care*** *mindset who are inspired to share the delight of the Tillamook brand with each other and others every day.* **What you will do:** The Process Engineer II independently leads recurring problem\-solving and improvement efforts, partnering with operations to implement durable solutions. Drives department\-wide measurable improvements (throughput, downtime, yield, reliability) and develops capacity and constraint analyses that inform site\-level long\-range planning priorities. **Here’s a day in the life:** * **Structured Troubleshooting —** Applies structured troubleshooting methods to recurring and ambiguous process problems; works across shifts and on the floor to move beyond symptoms and consistently identify root cause. * **Root Cause Analysis \& Data\-Driven Continuous Improvement —** Uses production data, downtime trends, and process metrics to lead root cause investigations and continuous improvement within the department; demonstrates the ability to turn recurring issues into verified, sustained gains. * **CIP \& Sanitary Design —** Applies CIP principles, sanitary design standards (3\-A/USDA), and drainability considerations across multiple system areas; demonstrates sound judgment in identifying and escalating sanitation risks (receiving through finished product, separations, pasteurization, cultures, packaging, whey handling). * **Mass \& Energy Balance / Throughput Modeling —** Applies mass and energy balance methods to quantify losses, constraints, and improvement opportunities using real data; uses throughput modeling to support improvement and capacity decisions. * **Process Control \& Automation Literacy —** Developing fluency in control intent, sensor placement and troubleshooting, functional descriptions, and operator interface design. * **Equipment Evaluation \& System Design —** Building the ability to evaluate equipment fit, failure modes, cleanability, and lifecycle cost; contributes to vendor evaluations and equipment selection. * **Dairy Process Fundamentals —** Applies end\-to\-end dairy process knowledge across system areas (receiving through finished product, separations, pasteurization, cultures, packaging, whey handling); uses system understanding to diagnose process behavior beyond the immediate area. * **Utilities Integration —** Developing understanding of how refrigeration, steam, compressed air, water, and wastewater systems constrain and enable production; building the ability to recognize utility\-driven process issues. * **Capacity \& Long\-Range Planning —** Applies capacity and constraint analysis to identify bottlenecks; uses capacity and constraint analyses to inform site\-level long\-range planning priorities. * **Project Management —** Applies project execution practices to deliver department\-level process improvements end to end — scope definition, design, installation, scheduling, and close\-out — delivering measurable results. * Ensures regulatory compliance (ODA, USDA, FDA, SQF, PSM/RMP) * Mandate adherence to all safety guidelines and work to provide a safe work environment for all employees. * **Situational Adaptability —** Picks up on situational cues and adjusts in the moment; readily adapts personal, interpersonal, and work style to the demands of different situations. * **Manages Complexity —** Asks the right questions to accurately analyze situations and acquires data from multiple, diverse sources; uncovers root causes and evaluates the pros, cons, risks, and benefits of different solution options. * **Plans \& Aligns —** Sets objectives that align with broader organizational goals, breaks them into appropriate initiatives and actions, stages activities with relevant milestones and schedules, and adjusts contingency plans as needed. * **Manages Ambiguity —** Deals comfortably with the uncertainty of change and effectively handles risk; decides and acts without the total picture, staying calm and productive even when things are up in the air. * **Communicates Effectively —** Communicates effectively one\-on\-one and in small and large groups across diverse styles and position levels; attentively listens, adjusts to fit the audience and message, and provides timely, helpful information across the organization. * **Collaborates —** Works cooperatively across the o ng fair to others, credits others for their contributions, and gains their trust and support. * **Ensures Accountability —** Follows through on commitments and makes sure others do the same; acts with a clear sense of ownership, takes personal responsibility for decisions, actions, and outcomes, and establishes clear responsibilities and processes for monitoring work and measuring results. * Utilize a computer with intermediate knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and SharePoint. **Knowledge, skills, and abilities:** *EDUCATION* * Bachelor's degree in a technical field (engineering, food science, or related discipline) *EXPERIENCE* * 4–7 years of relevant experience in a manufacturing or process engineering environment * Have experience with the following: Mass balance process flows and calculations, heat exchange (conceptual, theoretical, \& applicable), and food or dairy packaging experience. * Experience working with multi trade\-based vendors/contractors. * Show familiarity with USDA Dairy and 3A Sanitary Design Standards. * Required training/certification: 3\-A Hygienic Design Online Learning courses (Levels 1\.0–4\.0\); Tilla\-Leadership program. **Physical requirements:** * Sitting * Standing and/or walking * Lifting 25 lbs * Vision for machine or computer operations * Hearing * Corporate role Must be able to travel 25\-50% between Tillamook manufacturing facilities. **Working Conditions:** Administration: Individual work space, desk and computer. May not be temperature controlled, could have loud background noises. May include entering production facility and walking on uneven, slippery surfaces and encountering forklift traffic. Requires sitting majority of shift; can include standing and walking to accomplish tasks. May require stooping, bending and crouching to file, retrieve supplies. Occasional lifting of 25 pounds. **Salary Information:** This is a salaried position with a starting salary range of $89,790\.00 \- $130,197\.00\. Actual compensation will be determined by experience and other factors permitted by law. **Industry leading benefit and reward programs:** We offer a best\-in\-class benefits package designed to support your health, well\-being, and professional growth: * **Health Coverage:** Low premiums for medical, prescription, dental, and vision plans. * **Retirement:** 401(k) with 100% match on the first 6% you contribute. * **Wellness Support:** Up to $420 annually for fitness\-related expenses. * **Time Off:** Competitive vacation, 10 paid holidays, birthday off, Heritage Day, and paid volunteer time. * **Family Support:** Pet insurance and inclusive family\-forming benefits including adoption assistance. * **Education:** Financial assistance for online degrees, tuition reimbursement, and access to Rosetta Stone. * **Extra Perks**: Yum Bucks for free Tillamook products, birthday gifts, employee discounts, and more. Learn more at www.tillamook.com/careers. Join a team that values purpose, collaboration, and care—for each other and our communities. Learn We are committed to creating a culture of inclusion where all employees are heard, valued and feel a sense of belonging. We rely on different perspectives, thoughts, backgrounds and cultures to inform our work, to help us be better as a brand and as an employer and to fuel our success. We are seeking talent from a wide range of diversity, perspectives, and backgrounds to join our exceptional organization and help us build our future. *Tillamook County Creamery Association (TCCA) is a Drug\-Free Workplace.**EEO* *TCCA prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type and affords equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants without regard to age, race, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, gender or gender identity, disability status (including those related to pregnancy and childbirth), protected veteran status, membership/non\-membership in a labor organization, or any other characteristic protected*

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (AI Agents)
jobs.description: **About Traba** =============== Traba is building the AI operating layer for the industrial supply chain. We started in the workforce space because contingent labor is the biggest operational pain point our manufacturing and logistics customers face. We used it to embed ourselves inside their daily operations and create a far better customer experience through technology. Now those same customers are pulling us beyond staffing into the broader operational workflows that run their facilities. That foundation gave us proprietary data from millions of shifts and deep enterprise relationships. But our edge is more than data. By connecting to the systems running across every facility and activating the workers already on our platform to execute against them, we are building applied AI that drives real productivity gains and transforms how the global supply chain operates at scale. We are backed by Founders Fund, Khosla Ventures, and General Catalyst. **The Role** ------------ We are looking for an entrepreneurial and experienced Product Manager to join as a founding member of the Agents team and help us build the next layer of Traba's product, an agentic platform that synthesizes the data flowing through our marketplace and operates autonomously inside our customers' supply chain workflows. Think Claude, but for Light Industrial businesses. You'll embed deeply in our customers' operations, design and ship production agents that understand context, reason through ambiguity, make decisions, and execute work on behalf of users. This is a true 0\-to\-1 product role operating at the frontier of applied AI. You will work directly with founders, product engineers, ML teams, and early design partners to define workflows, shape product strategy, and build products while the underlying model ecosystem continues changing beneath us. The assumptions, capabilities, and constraints will evolve rapidly and the product will evolve with them. This role reports directly to our VP of Product. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * Architect and steward product strategy for Traba’s AI agent platform * Solve complex customer problems by balancing user needs, technical constraints, and evolving AI capabilities * Write detailed product requirements and partner deeply with product engineers and ML teams * Rapidly validate and prototype ideas alongside customers and design partners * Design agent systems that reason through workflows, orchestrate tools, maintain context, and execute meaningful work * Define product behavior, evaluation systems, and quality frameworks that improve reliability and performance * Use data to uncover patterns and answer key product and system questions * Evolve our AI product portfolio with a deep understanding of model capabilities and system architecture * Visualize and communicate complex concepts from system behavior and evaluations to user experiences and business impact * Socialize your work across all levels and departments while synthesizing diverse stakeholder feedback **What we’re looking for** -------------------------- **Real agent builder.** You have launched customer\-facing AI products where the system took meaningful actions on behalf of users. We are intentionally setting a high bar here. Shipping AI features, copilots, chat interfaces, wrappers, or lightweight LLM integrations alone is not enough. You understand agents that execute workflows, orchestrate systems, use tools, maintain context, and perform work autonomously. **0\-to\-1 operator.** You have built products from scratch with real customers and understand the realities of finding product market fit. You have launched, rebuilt, changed direction, killed ideas, and iterated toward signals. You are comfortable creating structures where no playbook exists. **AI\-native problem solver.** You move quickly in environments where models evolve constantly and assumptions regularly break. You understand that building AI products often means navigating prompt rewrites, model shifts, reliability tradeoffs, and capability cliffs. **First\-principles thinker.** You spend equal time thinking about why, how, and what. You understand that strong product judgment often comes from deeply understanding systems and constraints rather than applying generic playbooks. **Customer\-embedded builder.** You believe the best products are built shoulder\-to\-shoulder with customers. You have experience deeply embedding with early customers, understanding workflows firsthand, and rapidly shipping based on direct feedback loops. Experience with forward deployed environments or customer\-embedded product development models is highly valued. **Technical depth.** You are comfortable operating alongside ML engineers and highly technical teams as peers. You can understand evaluations, reason through system tradeoffs, prototype ideas, and participate deeply in technical conversations. You do not need to be an ex\-engineer, but you should have strong technical instincts and enjoy getting into the details. **Builder mentality.** Inventive and scrappy problem solver. You move quickly, embrace ambiguity, and know how to create meaningful outcomes without relying on giant teams or excessive process. **Deeply collaborative.** You work seamlessly across engineering, ML, operations, design, leadership, and customers to bring new products to life. **What you’ll bring** --------------------- * 5 – 7 years of experience as a Product Manager * Evidence of launching products from scratch and driving meaningful customer outcomes * Experience building AI\-native products or customer\-facing agent systems * Strong technical abilities with the ability to work deeply with engineering and ML teams * Ability to read evaluations, reason through system performance, and prototype ideas * Experience operating in highly ambiguous startup environments with fast iteration cycles * Deep familiarity with AI tools and hands\-on experience building with modern AI systems * Desire to work at a startup and cover an exceptionally wide surface area * A strong work ethic and desire to build a category\-defining company **Benefits** ------------ * Start\-up equity * Competitive Salary * 100% Paid health, dental \& vision coverage * Dinner Provided via Grubhub \& stocked kitchen for NY employees * Commuter benefit * Team building events * Gympass Benefit * Flexible PTO * ✚✚ Additional: One Medical Membership, Gympass, HSA via Optum, Talkspace, Health Advocate, Teledoc Health **Salary Range Details** ------------------------ The compensation range for this position is set between $180,000 and $210,000, reflecting our market analysis and other relevant considerations. However, exceptions may be made for candidates with qualifications that significantly differ from those outlined in the job description.We also offer a highly competitive equity package designed to ensure you share meaningfully in the long\-term success and upside of the business. The position is based onsite in New York City or San Francisco, five days per week, giving you the opportunity to collaborate closely with a high\-performing team in a fast\-paced, energetic environment. Being in person supports real\-time decision\-making, stronger teamwork, and the kind of creative problem\-solving that drives meaningful impact. **Equal Opportunity Employer** ------------------------------ Traba is dedicated to promoting Equal Opportunity employment practices. We evaluate all applicants without discrimination based on race, color, religion, creed, national origin, age, sex, gender, marital status, sexual orientation and identity, genetic information, veteran status, citizenship, or any other characteristics that are legally protected by local, state, or federal regulations. We encourage applicants from a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skill sets. **Our Values** -------------- **Dream Big \-** We are on a path to change the world for the better. We create and communicate a bold direction that inspires a life\-changing vision. We don’t sacrifice long\-term value for short\-term results. **Olympian’s Work Ethic \-** Changing the world never comes easy. We work harder, longer, and smarter, not just two out of three. We put everything we have on the field. **Growth Mindset \-** We confront the toughest challenges head\-on and persevere. Sometimes we fail, but we brush ourselves off, adapt, learn, and push forward with resilience. **Customer Obsession \-** We go the extra mile for our workers and businesses. We remain focused on delivering high\-quality products and services that solve this massive and overlooked industries’ problems Privacy Notice for CA Applicants Compensation Range: $180K \- $210K

Founded by Christina Knight — who spent nine years working on AI safety across Stanford, the U.S. government (where she helped start the Center for AI Standards and Innovation), Scale AI, and Harvard Law/MBA — alongside her co\-founder, a researcher and postdoc at MIT and Harvard. We have raised **$9\.2 million in pre\-seed funding** from 8VC and Floodgate. We are a small, rapidly growing team of engineers, legal experts, and researchers based in San Francisco. jobs.title: Software Engineer II - Backend Engineer
jobs.description: **About the role and team** Uber has evolved from a ride\-hailing service into an all\-in\-one platform, connecting users globally through various on\-demand offerings across UberX and UberEats. To unite this ecosystem, we introduced Uber One\-a paid membership program designed to elevate user experiences with priority service and exclusive perks. Under one unified membership, members unlock enhanced pricing, upgraded rides, dedicated customer support, premium partner benefits, and elevated service quality. With more than 50 million global Uber One members driving over half of our total company revenue, the program is a critical engine for company\-wide growth across our core offerings while shaping how users interact with our expanding ecosystem and new company big bets. Join us as we drive Uber's growth and shape expansion into new verticals. In this role on the Membership team, you will help shape the future of the program by architecting next\-generation member experiences and benefits in close partnership with cross\-functional teams. You will oversee our platform architecture and design highly reliable, scalable systems that power new initiatives across both UberEats and UberX. If you excel at tackling complex technical challenges, crafting impactful products, and driving key business outcomes, the Membership team is the perfect fit for you. **What you'll do** * Identify new impactful opportunities to evolve the Uber One program across UberEats and UberX * Collaborate with talented engineers, PMs, Data Science and Designers from across the company to design, build, and optimize products used by millions of members globally * Architect robust, highly available, and scalable systems designed to resolve ambiguous technical challenges to serve millions of users. Align the org on complex tradeoffs between various different technical designs and solutions * Drive technical strategy for platform evolution, microservices architecture, and API design to simplify future program needs * Cultivate engineering culture and technical excellence to drive up engineering velocity and quality across the team **Basic Qualifications** * 3\+ years work experience in software engineering building large scale systems * Bachelor's (or higher) in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. * Strong hands\-on technical skills, including proficiency in one or more programming languages (Go, Java, Python, Kotlin, Swift, C\+\+) and code reviews. * Deep understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including algorithms, data structures, distributed systems, system design, and architecture. * Proven experience in owning critical and large\-scale platforms, infra services. Proven experience in identifying architectural gaps and creating org\-wide frameworks that improve developer velocity and reduce systemic technical debt. * Proven ability to lead technical projects end\-to\-end through all lifecycle stages, from inception through design through global deployment and productionization. * Expertise in defining standards for testing, monitoring, and alerting systems, while overseeing the execution of complex incident management at an organizational level. * Demonstrated leadership in building relationships with internal stakeholders and external partners to rally around a technical vision. **Preferred Qualifications** * **Marketplace experience** **\- Uber's business model is marketplace heavy and prior experience creating 0 to 1 features and optimizing marketplaces is preferred.** **Experience in real\-time marketplace platforms requiring high consistency and global reliability.** * **Impact Mindset** \- (1\) Ability to navigate complex org and company business needs (2\) Ability to identify consumer needs through user research and data understand work (3\) Bringing those together to build products and systems that bring value to our customers and deliver company impact * **Strong Cross Company Technical Collaboration** \- (1\) Strong ability to collaborate and communicate technically with multiple teams across the company (2\) Strong ability to deep dive into complex technical systems owned by other organizations (3\) Create clean technical solutions that factor in complexities across multiple systems \& ultimately solve for multiple team goals For New York City, NY\-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $171,000 per year \- USD $190,000 per year. For San Francisco, CA\-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $171,000 per year \- USD $190,000 per year. For Sunnyvale, CA\-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $171,000 per year \- USD $190,000 per year. For all US locations, you will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award \& other types of comp. All full\-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits. **Ready to Ride?** This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook \- it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves \- we'd love to hear from you. You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits. Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in\-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full\-time in\-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements. Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.

The incumbent functions as a liaison between the SR Director, the Research Lab Supervisor and Research staff for laboratory and equipment maintenance, compliance, ordering, and maintaining inventory records. **Core Responsibilities:** * Assists in the operation of sophisticated scientific equipment. * Assists in the development of new core procedures. * Assists in ensuring the lab adheres to regulatory policies. * Reviews laboratory results and maintains records using appropriate lab notebook or database entry. * Follows SOPs (Standard Operating Protocols) Evaluates inventory of supplies and reagents, communicate order needs, place orders and verify receipts. * Inventory and manage stock as received. * Assists in performing QA/QC and maintenance of laboratory equipment, including making minor repairs or communicating with service engineers as needed. * Possesses the computational skills necessary to acquire proficiency in new software programs, cloud\-based tools, online webforms and databases. * Exercises excellent record\-keeping skills for all laboratory work and client interactions. * Keeps abreast of current publications relative to methods, techniques, and developments within the area of research. Adheres to University and unit\-level policies and procedures and safeguards University assets. * **Department Specific Functions – HIHG CGT Service Core RA1** Communicate professionally, verbally and in writing, with team members and colleagues * Exhibit the ability to take direction from peers, follow detailed and specific instructions, take applicable notes, ask pertinent questions and think organized and detailed laboratory notebook associated with all executed laboratory procedures * Possess the standard computational skills necessary to acquire proficiency in new software programs, cloud\-based tools, online webforms and databases * Work closely with senior research associates to train on at least one highly specialized molecular genetics platform in the genotyping, sequencing or biorepository core in order to successfully execute and troubleshoot its protocols independently * ***This list of duties and responsibilities is not intended to be all\-inclusive and may be expanded to include other duties or responsibilities as necessary.*** **Core Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in relevant field * Skill in completing assignments accurately and with attention to detail. * Ability to process and handle confidential information with discretion. * Ability to analyze, organize and prioritize work under pressure while meeting deadlines. * Ability to maintain effective interpersonal relationships. * Skill in collecting, organizing and analyzing data. Skill in completing assignments accurately and with attention to detail. * The University of Miami offers competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, tuition remission and more. jobs.title: HPC User Support Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** The University of Notre Dame is more than a workplace; it is a vibrant, mission\-driven community where every employee is valued and supported. Rooted in a tradition of excellence and inspired by our Catholic character, Notre Dame is committed to fostering an environment of care that nurtures the whole person—mind, body, and spirit. Here, you will find a deep sense of belonging, a culture that prioritizes well\-being, and the opportunity to grow your career while being a force for good in the world. Whether contributing to world\-class research, shaping the student experience, or supporting the University’s mission in other ways, you will be part of a dedicated team working to make a meaningful impact on campus and beyond. At Notre Dame, your work matters, and so do you! **Job Description** The Center for Research Computing (CRC) at the University of Notre Dame is seeking an HPC User Support Engineer to support researchers in effectively leveraging large\-scale computing and storage infrastructure. This position serves as a technical resource for undergraduate, graduate, faculty, and other computational researchers, helping them navigate complex high\-performance computing (HPC) environments, accelerated GPU clusters, and emerging AI/ML workflows to maximize the performance and efficiency of their research. The HPC User Support Engineer will bring expertise across Linux environments, programming and scripting languages, job scheduling, scientific applications, optimized compilers, mathematical libraries and algorithms, and distributed and parallel file systems. The role requires a combination of strong technical skills, problem\-solving ability, and excellent communication skills to address highly technical user needs and translate complex concepts for researchers with varying levels of computational experience. Working under the direction of the Center for Research Computing, this position may directly administer and support HPC systems or coordinate with colleagues across departments, colleges, and peer institutions to develop and maintain a world\-class research computing environment. Key Responsibilities * Provide technical support to users of high\-performance computing resources through email, virtual meetings, and in\-person consultations. Assess access issues, troubleshoot complex job workflows, investigate system problems, and resolve local and global application issues. * Analyze user challenges and identify opportunities to improve system documentation. Develop new documentation and update existing resources to provide clear guidance for common issues, workflows, and solutions. * Assist researchers with configuring, debugging, and scaling artificial intelligence, machine learning, and deep learning workflows across accelerated cluster infrastructure. * Lead and teach weekly HPC orientation and training sessions for undergraduate and graduate users, including researchers from both technical and non\-technical backgrounds. * Participate in workshops and other educational programs, which may occasionally require half\-day or full\-day sessions. Maintain and enhance training materials and contribute to developing new approaches to educating and supporting HPC users. * Work directly with researchers to debug, profile, and optimize scientific software and computational workflows, helping users improve the efficiency and performance of their applications on HPC resources. * Monitor and assess system usage to identify opportunities for improved performance, efficiency, and resource utilization. Collaborate with users to understand computational challenges and recommend appropriate solutions. * Support other HPC staff with system performance initiatives, emerging technologies, current tools and practices, and ongoing user education. * Coordinate with department, college, and external colleagues when specialized expertise or additional resources are needed to resolve technical challenges or advance HPC capabilities. * Communicate technical issues, recommendations, project updates, and progress effectively to both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Stay current with developments in high\-performance computing, scientific software, programming frameworks, system architectures, and research computing practices. * Participate in occasional non\-standard work hours when necessary to support critical systems, maintenance activities, or research computing needs. * Perform other related duties as assigned. * This position is structured as a hybrid role requiring a minimum of 3 days per week on\-site to support in\-person consultations, lab visits, and classroom instruction. Regular campus business hours apply, with occasional flexible evening or weekend hours required for planned system maintenance, critical cluster support, or scheduled training sessions. **Qualifications** * Master’s degree in a STEM field with 1\+ years of experience in HPC or scientific computing support; Or * Bachelor’s degree in a STEM field with 3–5\+ years of relevant technical experience (with at least 1 year directly supporting HPC/scientific workflows); Or * An equivalent combination of education, relevant certifications, and experience. Preferred Qualifications * Experience supporting researchers in an academic, research, industry, or supercomputing environment. * Advanced knowledge of one or more HPC areas, including Linux, programming and scripting, parallel programming (MPI), job schedulers, scientific applications, numerical methods, debugging, profiling, optimization, or distributed file systems. * Experience supporting modern machine learning frameworks, data science toolsets, and interactive computing environments within an HPC or cluster environment. * Ability to quickly learn and independently develop expertise in new technologies and tools. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills. **Additional Information** *The University of Notre Dame seeks to attract, develop, and retain the highest quality faculty, staff and administration. The University is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national or ethnic origin, sex, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or age in employment. Moreover, Notre Dame prohibits discrimination against veterans or disabled qualified individuals, and complies with 41 CFR 60\-741\.5(a) and 41 CFR 60\-300\.5(a). We strongly encourage applications from candidates attracted to a university with a Catholic identity.*

jobs.title: Project Engineer
jobs.description: **Systems \& Project Engineer** In the first 60 days, you will operate as a Tier 2 Service Desk Engineer by resolving escalated tickets, learning our clients and processes, and helping stabilize service desk operations. Once that foundation is established, the role transitions into a Project Engineer focus: planning and executing client onboarding projects, infrastructure deployments, and technical initiatives across networking, server, security, and advanced Microsoft tooling. We are looking for someone with strong fundamentals, a good attitude, and the ability to grow into the project side of this role with proper support. **Phase 1 (Days 1–60\):** Tier 2 Service Desk — Learn the environment, stabilize support operations, build client trust. **Phase 2 (Day 61\+):** Project Engineer — Lead and execute client onboarding and infrastructure projects across networking, server, security, and advanced Microsoft tools. **Phase 1: Tier 2 Service Desk (First 60 Days)** Your primary focus during onboarding is to get up to speed quickly, support our clients well, and develop a deep understanding of our processes and environments. Specific responsibilities include: * Resolving escalated Tier 1 and Tier 2 tickets across Windows, macOS, Microsoft 365, networking, VPN, endpoint security, and line\-of\-business applications. * Identifying root causes rather than applying temporary fixes. * Maintaining clean tickets: accurate time entries, clear notes, and timely client communication. * Coaching junior technicians when escalations need more discovery or a different approach. * Learning our client environments, documentation standards, and tooling (HaloPSA, Datto RMM, etc.). * Flagging patterns, recurring issues, or inherited problems that may warrant project work. * Contributing to the knowledge base and internal documentation as you learn. **Phase 2: Project Engineer (Day 61\+)** After the initial ramp period, this role shifts to project\-focused work. You will plan and execute technical projects for clients ranging from standard onboarding deployments (for our CST and EST clients) to more advanced initiatives. Project types include: Networking * Firewall deployments and configuration (Fortinet, SonicWall, Meraki, UniFi). * VLAN design and switch configuration. * Wireless access point deployments. * VPN setup and troubleshooting. * Network documentation and diagramming. Server \& Infrastructure * Windows Server deployments, updates, and migrations. * Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and file share management. * Backup configuration and validation. * Virtualization and cloud infrastructure changes. * On\-prem to cloud migrations. Security * Microsoft 365 security hardening: Conditional Access, MFA, Defender, and Secure Score improvements. * Endpoint protection and EDR deployment. * Email security configuration (filtering, DMARC/DKIM/SPF). * Security baseline implementation for new and existing clients. Client Onboarding Projects A core part of the project role is supporting structured client onboarding. This includes: * Technical discovery for new clients: reviewing environments, licensing, security posture, and documentation gaps. * User onboarding/offboarding workflows: accounts, MFA, device assignments, and application access. * Standardizing client environments to our baseline configurations. * Identifying risks and inherited issues that need remediation. * Documenting client\-specific systems, vendors, processes, and escalation paths. * Ensuring completed project work is cleanly handed off and supportable by the service desk. **Required Skills \& Experience** Strong candidates will have solid hands\-on experience with most of the following: * Microsoft 365 administration: Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, and licensing. * Entra ID / Azure AD: user management, groups, and identity. * Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, file permissions, and Windows Server. * Windows workstation troubleshooting and deployment. * Basic to intermediate networking: VLANs, DHCP, DNS, VPN, firewalls, switches, and wireless. * Ticketing systems and MSP service desk operations. * Clear, professional communication with both technical and non\-technical clients. * Ability to work independently and document work without constant reminders. **Preferred Skills (Nice to Have)** These are not requirements — we expect to help develop skills in these areas over time: * Intune / Microsoft Endpoint Manager. * Conditional Access and MFA administration. * Firewall platforms: Fortinet, SonicWall, Meraki, UniFi. * Backup and monitoring platforms. * Security tooling: EDR, SIEM, email filtering, vulnerability management. * PowerShell scripting or automation. * Power Automate or Power BI (even beginner\-level exposure is a plus). * macOS support in business environments. * PSA/RMM tools used in MSP environments. * Google Workspace administration. **Who We Are Looking For** You do not need to know everything on day one. architectur nce, or financial transaction data is a plus. **Benefits \& Perks** Vyne offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, financial well\-being, families, and lifestyles of our employees, including: * Medical, dental, and vision coverage * Retirement savings benefits * Paid time off and company holidays * Paid parental leave * Family support benefits, including diaper and wipes assistance for eligible employees during the first year * Pet insurance * Additional voluntary benefits * Flexible and remote work opportunities, where applicable * Professional development and career growth opportunities * Collaborative, supportive, and people\-focused work environment *Benefits and eligibility may vary based on position, employment status, location, and applicable plan terms.* **Physical Demands:** The physical demands described are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms and talk or hear. jobs.description: Veradigm is looking for a DevOps Engineer to help build and support a cloud\-based patient engagement platform used by millions of users every day. You'll take on real ownership of CI/CD pipelines and Azure infrastructure, and support .NET applications as part of a full\-stack delivery team. You'll work with Terraform to manage Azure infrastructure as code, build and maintain GitHub Actions/Azure DevOps pipelines for our .NET applications, and pair that DevOps work with full\-stack development knowledge to better support our development teams. You'll collaborate closely with developers, QA, and product owners in an agile environment, and you'll have support from senior engineers as you grow into more advanced infrastructure and automation work. ***This is a hybrid position, expected 2 days a week in Raleigh office*** **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps for building, testing, and deploying .NET applications. * Write and maintain Terraform modules to provision and manage Azure infrastructure (App Services, Azure SQL, AKS, Key Vault, networking, IAM). * Develop and maintain full\-stack features in .NET (C\#, ASP.NET Core, REST APIs), including bug fixes and enhancements alongside DevOps work. * Automate build, deployment, and cleanup tasks using PowerShell, Bash, or Python, including deployment scripts, log parsers, and tooling for development teams. * Apply secure DevOps practices across builds, GitHub Actions/Azure DevOps pipelines, and infrastructure creation, including security compliance and scanning. * Monitor application and infrastructure health using Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics, Prometheus, Kibana, and Grafana; triage and resolve build, deployment, or environment failures. * Partner with development, QA, and product teams to translate requirements into clear technical designs and estimates. * Produce and maintain technical and deployment documentation. * Participate in code and pipeline reviews; escalate issues and risks in a timely manner. * Support and mentor junior DevOps team members. **Technical Skills \& Experience** ---------------------------------- **Version Control** * Experience with version control — GitHub environments, GitHub expertise, and Git workflow best practices (feature branches, pull requests, tagging, secrets). **DevOps \& CI/CD** * Proven experience implementing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, with hands\-on experience in GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps. * Expertise in Azure cloud platforms, including compute, storage, networking, containerization (AKS), identity and access management (IAM), and monitoring and alerting. **Infrastructure as Code** * Strong experience with Terraform for managing Azure infrastructure. * Familiarity with Azure\-specific resources (App Services, Azure SQL, AKS, Key Vault, etc.). **Containers \& Configuration Management** * Exposure to container technologies (Docker, Kubernetes, AKS). **Application Support** * Experience supporting applications built in .NET (Framework and Core) — build and deployment automation. * Able to work with developers supporting both modern and legacy applications. **Full\-Stack Development** * Working knowledge of C\# and .NET (Framework and/or Core). * Experience building or maintaining REST APIs; jobs.title: Research Operations Analyst
jobs.description: As a Research Operations Analyst, you will help safeguard the quality, integrity, and efficiency of research and model development across CRS (Catastrophe and Risk Solutions). Reporting to the Head of Research Operations within the Research Department, you will partner with researchers and engineers as a compliance liaison throughout the development lifecycle, conduct model audits ahead of release, and support a broad portfolio of Research Operations initiatives, from training and GenAI enablement to data acquisition and resource planning, all in service of helping Research operate at scale and amplify its impact across the organization. We operate in an environment in perpetual evolution, with access to new compute solutions, new software, and new AI capabilities. Research Operations helps Research maintain its level of excellence by organizing and optimizing the people, processes, tools, and technologies behind our work, ensuring it stays reproducible, well documented, compliant, and efficiently supported. This is a hands\-on role for someone with strong attention to detail, solid technical foundations, and a genuine curiosity about how world\-class scientific modeling gets done. You will apply and enforce our established procedures while gaining broad exposure to audit, data, AI, and infrastructure topics within a leading modeling organization. You will join a department of more than 100 scientists, engineers, mathematicians, and analysts who develop and maintain a global suite of probabilistic risk models used to quantify and transfer risk worldwide. **Supporting Model Audits \& Research Compliance** Following our established audit procedure, you will conduct methodical audits of models ahead of each release milestone. Working from our model release questionnaire, you will verify process and release readiness (including reproducibility of results and validation against benchmarks), data management practices, documentation and team redundancy, compliance requirements, and adherence to code and coding standards. Beyond checking responses, you will probe inconsistencies, ask follow\-up questions, and exercise judgment about what constitutes sufficient evidence, tracking findings through to resolution. As a review liaison during development, you will advise teams on research compliance, helping protect our intellectual property and minimize our data footprint. You will also help implement new processes and requirements for models developed on Nexus, our new platform, and keep audit procedures and checklists documented and up to date. **Advising on Data Acquisition** You will guide teams through Data Usage Requests and advise on terms of use for external data, flagging licensing or usage risks early in development. **Enabling Training \& Knowledge Sharing** You will develop training content on research best practices and compliance standards, and coordinate, and at times lead, training efforts drawing on our in\-house experts, helping knowledge circulate across the department. **Advancing GenAI Adoption** You will maintain a curated repository of GenAI prompts and workflows, helping researchers discover, reuse, and extend what works, and tracking emerging use cases to broaden the responsible use of generative AI in Research. **Supporting IT Resource Management \& Planning** You will maintain an overview of data management practices, facilitate the planning of compute, storage, and software needs, and prepare usage overviews that help leadership make informed decisions about resources. **Contributing to Community \& Communication** You will help coordinate community rituals such as research seminars and team\-building events, and participate in newsletter efforts that showcase the department's work and keep teams connected. **Education \& Experience** * Bachelor's degree required (Math, Engineering, Science, or related field). jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Job Overview We are seeking a dynamic and innovative Data Engineer to join our team and drive the development of robust data systems that empower insightful decision\-making. In this role, you will design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and architectures that support our big data initiatives and business intelligence efforts. Your expertise will enable seamless data integration, management, and analysis across diverse platforms, ensuring our organization leverages data to its fullest potential. This position offers an exciting opportunity to work with cutting\-edge cloud technologies, big data systems, and advanced analytics tools in a fast\-paced environment committed to continuous improvement and innovation. Responsibilities * Develop, implement, and optimize ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) pipelines using tools like Informatica, Talend, or custom scripting to facilitate efficient data flow between systems. * Design and maintain scalable data models and schemas for data warehouses utilizing dimensional modeling techniques to support business intelligence needs. * Build and manage cloud\-based data storage solutions such as Azure Data Lake, AWS S3, or similar public cloud platforms to ensure secure and efficient data access. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to integrate linked data sources and ensure consistency across big data systems like Hadoop, Apache Hive, Spark, and related technologies. * Implement data management best practices for quality assurance, security, and compliance while supporting agile development methodologies. * Develop SQL queries, Python scripts, Bash (Unix shell), and shell scripts for automation of data workflows and analysis tasks. * Support the design of RESTful APIs for seamless data exchange between applications and services while contributing to model training and analytics initiatives. Skills * Extensive experience with cloud databases such as Azure Data Lake, AWS Public Cloud services, or equivalent platforms. * Proficiency in programming languages including Java, Python, SQL (Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle), with strong knowledge of SQL databases and query management. * Deep understanding of big data systems such as Hadoop ecosystem components (Hadoop, Spark, Hive) for large\-scale processing. * Skilled in designing efficient data models using dimensional modeling techniques for data warehousing and analytics purposes. * Hands\-on experience with ETL pipeline development using tools like Informatica or Talend; familiarity with RESTful API development is a plus. * Strong knowledge of business intelligence tools such as Looker or similar platforms for visualization and reporting. * Ability to work within an Agile environment while managing multiple projects related to data engineering and analysis skills. * Knowledge of database design principles for both traditional SQL databases (Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle) and cloud\-based solutions; experience with shell scripting (Bash/Unix) is advantageous. * Excellent analytical skills combined with a proactive approach to problem\-solving in complex big data environments. Join us if you’re passionate about transforming raw data into strategic insights through innovative engineering solutions! ***Equal Opportunity Employer Statement*** *VForce Infotech is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.* Pay: $60,000\.00 \- $80,000\.00 per year Work Location: In person

monitor inventory; load and unload supplies, materials, and equipment * Coordinate and assist with people and furniture relocations or installations * Coordinate load and delivery of tables and chairs to support special events * Scope, source, and manage renovation projects within existing facilities cohesively and efficiently by working with operations, safety, environmental, quality, accounting, sourcing, and/or any other internal and external project stakeholders **WHAT YOU BRING** * Associate's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, or Construction Engineering; Keck Observatory offers astronomers a unique vantage point to explore the universe, all while respecting the deep cultural significance of this site to the indigenous Native Hawaiian community. Our twin telescopes are at the forefront of astronomical research and provide invaluable insights into the cosmos. At Keck, we are committed to service, stewardship, and community engagement. Join us, and become an integral part of our mission. **A Day in the Life of a Summit Mechanical Engineer II:** As a Summit Mechanical Engineer II, you’ll play a key role in supporting the operation, maintenance, and upgrade of critical mechanical systems at our summit facility on Maunakea. This position is ideal for an engineer who thrives in both the field and collaborative project environments—someone who can diagnose issues, lead testing and repairs, support engineering design and integration, and coordinate multidisciplinary teams to keep world\-class observatory systems performing safely and reliably. In this role, you’ll work closely with engineers, summit supervisors, technicians, project managers, and subcontractors to support mechanical system upgrades, maintenance efforts, installation planning, and repair activities. You’ll review and interpret technical documentation, construction drawings, schematics, procedures, and industry standards while helping ensure engineering solutions are safe, practical, and completed with accountability. At Keck, your work directly supports the frontiers of astronomy while honoring the cultural significance of Maunakea and our commitment to stewardship, service, safety, and community engagement. If you’re a motivated problem\-solver with strong mechanical engineering fundamentals, hands\-on troubleshooting skills, and a passion for supporting complex systems in a unique summit environment, we encourage you to apply.### **Required Qualifications** *Education** Bachelor of Science in mechanical engineering or a related degree. *Experience** Five (5\) years working on complex mechanical systems. * Varied and broad experience with large industrial equipment such as motors, multi\-stage gearboxes, drives, pumps, chillers, ventilation systems, and similar. * Experience maintaining, testing, and troubleshooting mechanical systems. * Experience building a machine that moves and requires power. * Experience participating in design reviews and collaborating with a cross functional engineering team. *Technical Competency** Field experience working with legacy systems and equipment. * Well\-versed in mechanical engineering first principles. * Experience using 3D CAD software. SolidWorks preferred. * Experience in Engineering Change (EC) control processes and engineering design reviews. * Proficient in creating technical engineering documentation including reports and procedures. * Experience with fabrication. For instance, cutting, milling, welding. * Experience performing engineering tests. This may include testing for environmental conditions, vibration, shock, thermal, or similar experience and comfort using personnel lifts, cranes, hoists, or other lifting equipment. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Rigging experience and the ability to create and lead lifting plans for use by Operations team. * Condition monitoring, vibration analysis or other instrumentation experience (strain gauges). * Reliability engineering and asset management principles. * Operational fault diagnostics using SCADA (supervisory control and data acquisition) systems. * Use of CMMS (computerized maintenance management system). * Experience with opto\-mechanical systems including kinematic mounting and alignment of optical systems. * Experience handling both medium and large optics (meter\-class). * Experience with hydraulic and pneumatic systems. * Experience with cryogenics and cryogenic instrumentation. * Experience with clean room environments. * Systems Engineering experience managing requirements verification and interface control. * Project Management experience generating schedules and budgets. * Experience with Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD\&T) per ASME Y14\.5\. * Experience creating part and assembly drawings according to ASME Y14\.100\. **Don't miss the opportunity to be part of a dynamic team driving advancements in astronomy at W.M. Keck Observatory. Apply for this Summit Mechanical Engineer II position today and embark on an exciting journey with us.**### **About W. M. Keck Observatory** At the W. M. Keck Observatory, we approach our work with wonder about the mysteries of the universe and with deep respect and care for Maunakea – a mountain revered in Hawaiʻi and unlike any other in the world. For more than three decades, astronomers using Keck Observatory’s twin 10\-meter telescopes have vastly expanded our understanding of the cosmos through astonishing findings about our solar system, exoplanets, supermassive black holes, the evolution of the universe, and more. We are dedicated to the values of service and stewardship, while advancing the frontiers of astronomy, sharing our discoveries, and inspiring the imagination of all.

That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.* **What does a Senior Project Manager for Hex do at WPP Production?** As **Senior Project Manager for HEX**, you will be at the operational heart of HEX Studio. You will drive the scoping, delivery, and scaling of highly experimental, AI\-native production workflows, innovation workstreams, and commercial proofs\-of\-concept. To learn more about the Hex Studio: https://www.wpp.com/en/news/wpp\-launches\-hex\-creating\-a\-new\-kind\-of\-talent\-pipeline\-designed\-for\-the\-ai\-era. This role requires a rare blend of creative tech literacy, delivery discipline, and commercial acumen. You will act as the crucial translator between client/agency leadership and specialized technical teams (AI engineers, creative technologists, developers)—turning frontier tech ambitions into structured, high\-impact deliverables on time and on budget. **Key Responsibilities:** * AI \& Frontier Tech Delivery * + **End\-to\-End Delivery:** Lead the project lifecycle for complex AI and creative technology initiatives—spanning generative AI asset pipelines, agentic tools, spatial/interactive experiences, and rapid prototyping. + **Pipeline \& System Architecture Support:** Partner with technical leads to scope and build bespoke production workflows, ensuring fluid handoffs between traditional creative teams and AI\-enabled pipelines. + **Beta Tech \& Risk Management:** Proactively identify, evaluate, and manage technical, legal, and operational risks inherent to working with beta software, emerging AI models, IP boundaries, and fluid technical scopes. * Strategic Client \& Stakeholder Leadership * + **Forward\-Deployed Leadership:** Serve as a trusted delivery partner for forward\-deployed HEX teams, agency leads, and brand partners, articulating complex technical concepts into clear strategic choices and actionable milestones. + **Education \& Enablement:** Guide clients and agency stakeholders through the shift toward AI\-assisted workflows, building confidence in rapid iteration, experimentation, and iterative learning. * Financial \& Agile Governance * + **Financial Control:** Take end\-to\-end accountability for project budgets ($250K\+ individual budget size), managing resource allocation, burn rates, margin targets, and financial reconciliations with precision. + **Hybrid Agile Methodologies:** Adapt and apply Agile/Scrum frameworks tailored to creative technology R\&D—balancing sprint speed and rapid feedback loops with commercial deadlines. * Operational Scaling \& Knowledge Transfer * + **Best Practice Definition:** Establish standard operating procedures, pilot evaluation frameworks, and delivery playbooks for AI\-native production within HEX. + **Network Scaling:** Oversee post\-project documentation, capturing learnings from pilot programs and R\&D workstreams to scale successful AI workflows across WPP Production and the broader WPP agency network. **Core Competencies \& Skills** * **Technical Literacy:** Practical understanding of modern generative AI tools, diffusion models, LLMs, agentic workflows, and real\-time engines (e.g., Unreal Engine/Unity) applied to creative production. * **Scope \& Fluidity Management:** Proven ability to bring structure, clarity, and control to highly complex, fluid, and experimental tech scopes without stifling creative innovation. * **Commercial \& Financial Acumen:** Rigorous budget management skills, with a track record of running $250K\+ engagements profitably while managing complex resource models. * **Cross\-Disciplinary Translation:** Exceptional communication skills with the ability to bridge conversation between technologists, creative teams, client leaders, and legal/procurement teams. * **Adaptive Leadership:** Comfort with ambiguity, rapid technological shift, and pioneering new delivery models in a high\-growth studio environment. **Experience:** * **5\+ Years in Creative Tech / Digital Production:** Proven experience as a Project Manager or Producer in a creative agency, innovation lab, or creative tech studio. * **Hands\-On AI \& Innovation Track Record:** Demonstrated experience delivering complex technical projects involving AI integration, custom workflows, or interactive technology from initial concept through to final deployment. * **Multi\-Stakeholder Environments:** Track record of operating successfully across matrixed agency environments, client\-embedded teams, and third\-party tech partners. * **Agile Certification or Equivalent Practice:** Exposure to or practical experience with Agile, Scrum, or Kanban methodologies applied to creative technology. **Desirable Skills:** * Direct experience helping to define new commercial or operational models for creative production. * Experience building or managing production pipelines as the primary project deliverable. * Active personal engagement and ongoing experimentation with emerging AI models, tools, and developer platforms. \#LI\-hybrid
